name: PREUPD_OGF
body:
create trigger PREUPD_OGF
on R5OPFILES
for update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sAudituser     		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dAudittimestamp		datetime            
	declare @nId            		integer             
	declare @sDirname       		nvarchar(250)       
	declare @sFilename      		nvarchar(250)       
	declare @nSqlidentity   		integer             

	declare @sOldAudituser     	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldAudittimestamp	datetime            
	declare @nOldId            	integer             
	declare @sOldDirname       	nvarchar(250)       
	declare @sOldFilename      	nvarchar(250)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.OGF_AUDITUSER,	i.OGF_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	i.OGF_ID,	i.OGF_DIRNAME,	i.OGF_FILENAME,
													 	i.OGF_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.OGF_AUDITUSER,	d.OGF_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	d.OGF_ID,	d.OGF_DIRNAME,	d.OGF_FILENAME
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.OGF_SQLIDENTITY = d.OGF_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,	@nId,	@sDirname,	@sFilename,
												   	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldAudituser,	@dOldAudittimestamp,	@nOldId,	@sOldDirname,	@sOldFilename
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							update R5OPFILES set OGF_AUDITTIMESTAMP = getDate(), OGF_LASTSAVED = getdate() where OGF_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,	@nId,	@sDirname,	@sFilename,
														   	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldAudituser,	@dOldAudittimestamp,	@nOldId,	@sOldDirname,	@sOldFilename
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_OML
ON r5objmaplayer
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT oml_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5objmaplayer
          SET    oml_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  oml_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

	declare @nMatchltp   		numeric(5,2)
	declare @nTimezone   		numeric(4,1)
	declare @nLatitude   		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nLongitude  		numeric(24,6)

	declare @nInvqtytol  		numeric(7,2)
	declare @sDunsnum    		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)
	declare @dCreated    		datetime
	declare @dUpdated    		datetime
	declare @sLocale     		nvarchar(10)
	declare @sDepmethod    		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDeprmethod   		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCurr       	nvarchar(3)
	declare @sOldCommon     	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldCoderef    	nvarchar(50)
	declare @sOldBookid     	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldMatchlta   	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldMatchltp   	numeric(5,2)
	declare @nOldTimezone   	numeric(4,1)
	declare @nOldLatitude   	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldLongitude  	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldExternalorg	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldInvqtytol  	numeric(7,2)
	declare @sOldDunsnum    	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime
	declare @sOldLocale     	nvarchar(10)
	declare @sOldDepmethod    	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldDeprmethod   	nvarchar(4)

    declare @sSegmentvalue  nvarchar(30)

    declare @sUdfchar01      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar02      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar03      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar04      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar05      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar06      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar07      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar08      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sUdfchar09      nvarchar(80)

    declare @nUdfnum01       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nUdfnum02       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nUdfnum03       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nUdfnum04       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nUdfnum05       numeric(24,6)

    declare @dUdfdate01      datetime
    declare @dUdfdate02      datetime
    declare @dUdfdate03      datetime
    declare @dUdfdate04      datetime
    declare @dUdfdate05      datetime

    declare @sUdfchkbox01    nvarchar(1)
    declare @sUdfchkbox02    nvarchar(1)
    declare @sUdfchkbox03    nvarchar(1)
    declare @sUdfchkbox04    nvarchar(1)
    declare @sUdfchkbox05    nvarchar(1)

	declare @sAccountingentity nvarchar(22)
    declare @sStreamPlusProject nvarchar(8)

    declare @sCalGroupOrg       nvarchar(15)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin

			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.ORG_CODE, i.ORG_DESC, i.ORG_CURR, i.ORG_COMMON, i.ORG_CODEREF, i.ORG_BOOKID,
														i.ORG_MATCHLTA, i.ORG_MATCHLTP, i.ORG_TIMEZONE, i.ORG_LATITUDE, i.ORG_LONGITUDE,

														d.ORG_COMMON, d.ORG_CODEREF, d.ORG_BOOKID, d.ORG_MATCHLTA, d.ORG_MATCHLTP,
														d.ORG_TIMEZONE, d.ORG_LATITUDE, d.ORG_LONGITUDE, d.ORG_EXTERNALORG, d.ORG_INVQTYTOL,
														d.ORG_DUNSNUM, d.ORG_UPDATECOUNT, d.ORG_CREATED, d.ORG_UPDATED, d.ORG_LOCALE, d.ORG_DEPMETHOD,	d.ORG_DEPRMETHOD,

											@nTimezone, @nLatitude, @nLongitude, @sExternalorg, @nInvqtytol, @sDunsnum,
											@nUpdatecount, @dCreated, @dUpdated, @sLocale, @nSqlidentity, @sDepmethod,	@sDeprmethod, @sOldCode,
											@sOldDesc, @sOldCurr, @sOldCommon, @sOldCoderef, @sOldBookid, @nOldMatchlta,
											@nOldMatchltp, @nOldTimezone, @nOldLatitude, @nOldLongitude, @sOldExternalorg,
											@nOldInvqtytol, @sOldDunsnum, @nOldUpdatecount, @dOldCreated, @dOldUpdated,
											@sOldLocale, @sOldDepmethod,	@sOldDeprmethod, @sSegmentvalue,
                                            @sUdfchar01, @sUdfchar02, @sUdfchar03, @sUdfchar04, @sUdfchar05,
                                            @sUdfchar06, @sUdfchar07, @sUdfchar08, @sUdfchar09, @sUdfchar10,
                                            @nUdfnum01, @nUdfnum02, @nUdfnum03, @nUdfnum04, @nUdfnum05,
                                            @dUdfdate01, @dUdfdate02, @dUdfdate03, @dUdfdate04, @dUdfdate05,
                                            @sUdfchkbox01, @sUdfchkbox02, @sUdfchkbox03, @sUdfchkbox04, @sUdfchkbox05, @sAccountingentity, @sStreamPlusProject,
                                            @sCalGroupCode, @sCalGroupOrg
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							--PREUPD_ORG portion here
							set @dUpdated = GetDate()

							--PREUPD2_ORG portion here
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end

					update R5ORGANIZATION set	ORG_CODE         =  @sCode,
												ORG_DESC         =  @sDesc,
												ORG_CURR         =  @sCurr,
								                ORG_COMMON       =  @sCommon,
												ORG_CODEREF      =  @sCoderef,
												ORG_BOOKID       =  @sBookid,
								                ORG_MATCHLTA     =  @nMatchlta,
												ORG_MATCHLTP     =  @nMatchltp,
												ORG_TIMEZONE     =  @nTimezone,
								                ORG_LATITUDE     =  @nLatitude,
												ORG_LONGITUDE    =  @nLongitude,
												ORG_EXTERNALORG  =  @sExternalorg,
								                ORG_INVQTYTOL    =  @nInvqtytol,
												ORG_DUNSNUM      =  @sDunsnum,
												ORG_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount,

												ORG_UPDATED      =  @dUpdated,
												ORG_DEPMETHOD    =  @sDepmethod,
												ORG_DEPRMETHOD   =  @sDeprmethod,
												ORG_LOCALE       =  @sLocale,
                                                ORG_SEGMENTVALUE = @sSegmentvalue,
                                                ORG_UDFCHAR01    = @sUdfchar01,
                                                ORG_UDFCHAR02    = @sUdfchar02,
                                                ORG_UDFCHAR03    = @sUdfchar03,

NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(2)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(2)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ORI_CODE, i.ORI_DESC, i.ORI_CLASS, i.ORI_CLASS_ORG , i.ORI_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.ORI_CODE, d.ORI_DESC, d.ORI_CLASS, d.ORI_CLASS_ORG , d.ORI_UPDATECOUNT,
													  i.ORI_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ORI_SQLIDENTITY = d.ORI_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'ORIG', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_ORI', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							--PREUPD2_ORI portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5ORIGINATORS set ORI_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, ORI_LASTSAVED = getdate() where ORI_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'ORIG', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'ORIG'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
											@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_ORP
on R5OPREPORTS
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nId            		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sName         		nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sOrg           		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sType          		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sTicket        		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sAudituser     		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dAudittimestamp		datetime        
	declare @nPublic				numeric(1,0)    
	declare @nUpdatecount   		numeric(38,0) 
	declare @sCreatedbyuser			nvarchar(255)
	declare @dLastuploadtime	datetime	     
	declare @nSqlidentity   		integer             

	declare @nOldId            	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sOldName         	nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sOldOrg           	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldType          	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldTicket        	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOldAudituser     	nvarchar(255)
	declare @nOldPublic			numeric(1,0)	        
	declare @sOldCreatedbyuser	nvarchar(255)      
	declare @dOldAudittimestamp	datetime
	declare @dOldLastuploadtime	datetime	            
	declare @nOldUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.ORP_ID,	i.ORP_NAME,	i.ORP_ORG,	i.ORP_TYPE,	i.ORP_TICKET,
													 	i.ORP_AUDITUSER,	i.ORP_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	i.ORP_PUBLIC, i.ORP_CREATEDBYUSER, i.ORP_LASTUPLOADTIME, i.ORP_UPDATECOUNT,	i.ORP_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.ORP_ID,	d.ORP_NAME,	d.ORP_ORG,	d.ORP_TYPE,	d.ORP_TICKET,
													  	d.ORP_AUDITUSER,	d.ORP_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	d.ORP_PUBLIC, d.ORP_CREATEDBYUSER, d.ORP_LASTUPLOADTIME, d.ORP_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.ORP_SQLIDENTITY = d.ORP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nId,	@sName,	@sOrg,	@sType,	@sTicket,
										   	@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,	@nPublic, @sCreatedbyuser, @dLastuploadtime, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@nOldId,	@sOldName,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldType,	@sOldTicket,
											@sOldAudituser,	@dOldAudittimestamp,	@nOldPublic, @sOldCreatedbyuser, @dOldLastuploadtime, @nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @dAudittimestamp = getdate()

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5OPREPORTS set	ORP_ID              =  @nId,	ORP_NAME           =  @sName,	ORP_ORG             =  @sOrg,
						                  	ORP_TYPE            =  @sType,	ORP_TICKET          =  @sTicket,	ORP_AUDITUSER       =  @sAudituser,
						                  	ORP_AUDITTIMESTAMP  =  @dAudittimestamp,	ORP_PUBLIC = @nPublic, ORP_CREATEDBYUSER = @sCreatedbyuser, 
						                  	ORP_LASTUPLOADTIME = @dLastuploadtime , ORP_UPDATECOUNT     =  @nUpdatecount, ORP_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where ORP_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nId,	@sName,	@sOrg,	@sType,	@sTicket,
												   	@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,	@nPublic, @sCreatedbyuser, @dLastuploadtime, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldId,	@sOldName,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldType,	@sOldTicket,
													@sOldAudituser,	@dOldAudittimestamp,	@nOldPublic, @sOldCreatedbyuser, @dOldLastuploadtime, @nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_ORS
on R5OBJRESOURCES
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sObject		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sResource		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sActive     		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCoolDownTime		numeric(18,2)
	declare @nWarmupTime		numeric(18,2)
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer

	declare @sOldObject		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldResource		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldActive		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nOldCoolDownTime	numeric(18,2)
	declare @nOldWarmupTime		numeric(18,2)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)
	declare @nreturn			int

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select  i.ORS_OBJECT, i.ORS_OBJECT_ORG, i.ORS_RESOURCE, i.ORS_COOLDOWNTIME, i.ORS_WARMUPTIME, i.ORS_ACTIVE,i.ORS_UPDATECOUNT,i.ORS_SQLIDENTITY,
								   d.ORS_OBJECT, d.ORS_OBJECT_ORG, d.ORS_RESOURCE, d.ORS_COOLDOWNTIME, d.ORS_WARMUPTIME, d.ORS_ACTIVE,d.ORS_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.ORS_SQLIDENTITY = d.ORS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource, @nCoolDowntime, @nWarmuptime, @sActive, @nUpdatecount,@nSqlidentity,
			                                @sOldObject, @sOldObjectOrg, @sOldResource, @nOldCoolDowntime, @nOldWarmuptime, @sOldActive, @nOldUpdatecount 
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
							
							--PREUPD2_ORS portion here
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end

					update R5OBJRESOURCES set ORS_OBJECT         =  @sObject,
					                          ORS_OBJECT_ORG     =  @sObjectOrg,
					                          ORS_RESOURCE       =  @sResource,
					                          ORS_COOLDOWNTIME   =  @nCoolDowntime,
					                          ORS_WARMUPTIME     =  @nWarmupTime,
					                          ORS_ACTIVE         =  @sActive,
					                          ORS_UPDATECOUNT    =  @nUpdatecount, 
					                          ORS_LASTSAVED      =  getdate()
					where ORS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

				fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource, @nCoolDowntime, @nWarmuptime, @sActive, @nUpdatecount,@nSqlidentity,
			                                        @sOldObject, @sOldObjectOrg, @sOldResource, @nOldCoolDowntime, @nOldWarmuptime, @sOldActive, @nUpdatecount 
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_ORT
on R5ORDERTERMS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sRtype				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sType				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ORT_CODE, i.ORT_ORG, i.ORT_DESC, i.ORT_RTYPE, i.ORT_TYPE, i.ORT_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.ORT_CODE, d.ORT_TYPE, d.ORT_UPDATECOUNT, i.ORT_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ORT_SQLIDENTITY = d.ORT_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sRtype,@sType, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldType, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode OR @sType <> @sOldType

								Begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_ORT', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5ORDERTERMS set ORT_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, ORT_LASTSAVED = getdate() where ORT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'ORDT', @sX, @sRtype, @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sRtype,@sType, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldType, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_OUD
on R5OBJUSAGEDEFS
for insert, update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @sObject			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sUOM				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nSinceInstall		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nSinceLastWork		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTotalUsage		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)
	declare @sNotlast			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldObject			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldUOM			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nOldSinceInstall	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldSinceLastWork	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldTotalUsage		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	numeric(38,0)
	declare @nNewUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)
	declare @dToday			datetime
	declare @nSqlIdentity	int

	declare @nDfltdailyusg		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCalcdailyusg		numeric(24,6)
	declare @dLastreaddate		datetime
	declare @nOldCalcdailyusg	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldDfltdailyusg	numeric(24,6)
	declare @dOldLastreaddate	datetime
	declare @sEvtcode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nReturn 			integer
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			set @dToday = GETDATE()
			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				--INSERTING
				begin
					declare c_inserted cursor local for select	OUD_OBJECT, OUD_UOM, OUD_OBJECT_ORG, OUD_SINCEINSTALL, OUD_SINCELASTWORK,
																OUD_TOTALUSAGE, OUD_UPDATECOUNT
															from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sObject, @sUOM, @sObjectOrg, @nSinceInstall, @nSinceLastWork, @nTotalUsage,
															@nUpdatecount
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									UPDATE r5objects
									SET    obj_updated = @dToday 
									WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
									AND    obj_org  = @sObjectOrg
									AND    obj_created < getdate() - 0.00003
																		
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sObject, @sUOM, @sObjectOrg, @nSinceInstall, @nSinceLastWork, @nTotalUsage,
																	@nUpdatecount
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
				end
			else
				--UPDATING
				begin
					EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.OUD_OBJECT, i.OUD_UOM, i.OUD_OBJECT_ORG, i.OUD_SINCEINSTALL,
																i.OUD_SINCELASTWORK, i.OUD_TOTALUSAGE, i.OUD_UPDATECOUNT,
																d.OUD_OBJECT, d.OUD_UOM, d.OUD_OBJECT_ORG, d.OUD_SINCEINSTALL,
																d.OUD_SINCELASTWORK, d.OUD_TOTALUSAGE, d.OUD_UPDATECOUNT, i.OUD_SQLIDENTITY,
																i.oud_dfltdailyusg, i.oud_calcdailyusg, i.oud_Lastreaddate,
																d.oud_dfltdailyusg, d.oud_calcdailyusg, d.oud_Lastreaddate,
																ISNULL( i.oud_notlast, N'-' )
															from inserted i, deleted d
															where i.OUD_SQLIDENTITY = d.OUD_SQLIDENTITY		

					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
							open c_ins_del 
							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sObject, @sUOM, @sObjectOrg, @nSinceInstall, @nSinceLastWork, @nTotalUsage,
															@nUpdatecount, @sOldObject, @sOldUOM, @sOldObjectOrg, @nOldSinceInstall,
															@nOldSinceLastWork, @nOldTotalUsage, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity,
															@nDfltdailyusg, @nCalcdailyusg, @dLastreaddate,
															@nOldDfltdailyusg, @nOldCalcdailyusg, @dOldLastreaddate,
															@sNotlast

							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									-- A21200 - Object, UOM is not updateable
									if @sObject <> @sOldObject or @sObjectOrg <> @sOldObjectOrg
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_OUD', N'TRIG', 2
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
										begin
											if @sUOM      <> @sOldUOM
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_OUD', N'TRIG', 3
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end

									/* A21210 - Calculate usage since last install and since last work. */
                                    IF ( @sNotlast = N'-' OR  @sNotlast = N'I' )
										begin
											if  @nSinceInstall <> 0 OR @nOldSinceInstall  = 0 
												begin
													set @nSinceInstall = coalesce( @nOldSinceInstall, 0 ) + ( coalesce( @nTotalUsage, 0 ) - coalesce( @nOldTotalUsage, 0 )) 
													if @nSinceInstall < 0 
														set @nSinceInstall = 0
												end
                                        end
									
                                    IF ( @sNotlast = N'-' OR  @sNotlast = N'W' )
                                         BEGIN
											if  @nSinceLastWork <> 0 OR @nOldSinceLastWork = 0			
												begin
													set @nSinceLastWork =  coalesce( @nOldSinceLastWork, 0 ) + ( coalesce( @nTotalUsage, 0 ) - coalesce( @nOldTotalUsage, 0 ) ) 
													if @nSinceLastWork < 0 
														set @nSinceLastWork = 0
												end
										end
									
									if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull(@nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
										set @nNewUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
									else
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

                                    UPDATE R5OBJUSAGEDEFS 
                                    SET    OUD_SINCEINSTALL  = @nSinceInstall,
                                           OUD_SINCELASTWORK = @nSinceLastWork,
                                           OUD_UPDATECOUNT   = @nNewUpdatecount,
                                           OUD_UPDATED       = GetDate(),
                                           OUD_NOTLAST       = '-'  -- reset it back
                                    WHERE  OUD_SQLIDENTITY   = @nSqlIdentity

									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									UPDATE r5objects
									SET    obj_updated = @dToday 
									WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
									AND    obj_org  = @sObjectOrg

									IF ( ISNULL( @dOldLastreaddate, @dToday + 10000 ) <> 
									  ISNULL( @dLastreaddate, @dToday + 10000 ) OR
									  ISNULL( @nOldDfltdailyusg, -1 ) <> ISNULL( @nDfltdailyusg, -1 ) OR
									  ISNULL( @nOldCalcdailyusg, -1 ) <> ISNULL( @nCalcdailyusg, -1 ) OR
									  ISNULL( @nOldTotalusage,   -1 ) <> ISNULL( @nTotalusage,   -1 ) )
									    begin
										declare c_evt cursor local for 
										SELECT evt_code
										FROM   r5events
										WHERE  evt_rstatus    = N'A'
										AND    evt_object     = @sObject 
										AND    evt_object_org = @sObjectOrg
										AND    evt_mp IS NOT NULL
										AND  ( evt_metuom = @sUOM OR evt_metuom2 = @sUOM )
										AND  ( evt_meterdue IS NOT NULL OR evt_meterdue2 IS NOT NULL )

										open c_evt 
										fetch next from c_evt into @sEvtcode
										while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
										    begin
										       /* Call o7mpduedates to calculate some date fields. */
										       set @nTotalusage = COALESCE( @nTotalusage, 0 )
										       EXECUTE @nReturn = o7mpduedates @sEvtcode, @sUOM, @nDfltdailyusg, @nCalcdailyusg, @nTotalusage
										       fetch next from c_evt into @sEvtcode
										    end
										close c_evt
										deallocate c_evt
									    end													
									fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sObject, @sUOM, @sObjectOrg, @nSinceInstall, @nSinceLastWork, @nTotalUsage,
															@nUpdatecount, @sOldObject, @sOldUOM, @sOldO

													  d.PBC_CODE, d.PBC_DESC, d.PBC_CLASS, d.PBC_CLASS_ORG , d.PBC_UPDATECOUNT, i.PBC_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.PBC_SQLIDENTITY = d.PBC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @nCountit = 0
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PBUD', @sCode, @sX, N'DET', @sX, N'*', @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCountit > 0
								begin
									If @sClass <> @sOldClass
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PREPBC N'UPD', @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPBC', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5PROJBUDCODES set PBC_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, PBC_LASTSAVED = getdate() where PBC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'PBUD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PCL
on R5PROJBUDCLASSES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sProject		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sProjbud		nvarchar(20)
	declare @nAmount		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldProject		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldProjbud		nvarchar(20)

	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)	


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.pcl_project, i.pcl_projbud, i.pcl_amount, i.PCL_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.pcl_project, d.pcl_projbud,  d.PCL_UPDATECOUNT, i.PCL_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.PCL_SQLIDENTITY = d.PCL_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'1'
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sProject, @sProjbud, @nAmount,@nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldProject, @sOldProjbud, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @sProject <> @sOldProject  OR @sProjbud <> @sOldProjbud
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							execute @nReturn = O7PREPCL N'UPD', @sProject, @sProjbud, @nAmount, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPCL', N'PROC',@sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update R5PROJBUDCLASSES set PCL_UPDATED = GetDate() where PCL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--PREUPD2_PCL portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5PROJBUDCLASSES set PCL_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where PCL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--XMLOUT_POSINSUPD_PCL
							set @sFlag = N'N'

							SELECT @sFlag = coalesce(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE =	N'@SYNCPRJ'

							IF @sFlag = N'Y' 
								begin

									SELECT @nCount = COUNT(*) FROM R5PROJECTS WHERE (PRJ_RSTATUS = N'O'
																AND PRJ_SOURCESYSTEM IS NULL 
																AND PRJ_CODE = @sProject)
									IF (@nCount > 0)  
										begin
											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											SELECT @sOrg = PRJ_ORG FROM R5PROJECTS WHERE PRJ_CODE = @sProject
											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS (XTS_TRANTYPE, XTS_TABLE, XTS_KEYFLD1, XTS_ORG, XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
											VALUES(N'SYNCPRJ', N'R5PROJECTS', @sProject, @sOrg, @sTempMsgid			)
										end
								end
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sProject, @sProjbud, @nAmount,@nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldProject, @sOldProjbud, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_PEQ
  ON r5patternequipment
  INSTEAD OF UPDATE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sUser           NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @sMp             NVARCHAR(30) 
  DECLARE @sMp_org         NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @nRevision       NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sObject         NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObject_org     NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sOrg            NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sStatus         NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @sMrc            NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sLocation       NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sLocation_org   NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sCostcode       NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sPerson         NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @dDeactive       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dDormstart      DATETIME
  DECLARE @dDormend        DATETIME
  DECLARE @sDormreuse      NVARCHAR(1)
  DECLARE @sSchedgrp       NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sSet            NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @dCreated        DATETIME
  DECLARE @dUpdated        DATETIME
  DECLARE @nIdentity       INTEGER
  DECLARE @sRoute          NVARCHAR(20)
  DECLARE @nReturn         INT
  DECLARE @sInobjectupdate NVARCHAR(10)
  DECLARE @sIncludeNonconformities     NVARCHAR(1)
  DECLARE @sDueNonconformitiesOnly     NVARCHAR(1)

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT peq_mp, peq_mp_org, peq_revision, peq_object, peq_object_org, peq_org,
             peq_status, peq_mrc, peq_location, peq_location_org, peq_costcode,
             peq_person, peq_deactive, peq_dormstart, peq_dormend, peq_dormreuse, 
             peq_schedgrp, peq_set, peq_created, peq_updated, peq_sqlidentity, peq_route,
             peq_includenonconformities, peq_duenonconformitiesonly
      FROM   INSERTED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO 
                @sMp, @sMp_org, @nRevision, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sOrg,
                @sStatus, @sMrc, @sLocation, @sLocation_org, @sCostcode,
                @sPerson, @dDeactive, @dDormstart, @dDormend, @sDormreuse, 
                @sSchedgrp, @sSet, @dCreated, @dUpdated, @nIdentity, @sRoute,
                @sIncludeNonconformities, @sDueNonconformitiesOnly
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN

              IF @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                SET @dUpdated = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )

              UPDATE r5patternequipment
              SET    peq_mp           = @sMp, 
                     peq_mp_org       = @sMp_org, 
                     peq_revision     = @nRevision, 
                     peq_object       = @sObject, 
                     peq_object_org   = @sObject_org, 
                     peq_org          = @sOrg,
                     peq_status       = @sStatus, 
                     peq_mrc          = @sMrc, 
                     peq_location     = @sLocation, 
                     peq_location_org = @sLocation_org, 
                     peq_costcode     = @sCostcode,
                     peq_person       = @sPerson, 
                     peq_deactive     = @dDeactive, 
                     peq_dormstart    = @dDormstart,
                     peq_dormend      = @dDormend,
                     peq_dormreuse    = @sDormreuse, 
                     peq_schedgrp     = @sSchedgrp, 
                     peq_set          = @sSet, 
                     peq_created      = @dCreated, 
                     peq_updated      = @dUpdated,
                     peq_route		  = @sRoute,
                     peq_includenonconformities = @sIncludeNonconformities,
                     peq_duenonconformitiesonly = @sDueNonconformitiesOnly
              WHERE  peq_sqlidentity  = @nIdentity

              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO  
                    @sMp, @sMp_org, @nRevision, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sOrg,
                    @sStatus, @sMrc, @sLocation, @sLocation_org, @sCostcode,
                    @sPerson, @dDeactive, @dDormstart, @dDormend, @sDormreuse, 
                    @sSchedgrp, @sSet, @dCreated, @dUpdated, @nIdentity, @sRoute,
                    @sIncludeNonconformities, @sDueNonconformitiesOnly
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

create trigger PREUPD_PET
on R5PERTYPES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sPerson			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sType				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @sOldPerson			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PET_PERSON, i.PET_TYPE, i.PET_UPDATECOUNT,
														d.PET_PERSON, d.PET_TYPE, d.PET_UPDATECOUNT
												from	inserted i, deleted d
											   where	i.PET_SQLIDENTITY = d.PET_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sPerson, @sType, @nUpdatecount, @sOldPerson, @sOldType, @nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

									update r5pertypes set pet_updatecount = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1) + 1, PET_LASTSAVED = getdate()

									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del

									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_PFE
ON r5prefilterlookup
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT pfe_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5prefilterlookup
          SET    pfe_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  pfe_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

CREATE FUNCTION PREUPD_PFV_GET_CHILD_HIERARCHY ( @sParent nvarchar(30), @sParentorg nvarchar(15) )
RETURNS @tReturn TABLE( stc_child  nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_child_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_parent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_parent_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  )
AS
BEGIN
   DECLARE @nLevel         int
   DECLARE @sChild         nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @sChildorg      nvarchar(15)

   DECLARE @tStack TABLE ( stc_child nvarchar(30),
                           stc_child_org nvarchar(15),
                           stc_parent nvarchar(30),
                           stc_parent_org nvarchar(15),
                           LevelID int )

   INSERT INTO @tStack
      SELECT stc_child,
             stc_child_org,
             stc_parent,
             stc_parent_org,
             1
         FROM r5structures
         WHERE	stc_parent = @sParent
         AND   stc_parent_org = @sParentorg

   SET @nLevel = 1

   WHILE( @nLevel > 0 )
      BEGIN
         IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
            BEGIN
               SELECT @sChild = stc_child,
                       @sChildorg = stc_child_org,
                       @sParent = stc_parent,
                       @sParentorg = stc_parent_org
                  FROM	@tStack
                  WHERE LevelID = @nLevel
               INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES ( @sChild, @sChildorg, @sParent, @sParentorg )
               DELETE FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sChild AND stc_child_org = @sChildorg
               INSERT INTO @tStack	SELECT stc_child,
                                           stc_child_org,
                                           stc_parent,
                                           stc_parent_org,
                                           @nLevel + 1
                                       FROM r5structures
                                       WHERE	stc_parent = @sChild
                                       AND   stc_parent_org = @sChildorg
               IF( @@ROWCOUNT > 0 )
                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
            END
         ELSE
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      END

   RETURN
END

create trigger PREUPD_PMP
on R5PPMPLAN
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(6)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sObjectClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sObjectClassOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(6)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.PMP_CODE, i.PMP_ORG, i.PMP_DESC, i.PMP_CLASS, i.PMP_CLASS_ORG , i.PMP_OBJECTCLASS, i.PMP_OBJECTCLASS_ORG, i.PMP_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.PMP_CODE, d.PMP_ORG, d.PMP_DESC, d.PMP_CLASS, d.PMP_CLASS_ORG , d.PMP_UPDATECOUNT, i.PMP_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.PMP_SQLIDENTITY = d.PMP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sObjectClass, @sObjectClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode OR @sOrg <> @sOldOrg
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PPMP', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_PMP', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							If @sObjectClass is not null 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sObjectClass, @sObjectClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_PMP', N'TRIG', 2
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5PPMPLAN set PMP_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, PMP_LASTSAVED = getdate() where PMP_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'PPMP', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'PPMP'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sObjectClass, 
											@sObjectClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, 
											@sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

							if @sPrompt <> @sOldPrompt OR  @sAspect <> @sOldAspect
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 900
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							If @sPrompt IS NULL OR @sAspect IS NULL
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'PROC', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							If @sOldCode IS NULL 
								begin
									If @sCode IS NOT NULL 
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PROMPT', N'PAC', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
   
							If  @sOldCode IS NULL  
								begin
									If coalesce(@sValue, 'NULL') <>  coalesce(@sOldValue, 'NULL') OR
									coalesce(@dDvalue, @dDate) <>  coalesce(@dOldDvalue, @dDate) OR
									coalesce(@nNvalue, 0) <>  coalesce(@nOldNvalue, 0)
     									begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'PROC', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
							   end

							set @dUpdated = getdate()

						end
					update R5PROMPTVALUES set	PMV_PROMPT       =  @sPrompt,	PMV_ASPECT       =  @sAspect,	PMV_CODE         =  @sCode,
						                     	PMV_SEQNO        =  @nSeqno,	PMV_VALUE        =  @sValue,	PMV_NVALUE       =  @nNvalue,
						                     	PMV_DVALUE       =  @dDvalue,	PMV_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, PMV_UPDATED   =  @dUpdated
						where PMV_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sPrompt,	@sAspect,	@sCode,	@nSeqno,	@sValue,
												   	@nNvalue,	@dDvalue,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldPrompt,	@sOldAspect,	@sOldCode,	@nOldSeqno,	@sOldValue,
													@nOldNvalue,	@dOldDvalue,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_POI
on R5POINTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sObject      		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sObrtype     		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sObtype      		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sPoint       		nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sDesc        		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sPointtype   		nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sObject_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 		integer   
	declare @sOldObject      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldObrtype     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldObtype      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldPoint       	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sOldDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldPointtype   	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sOldObject_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nOldSqlidentity 	integer    
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for
				select	i.poi_object,      d.poi_object,
						i.poi_obrtype,     d.poi_obrtype,
						i.poi_obtype,      d.poi_obtype,
						i.poi_point,       d.poi_point,
						i.poi_desc,        d.poi_desc,
						i.poi_pointtype,   d.poi_pointtype,
						i.poi_object_org,  d.poi_object_org,
						i.poi_updatecount, d.poi_updatecount,
						i.poi_sqlidentity, d.poi_sqlidentity
					from inserted i, deleted d 
					where i.poi_sqlidentity = d.poi_sqlidentity

			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 
						 @sObject, @sOldObject,
						 @sObrtype, @sOldObrtype,
						 @sObtype, @sOldObtype,
						 @sPoint, @sOldPoint,
						 @sDesc, @sOldDesc,
						 @sPointtype, @sOldPointtype,
						 @sObject_org, @sOldObject_org,
						 @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount,
						 @nSqlidentity, @nOldSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF(( @sObject     <> @sOldObject )
							OR(  @sObject_org <> @sOldObject_org )
							OR(  @sObtype     <> @sOldObtype )
							OR(  @sObrtype    <> @sOldObrtype )
							OR(  @sPointtype  <> @sOldPointtype )
							OR(  @sPoint      <> @sOldPoint )) 
   								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update R5POINTS set POI_UPDATED = GetDate() where POI_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5POINTS set POI_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where POI_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 
								 @sObject, @sOldObject,
								 @sObrtype, @sOldObrtype,
								 @sObtype, @sOldObtype,
								 @sPoint, @sOldPoint,
								 @sDesc, @sOldDesc,
								 @sPointtype, @sOldPointtype,
								 @sObject_org, @sOldObject_org,
								 @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount,
								 @nSqlidentity, @nOldSqlidentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PPA
on R5PPMACTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sPPM				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nAct				numeric(8)
	declare @sTrade				nvarchar(15)
	declare @nDuration			numeric(8)
	declare @nStart				numeric(3)
	declare @nRevision			numeric(4)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(100)--r5descriptions.des_code%TYPE;
	declare @sOldPPM			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nOldAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sOldTrade			nvarchar(15)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ppa_ppm, i.ppa_act, i.ppa_trade, i.ppa_duration, i.ppa_start, i.ppa_revision, i.PPA_UPDATECOUNT, d.ppa_ppm, d.ppa_act, d.ppa_trade, d.PPA_UPDATECOUNT, i.PPA_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.PPA_SQLIDENTITY = d.PPA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sPPM, @nAct, @sTrade, @nDuration, @nStart, @nRevision, @nUpdatecount,@sOldPPM, @nOldAct, @sOldTrade, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							/* W192  -  Update of Reading not allowed */
							--preupd_ppa section
							/* W16211 : PPM, Act. No, Trade not updatable  */
							IF @sPPM   <> @sOldPPM    OR @nAct   <> @nOldAct
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							/* W16223 : Call to o7preppa procedure  */
							execute @nReturn = O7PREPPA N'UPD', @sPPM, @nRevision, @nDuration, @nStart, @sCheckresult Output
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPPA', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							--preupd2_ppa section
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5PPMACTS set PPA_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, PPA_LASTSAVED = getdate() where PPA_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sPPM, @nAct, @sTrade, @nDuration, @nStart, @nRevision, @nUpdatecount,@sOldPPM, @nOldAct, @sOldTrade, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PQU
on R5PERSONNELQUALIFICATIONS
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sFlag       nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTempMsgid  nvarchar(256)
	declare @nCount		 int
	declare @nReturn	 int
	declare @sCode		 nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg		 nvarchar(15)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.PQU_UPDATECOUNT, d.PQU_UPDATECOUNT, i.PQU_SQLIDENTITY, i.PQU_PERSON
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.PQU_SQLIDENTITY = d.PQU_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							update R5PERSONNELQUALIFICATIONS set pqu_updated = GetDate() where PQU_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5PERSONNELQUALIFICATIONS set pqu_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where PQU_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

			/* START Personnel Outbound EAM-798 */

			select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCPER'
			if @nCount > 0
				select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCPER'
			else
				set @sFlag = N'N'

				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						close c_inserted
						deallocate c_inserted
						rollback transaction
						return
					end
			if @sFlag = N'Y'
				begin
				select @sOrg = PER_ORG from  R5PERSONNEL WHERE PER_CODE = @sCode
					INSERT INTO r5xmltranstatus(
						xts_trantype,
						xts_table,
						xts_keyfld1,
						xts_keyfld2,
						xts_orig_messageid,
						xts_org  )
						VALUES(
						 N'SYNCPERS',
						 N'R5PERSONNEL',
						 @sCode,
						 @sOrg,
						 @sTempMsgid,
						 @sOrg )
				end
			/* END Personnel Outbound EAM-798 */

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

          SET    pra_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  pra_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd

	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPermit		nvarchar(12)
	declare @sEntity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(50)
	declare @sRType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMand			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nUpdateCount	int
	declare @sOldPermit		nvarchar(12)
	declare @sOldEntity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldRentity	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCode		nvarchar(50)
	declare @sOldRType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldMand		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity	int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PRE_PERMIT, i.PRE_ENTITY, i.PRE_RENTITY, i.PRE_TYPE, i.PRE_RTYPE, i.PRE_CODE, i.PRE_MAND, i.PRE_UPDATECOUNT,
														d.PRE_PERMIT, d.PRE_ENTITY, d.PRE_RENTITY, d.PRE_TYPE, d.PRE_RTYPE, d.PRE_CODE, d.PRE_MAND, d.PRE_UPDATECOUNT, i.pre_SQLIDENTITY
													  from	inserted i, deleted d
													where	i.pre_SQLIDENTITY		=	d.pre_SQLIDENTITY

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sPermit, @sEntity, @sRentity, @sType, @sRType, @sCode, @sMand, @nUpdateCount,
													@sOldPermit, @sOldEntity, @sOldRentity, @sOldType, @sOldRType, @sOldCode, @sOldMand, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sEntity		<> @sOldEntity	OR
							   @sRentity	<> @sOldRentity	OR
							   @sType		<> @sOldType Or
								@sRType		<> @sOldRType OR
								@sCode		<> @sOldCode OR
								@sPermit	<> @sOldPermit
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								if isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1 ) = isnull(@nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
									update R5PERMENTITIES set PRE_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1) + 1 where PRE_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
								else
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sPermit, @sEntity, @sRentity, @sType, @sRType, @sCode, @sMand, @nUpdateCount,
															@sOldPermit, @sOldEntity, @sOldRentity, @sOldType, @sOldRType, @sOldCode, @sOldMand, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PRI
on R5PRICECODES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.PRI_CODE, i.PRI_DESC, i.PRI_CLASS, i.PRI_CLASS_ORG , i.PRI_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.PRI_CODE, d.PRI_DESC, d.PRI_CLASS, d.PRI_CLASS_ORG , d.PRI_UPDATECOUNT, i.PRI_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.PRI_SQLIDENTITY = d.PRI_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @nCountit = 0
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end



								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PRIC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_PRI', N'TRIG', 8
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5PRICECODES set PRI_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, PRI_LASTSAVED = getdate() where PRI_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'PRIC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (@sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg<> Coalesce(@sClassOrg ,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'PRIC'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PRM
on R5PERMISSIONS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sFunction			nvarchar(6)
	declare @sSelect			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sUpdate			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sInsert			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDelete			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sGroup				nvarchar(12)
	declare @sOldFunction		nvarchar(6)
	declare @sOldGroup			nvarchar(12)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nSQLIdentity		int
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.PRM_FUNCTION, i.PRM_SELECT, i.PRM_UPDATE, i.PRM_INSERT, i.PRM_DELETE, i.PRM_GROUP,
														d.PRM_FUNCTION, d.PRM_GROUP, i.PRM_UPDATECOUNT, d.PRM_UPDATECOUNT, i.PRM_SQLIDENTITY
												   from inserted i, deleted d
												  where	i.PRM_SQLIDENTITY = d.PRM_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sFunction, @sSelect, @sUpdate, @sInsert, @sDelete, @sGroup, @sOldFunction, @sOldGroup, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSQLIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							if @sFunction <> @sOldFunction OR @sGroup <> @sOldGroup
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PREPRM N'UPD', @sFunction, @sSelect, @sUpdate, @sInsert, @sDelete, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPRM', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update r5permissions set prm_updated = GetDate()
							  where PRM_SQLIDENTITY	= @nSQLIdentity
							
							if coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1)
									update r5permissions set prm_updatecount = coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
									  where PRM_SQLIDENTITY	= @nSQLIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1'
									rollback transaction
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sFunction, @sSelect, @sUpdate, @sInsert, @sDelete, @sGroup, @sOldFunction, @sOldGroup, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSQLIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PRO
on R5PROPERTIES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sType				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMin				nvarchar(25)
	declare @sMax				nvarchar(25)
	declare @sText				nvarchar(25)
	declare @sOldText				nvarchar(25)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @dUpdated			datetime

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PRO_CODE, d.PRO_CODE, i.PRO_TYPE, d.PRO_TYPE, 
														i.PRO_MIN, i.PRO_MAX, i.PRO_TEXT,
														i.PRO_UPDATECOUNT, d.PRO_UPDATECOUNT, i.PRO_SQLIDENTITY, i.PRO_UPDATED, d.PRO_TEXT
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.PRO_SQLIDENTITY = d.PRO_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOldCode, @sType, @sOldType, @sMin, @sMax, @sText, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @dUpdated, @sOldText
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sCode <> @sOldCode OR @sType <> @sOldType
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end 

							if @dUpdated <> dbo.to_date(N'19121960', N'DDMMYYYY')
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7PROP_PREPRO N'UPD', @sCode, @sType, @sMin, @sMax
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							update R5PROPERTIES set PRO_UPDATED = GetDate() where PRO_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5PROPERTIES set PRO_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where PRO_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							if @sText <> @sOldText
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', NULL, N'PROM', NULL, N'*', @sCode, NULL, @sText, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							--posupd2_pro
								/* Only need to update cache if the current custom field is
								associated with star/star class*/

								update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
								where exists (select N'x' from r5addproperties where pgc_rentity=apr_rentity
								and APR_PROPERTY=@sCode and apr_class=N'*' and apr_class_org =(select ins_desc from r5install where ins_code=N'DEFORG'))
								and pgc_tabname=N'HDR'

								/* Updating cache for List view for current custom field
								associated with any class */

								update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
								where exists (select N'x' from r5addproperties where pgc_rentity=apr_rentity
								and APR_PROPERTY=@sCode and exists (select N'x' from r5classes where apr_rentity = cls_entity 
																	and apr_class = cls_code and apr_class_org = cls_org))
								and pgc_tabname=N'LST' 

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOldCode, @sType, @sOldType, @sMin, @sMax, @sText, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @dUpdated, @sOldText
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PRT
on R5PERMITS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @nLength			numeric(3)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
    declare @sKeyCode           nvarchar(40)
    declare @nRevision          int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.PRT_CODE, i.PRT_ORG, i.PRT_DESC, i.PRT_CLASS, i.PRT_CLASS_ORG , i.PRT_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.PRT_CODE, d.PRT_ORG, d.PRT_DESC, d.PRT_CLASS, d.PRT_CLASS_ORG , d.PRT_UPDATECOUNT, i.PRT_SQLIDENTITY, 
													  i.PRT_REVISION
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.PRT_SQLIDENTITY = d.PRT_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @nRevision
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							-- preupd_tsk portion
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								/* W13321 : Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = 'PERM' ) */
								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PERM', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_PRT', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							--PREUPD2_PRT portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5PERMITS set PRT_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where PRT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSUPD_PRT portion
							/* W1334 - Update descriptions (r5descriptions)   */
							set @sKeyCode = @sCode + '#' + CAST(@nRevision AS nvarchar(4))
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'PERM', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							/* W1313 - If class is updated then remove property values of old class */
							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass <> Coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg) ) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'PERM'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode 
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @nRevision
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end
