create trigger PREUPD_PRV
on R5PROPERTYVALUES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sProperty		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldProperty		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(100)
	declare @sOldCode		nvarchar(100)
	declare @nSeqno			numeric(38)
	declare @sValue			nvarchar(40)
	declare	@nValue			numeric(24,6)
	declare @dValue			datetime
	declare @sOldValue		nvarchar(40)
	declare	@nOldValue		numeric(24,6)
	declare @dOldValue		datetime
	declare @sAudit			nvarchar(1)	--r5entities.ent_caaudit%TYPE
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCoalesced		nvarchar(255)
	declare @sOldCoalesced		nvarchar(255)
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount 	int
	declare @nUpdateCount		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		bigint
	declare @sType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sFormdat		nvarchar(200)
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PRV_PROPERTY,	d.PRV_PROPERTY,
														i.PRV_RENTITY,	d.PRV_RENTITY,
														i.PRV_CLASS,	d.PRV_CLASS,
														i.PRV_CODE,		d.PRV_CODE,
														i.PRV_SEQNO,
														i.PRV_VALUE,	d.PRV_VALUE,
														i.PRV_NVALUE,	d.PRV_NVALUE,
														i.PRV_DVALUE,	d.PRV_DVALUE,
														i.PRV_UPDATECOUNT, d.PRV_UPDATECOUNT,
														i.PRV_SQLIDENTITY
												   from inserted i, deleted d
												  where	i.PRV_SQLIDENTITY = d.PRV_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sProperty, @sOldProperty, @sRentity, @sOldRentity,
													@sClass, @sOldClass, @sCode, @sOldCode, @nSeqno,
													@sValue, @sOldValue, @nValue, @nOldValue, @dValue,
													@dOldValue, @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sProperty	<> @sOldProperty	OR
							   @sRentity	<> @sOldRentity		OR
							   @sClass		<> @sOldClass
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 900
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PROP_PREPRV N'UPD', @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sCode, @sOldCode, @nSeqno, @sValue, @sOldValue, @nValue, @nOldValue, @dValue, @dOldValue
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5PROPERTYVALUES set PRV_UPDATED = GetDate(), PRV_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1) + 1 where PRV_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @dOldValue is not null or @dValue is not null
								begin
									select @sType = pro_type from r5properties where pro_code = @sOldProperty
									if @sType = N'DATE'
										set @sFormdat = isnull(dbo.o7dflt2(N'FORMDATE'), N'DD-MON-RRRR')
									else
										set @sFormdat = isnull(dbo.o7dflt2(N'FORMDATI'), N'DD-MON-RRRR HH24:MI:SS')
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							SELECT @sAudit = coalesce( ent_caaudit, N'-' )
							  FROM r5entities
							 WHERE ent_rentity = @sOldRentity

							if @sAudit = N'+' and @sOldCode is not null
								begin
									set @sOldCoalesced = coalesce( @sOldValue, coalesce( cast(@nOldValue as nvarchar), dbo.f_date_to_char(@dOldValue, @sFormdat) ) )
									set @sCoalesced = coalesce( @sValue, coalesce( cast(@nValue as nvarchar), dbo.f_date_to_char(@dValue, @sFormdat) ) )
									set @sConcat = @sRentity + N' ' + @sCode
									execute @nReturn = O7AUDIT 0, N'UPDATE', N'R5PROPERTYVALUES', @sOldCoalesced, @sCoalesced, @sProperty, @sConcat, @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							--Reset work order esignature information
							if @sRentity = N'EVNT'
							begin
								DELETE FROM r5eventsignature WHERE ets_event = @sCode and ets_updatecount <> -999
							end								
							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sProperty, @sOldProperty, @sRentity, @sOldRentity,
															@sClass, @sOldClass, @sCode, @sOldCode, @nSeqno,
															@sValue, @sOldValue, @nValue, @nOldValue, @dValue,
															@dOldValue, @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PSL
on R5PACKINGSLIP
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sDock       		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nLine       		numeric(8,0)
	declare @sOrder      		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOrdline    		numeric(8,0)
	declare @sOrder_org  		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPart       		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPart_org   		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sManlot     		nvarchar(24)
	declare @dManlotexp  		datetime
	declare @sSupplierref		nvarchar(50)
	declare @sDeluom     		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nDelqty     		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRecvqty    		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nMultiply   		numeric(10,4)
	declare @sComment    		nvarchar(45)
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer

	declare @sOldDock       	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldLine       	numeric(8,0)
	declare @sOldOrder      	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldOrdline    	numeric(8,0)
	declare @sOldOrder_org  	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldPart       	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldPart_org   	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldManlot     	nvarchar(24)
	declare @dOldManlotexp  	datetime
	declare @sOldSupplierref	nvarchar(50)
	declare @sOldDeluom     	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldDelqty     	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldRecvqty    	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldMultiply   	numeric(10,4)
	declare @sOldComment    	nvarchar(45)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PSL_DOCK,	i.PSL_LINE,	i.PSL_ORDER,	i.PSL_ORDLINE,	i.PSL_ORDER_ORG,
													  	i.PSL_PART,	i.PSL_PART_ORG,	i.PSL_MANLOT,	i.PSL_MANLOTEXP,	i.PSL_SUPPLIERREF,
													  	i.PSL_DELUOM,	i.PSL_DELQTY,	i.PSL_RECVQTY,	i.PSL_MULTIPLY,	i.PSL_COMMENT,
													 	i.PSL_UPDATECOUNT,	i.PSL_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.PSL_DOCK,	d.PSL_LINE,	d.PSL_ORDER,	d.PSL_ORDLINE,	d.PSL_ORDER_ORG,
													  	d.PSL_PART,	d.PSL_PART_ORG,	d.PSL_MANLOT,	d.PSL_MANLOTEXP,	d.PSL_SUPPLIERREF,
													  	d.PSL_DELUOM,	d.PSL_DELQTY,	d.PSL_RECVQTY,	d.PSL_MULTIPLY,	d.PSL_COMMENT,
													  	d.PSL_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.PSL_SQLIDENTITY = d.PSL_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sDock,	@nLine,	@sOrder,	@nOrdline,	@sOrder_org,
										   	@sPart,	@sPart_org,	@sManlot,	@dManlotexp,	@sSupplierref,
										   	@sDeluom,	@nDelqty,	@nRecvqty,	@nMultiply,	@sComment,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldDock,	@nOldLine,	@sOldOrder,	@nOldOrdline,	@sOldOrder_org,
											@sOldPart,	@sOldPart_org,	@sOldManlot,	@dOldManlotexp,	@sOldSupplierref,
											@sOldDeluom,	@nOldDelqty,	@nOldRecvqty,	@nOldMultiply,	@sOldComment,
											@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							execute @nReturn = O7PREPSL N'UPD', @sOrder, @nOrdline, @sOrder_org, @sDock, @nLine, @sPart, @sPart_org, @nDelqty, @nRecvqty,@sX
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPSL', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							UPDATE r5orderlines
							SET    orl_dckrecvqty = orl_dckrecvqty + @nRecvqty - @nOldRecvqty
							WHERE  orl_order      = @sOrder
							AND    orl_ordline    = @nOrdline
							AND    orl_order_org  = @sOrder_org
							AND    orl_part       = @sPart
							AND    orl_part_org   = @sPart_org

						end
					update R5PACKINGSLIP set	PSL_DOCK         =  @sDock,	PSL_LINE         =  @nLine,	PSL_ORDER        =  @sOrder,
								                PSL_ORDLINE      =  @nOrdline,	PSL_ORDER_ORG    =  @sOrder_org,	PSL_PART         =  @sPart,
								                PSL_PART_ORG     =  @sPart_org,	PSL_MANLOT       =  @sManlot,	PSL_MANLOTEXP    =  @dManlotexp,
								                PSL_SUPPLIERREF  =  @sSupplierref,	PSL_DELUOM       =  @sDeluom,	PSL_DELQTY       =  @nDelqty,
								                PSL_RECVQTY      =  @nRecvqty,	PSL_MULTIPLY     =  @nMultiply,	PSL_COMMENT      =  @sComment,
								                PSL_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, PSL_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where PSL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sDock,	@nLine,	@sOrder,	@nOrdline,	@sOrder_org,
													@sPart,	@sPart_org,	@sManlot,	@dManlotexp,	@sSupplierref,
													@sDeluom,	@nDelqty,	@nRecvqty,	@nMultiply,	@sComment,
													@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldDock,	@nOldLine,	@sOldOrder,	@nOldOrdline,	@sOldOrder_org,
													@sOldPart,	@sOldPart_org,	@sOldManlot,	@dOldManlotexp,	@sOldSupplierref,
													@sOldDeluom,	@nOldDelqty,	@nOldRecvqty,	@nOldMultiply,	@sOldComment,
													@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_PTP
on R5POINTTYPES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode        	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer             
	declare @sOldCode        	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sOldDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nOldSqlidentity 	integer 
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn			int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select 
						   i.ptp_code,        d.ptp_code,
						   i.ptp_desc,        d.ptp_desc,
						   i.ptp_class,       d.ptp_class,
						   i.ptp_class_org,   d.ptp_class_org,
						   i.ptp_updatecount, d.ptp_updatecount,
						   i.ptp_sqlidentity, d.ptp_sqlidentity
					from inserted i, deleted d 
					where i.ptp_sqlidentity = d.ptp_sqlidentity


			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 
						 @sCode, @sOldCode,
						 @sDesc, @sOldDesc,
						 @sClass, @sOldClass,
						 @sClass_org, @sOldClass_org,
						 @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount,
						 @nSqlidentity, @nOldSqlidentity

 					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End


								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClass_org <> Coalesce(@sOldClass_org,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PNTP', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_PTP', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							update R5POINTTYPES set PTP_UPDATED = GetDate() where PTP_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5POINTTYPES set PTP_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where PTP_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'PNTP', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( coalesce(@sOldClass,N'*') <> coalesce(@sClass, N'*') OR coalesce(@sOldClass_org,@sDeforg) <> Coalesce(@sClass_org,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'PNTP'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END



							fetch next from c_ins_del into 
								 @sCode, @sOldCode,
								 @sDesc, @sOldDesc,
								 @sClass, @sOldClass,
								 @sClass_org, @sOldClass_org,
								 @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount,
								 @nSqlidentity, @nOldSqlidentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_PWR
ON r5wsrequiredfields
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT pwr_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5wsrequiredfields
          SET    pwr_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  pwr_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

	declare @nOldExchtodual		numeric(24,12)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0

														i.QUL_PART, i.QUL_CATREF, i.QUL_PURUOM, i.QUL_EVENT, i.QUL_ACT, i.QUL_TRADE,

														i.QUL_DELADDRESS, i.QUL_PART_ORG, i.QUL_INSPECT, i.QUL_UPDATECOUNT,
														d.QUL_QUOTATION, d.QUL_SEQNO, d.QUL_LINE, d.QUL_TYPE, d.QUL_RTYPE, d.QUL_REQ,
														d.QUL_PART, d.QUL_CATREF, d.QUL_PURUOM, d.QUL_EVENT, d.QUL_ACT, d.QUL_TRADE,
														d.QUL_REQPERS, d.QUL_PERSONS, d.QUL_REQQTY, d.QUL_QUOTQTY, d.QUL_QUOTUOM,

														d.QUL_MULQUOT, d.QUL_CURR, d.QUL_EXCH, d.QUL_REQLINE, d.QUL_EXCHTODUAL,

											@nReqpers, @nPersons, @nReqqty, @nQuotqty, @sQuotuom,

											@nMulquot, @sCurr, @nExch, @nReqline, @nExchtodual,
											@nExchfromdual, @nTaskqty, @nTaskrev, @nQuottaskqty,

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'

							set @sX = NULL

							if @sQuotation <> @sOldQuotation or @sSeqno <> @sOldSeqno or @sTrade <> @sOldTrade
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sPart <> @sOldPart
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PREQUL N'UPD', @sQuotation, @sSeqno, @sCatref, @sPuruom, @sEvent, 
														@nAct, @sTrade,	@nReqpers, @sType OUTPUT, @sRtype OUTPUT,

														@sQuotuom OUTPUT, @nLeadtime OUTPUT, @nPrice OUTPUT, @sTask OUTPUT, 
														@dExpir OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'

									deallocate c_ins_del

									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )

							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end

					update r5quotlines set QUL_QUOTATION = @sQuotation, QUL_SEQNO =@sSeqno , QUL_LINE = @nLine, 
											QUL_TYPE = @sType, QUL_RTYPE = @sRtype, QUL_REQ = @sReq,

											QUL_PRICE = @nPrice, QUL_TASK = @sTask, QUL_EXPIR = @dExpir, 
											QUL_MULTIPLY = @nMultiply, QUL_MULQUOT = @nMulquot, QUL_CURR = @sCurr, 
											QUL_EXC

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.QUT_QUOTATION, i.QUT_SEQNO, i.QUT_TRADE, i.QUT_UPDATECOUNT, 
														d.QUT_QUOTATION, d.QUT_SEQNO, d.QUT_TRADE, d.QUT_UPDATECOUNT, i.QUT_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.QUT_SQLIDENTITY = d.QUT_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sQuotation, @sSeqno, @sTrade, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldQuotation, @sOldSeqno, @sOldTrade, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
							begin

								IF @sQuotation <> @sOldQuotation
								OR @sSeqno     <> @sOldSeqno
								OR @sTrade     <> @sOldTrade 
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
										rollback transaction
										return
									end



								execute @nReturn = O7EXISTQ N'QUOT', N'*',  @sQuotation,  N'STAT', @sSeqno, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end


								if @nCountit >= 0
									begin
										if @nCountit = 0 
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_QUT', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										else
											set @sX = null
									end
								else
									begin
										if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXISTQ', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end



								if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
									update R5QUOTTASKS set QUT_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, QUT_LASTSAVED = getdate() where QUT_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
								else
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sQuotation, @sSeqno, @sTrade, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldQuotation, @sOldSeqno, @sOldTrade, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_REL
ON r5reliability
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT rel_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5reliability
          SET    rel_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  rel_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

create trigger PREUPD_RES
on R5RESERVATIONS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sPart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPartorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sStore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(2)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sQty			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sAllQty		nvarchar(80)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nAllQty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldUpdateCount int
	declare @nUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity	int
	declare @sOldEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldAct		int
	declare @sProject		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sDeferred		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.RES_EVENT, i.RES_ACT, i.RES_PART, i.RES_PART_ORG, i.RES_PROJECT, i.RES_STORE, i.RES_QTY, i.RES_ALLQTY, i.RES_UPDATECOUNT, i.RES_SQLIDENTITY,
														d.RES_EVENT, d.RES_ACT, d.RES_UPDATECOUNT
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.RES_SQLIDENTITY = d.RES_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin

					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sProject, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty ,@nUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity,  @sOldEvent, @nOldAct, @nOldUpdateCount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL
							set @nCountit = 0
							declare cur_deferred cursor local for select a.act_defermaintenance from r5activities a where a.act_event = @sOldEvent and a.act_act = @nOldAct;
							open cur_deferred;
							fetch next from cur_deferred into @sDeferred;
							close cur_deferred;
							deallocate cur_deferred;
							
							

							if ((@sEvent <> @sOldEvent OR  @nAct <> @nOldAct) and @sDeferred <>N'+')
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							

							execute @nReturn = O7PRERES N'UPD', @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sProject, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRERES', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5RESERVATIONS set RES_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1) + 1, RES_LASTSAVED = getdate() where RES_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							
							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							/* S3838 - Delete dependant data */
							
							select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCRES'
							if @nCount > 0 
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCRES'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'

							if @sFlag = N'Y'
								begin
									EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
									  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
									   XTS_TABLE,
									   XTS_KEYFLD1,
									   XTS_KEYFLD2,
									   XTS_KEYFLD3,
									   XTS_KEYFLD4,
									   XTS_KEYFLD5,
									   XTS_DATAFLD1,
									   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
									   XTS_ORG
									  )
									VALUES(
									  N'RESERVATIONS',
									  N'R5RESERVATIONS',
									  @sEvent,
									  @nAct,
									  @sPart,
									  @sPartorg,
									  @sStore,
									  N'R',
									  @sTempMsgid,
									  @sPartorg)
								end							  							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sProject, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty ,@nUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity,  @sOldEvent, @nOldAct, @nOldUpdateCount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @sOldRanklevel  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldRankvalue  	numeric(12,6)        
	declare @sOldNotused    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUpduser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOldFormula    	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.RIS_PK,	i.RIS_CODE,	i.RIS_DESC,	i.RIS_RISK,	i.RIS_REVISION,
													  	i.RIS_CLASS,	i.RIS_CLASS_ORG,	i.RIS_REVRSTATUS,	i.RIS_REVSTATUS,	i.RIS_TYPE,
													  	i.RIS_PARENT,	i.RIS_NORMALIZE,	i.RIS_RANKLEVEL,	i.RIS_RANKVALUE,	i.RIS_NOTUSED,
													  	i.RIS_CREATED,	i.RIS_USER,	i.RIS_UPDATED,	i.RIS_UPDUSER,	i.RIS_FORMULA,
													 	i.RIS_UPDATECOUNT,	i.RIS_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.RIS_PK,	d.RIS_CODE,	d.RIS_DESC,	d.RIS_RISK,	d.RIS_REVISION,
													  	d.RIS_CLASS,	d.RIS_CLASS_ORG,	d.RIS_REVRSTATUS,	d.RIS_REVSTATUS,	d.RIS_TYPE,
													  	d.RIS_PARENT,	d.RIS_NORMALIZE,	d.RIS_RANKLEVEL,	d.RIS_RANKVALUE,	d.RIS_NOTUSED,
													  	d.RIS_CREATED,	d.RIS_USER,	d.RIS_UPDATED,	d.RIS_UPDUSER,	d.RIS_FORMULA,
													  	d.RIS_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.RIS_SQLIDENTITY = d.RIS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nPk,	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sRisk,	@nRevision,
											@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sType,
											@nParent,	@sNormalize,	@sRanklevel,	@nRankvalue,	@sNotused,
											@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sFormula,
											@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@nOldPk,	@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRevision,
											@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldType,
											@nOldParent,	@sOldNormalize,	@sOldRanklevel,	@nOldRankvalue,	@sOldNotused,
											@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@sOldFormula,
											@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PRERIS N'UPD', @sClass, @sClass_org, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRERIS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--PREUPD2 portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end

					update R5RISK set	RIS_PK           =  @nPk,	RIS_CODE         =  @sCode,	RIS_DESC         =  @sDesc,
								        RIS_RISK         =  @sRisk,	RIS_REVISION     =  @nRevision,	RIS_CLASS        =  @sClass,
								        RIS_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	RIS_REVRSTATUS   =  @sRevrstatus,	RIS_REVSTATUS    =  @sRevstatus,
								        RIS_TYPE         =  @sType,	RIS_PARENT       =  @nParent,	RIS_NORMALIZE    =  @sNormalize,
								        RIS_RANKLEVEL    =  @sRanklevel,	RIS_RANKVALUE    =  @nRankvalue,	RIS_NOTUSED      =  @sNotused,
								        RIS_CREATED      =  @dCreated,	RIS_USER         =  @sUser,	RIS_UPDATED      =  @dUpdated,
								        RIS_UPDUSER      =  @sUpduser,	RIS_FORMULA      =  @sFormula,	RIS_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount
						where RIS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nPk,	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sRisk,	@nRevision,
													@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sType,
													@nParent,	@sNormalize,	@sRanklevel,	@nRankvalue,	@sNotused,
													@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sFormula,
													@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldPk,	@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRevision,
													@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldType,
													@nOldParent,	@sOldNormalize,	@sOldRanklevel,	@nOldRankvalue,	@sOldNotused,
													@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@sOldFormula,
													@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_RJR
on R5REJECTREASONS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.RJR_CODE, i.RJR_DESC, i.RJR_CLASS, i.RJR_CLASS_ORG , i.RJR_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.RJR_CODE, d.RJR_DESC, d.RJR_CLASS, d.RJR_CLASS_ORG , d.RJR_UPDATECOUNT, i.RJR_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.RJR_SQLIDENTITY = d.RJR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end


								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'REJR', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_RJR', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5REJECTREASONS set RJR_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, RJR_LASTSAVED = getdate() where RJR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'REJR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'REJR'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
											@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_RLG
ON r5dwetlrunlog
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT rlg_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5dwetlrunlog
          SET    rlg_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  rlg_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)

	declare @sOldCategory			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ROU_CODE, i.ROU_ORG, i.ROU_DESC, i.ROU_CLASS, i.ROU_CLASS_ORG , i.ROU_CATEGORY, i.ROU_REVISION, i.ROU_TEMPLATE, i.ROU_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.ROU_CODE, d.ROU_ORG, d.ROU_DESC, d.ROU_CLASS, d.ROU_CLASS_ORG , d.ROU_CATEGORY, d.ROU_REVISION, d.ROU_TEMPLATE, d.ROU_UPDATECOUNT, i.ROU_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ROU_SQLIDENTITY = d.ROU_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sCategory, @nRevision,@sTemplate, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@sOldCategory, @nOldRevision, @sOldTemplate, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode  OR
								@sTemplate <> @sOldTemplate OR
								@sClass <> @sOldClass OR
								@sCategory <> @sOldCategory
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end



								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_ROU', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5ROUTES set ROU_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, ROU_LASTSAVED = getdate() where ROU_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'ROUT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @sRevision = Cast(@nOldRevision as nvarchar(4))

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'ROUT'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + N'#' + @sRevision
								END



		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sCategory, @nRevision,@sTemplate, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@sOldCategory, @nOldRevision, @sOldTemplate, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_RQM
on R5REQUIRCODES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.RQM_CODE, i.RQM_DESC, i.RQM_CLASS, i.RQM_CLASS_ORG , i.RQM_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.RQM_CODE, d.RQM_DESC, d.RQM_CLASS, d.RQM_CLASS_ORG , d.RQM_UPDATECOUNT, i.RQM_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.RQM_SQLIDENTITY = d.RQM_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @nCountit = 0
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							If @sClass is not null 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'RECO', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_RQM', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
										if @nCountit > 0
											set @sX= null
										else
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
								end

							update R5REQUIRCODES set RQM_UPDATED = GetDate() where RQM_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5REQUIRCODES set RQM_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where RQM_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'RECO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'SHUT', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_SHUT', N'TRIG', 4
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end


							--PREUPD2_SDS portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5SHUTDOWNS set SDS_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, SDS_LASTSAVED = getdate() where SDS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'SHUT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'SHUT'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, @sOrg,
											@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_SHD
on R5SHFDAYS
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sShift				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nDay				numeric(3)
	declare @sOldShift			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nOldDay			numeric(3)
	declare @nTime				numeric(7,2)
	declare @nOldTime			numeric(7,2)
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCount				integer	
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)
	declare @nReturn		int
	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.shd_shift, i.shd_day, i.shd_time, i.shd_UPDATECOUNT,
													d.shd_shift, d.shd_day, d.shd_UPDATECOUNT, i.shd_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.shd_SQLIDENTITY = d.shd_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sShift, @nDay, @nTime, @nUpdatecount, @sOldShift, @nOldDay, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity 

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							if @sShift <> @sOldShift OR @nDay <> @nOldDay
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end 

/*DB start*/

									select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSHF'
									if @nCount > 0
										select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSHF'
									else
										set @sFlag = N'N'

									if @sFlag = N'Y'
										begin
											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
											   XTS_TABLE,
											   XTS_KEYFLD1,
											   XTS_KEYFLD2,
											   XTS_KEYFLD3,
											   XTS_ORG,
											   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
											  )
											VALUES(
											  N'SYNCSHIFTS',
											  N'R5SHIFTS',
											  @sShift,@nDay,@nTime,
											  null,
											  @sTempMsgid )
										end

/*DB end*/

								

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5SHFDAYS set shd_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, SHD_LASTSAVED = getdate() where shd_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sShift, @nDay, @nTime, @nUpdatecount, @sOldShift, @nOldDay, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity 
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_SHF
on R5SHIFTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @nLength			numeric(3)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCount				integer	
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.SHF_CODE, i.SHF_ORG, i.SHF_DESC, i.SHF_CLASS, i.SHF_CLASS_ORG , i.SHF_LENGTH, i.SHF_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.SHF_CODE, d.SHF_ORG, d.SHF_DESC, d.SHF_CLASS, d.SHF_CLASS_ORG , d.SHF_UPDATECOUNT, i.SHF_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.SHF_SQLIDENTITY = d.SHF_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nLength, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0

							--preupd_shf portion
							/* W45301 - Code not updateable */
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							/* W21221 : Class must exist ( r5classes, rentity = N'SHIF' ) */
							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'SHIF', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_SHF', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							update R5SHIFTS set SHF_UPDATED = GetDate() where SHF_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity


/*SCR 48731 Start*/

									set @sCheckresult = N'0'

									select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSHF'
									if @nCount > 0
										select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSHF'
									else
										set @sFlag = N'N'

									if @sFlag = N'Y'
										begin
											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
											   XTS_TABLE,
											   XTS_KEYFLD1,
											   XTS_ORG,
											   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
											  )
											VALUES(
											  N'SYNCSHIFTS',
											  N'R5SHIFTS',
											  @sCode,
											  @sOrg,
											  @sTempMsgid )
										end
/*SCR 48731 end*/

							
							

							--PREUPD2_SHF portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5SHIFTS set SHF_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where SHF_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSUPD_SHF portion
							/* W2134 : Delete from r5shfdays for Shift where Day > Length */
							DELETE r5shfdays
							WHERE  shd_day   > @nLength
							AND    shd_shift = @sCode

							
							/* W2135 - Update descriptions */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'SHIF', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							/* W2113 - If class is updated then remove property values of old class */
							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg) ) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'SHIF'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END



		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nLength, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_SOB
on R5SHUTDOWNOBJECTS
instead of update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sShutdown   		nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sObtype     		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sObrtype    		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sObject     		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDepend     		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sStandwork  		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sProjbud    		nvarchar(20)         
	declare @sObject_org 		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             
	declare @sRoute				nvarchar(20)        
	declare @nRouterev			numeric(4)          

	declare @sOldShutdown   	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sOldObtype     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldObrtype    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldObject     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldDepend     	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldStandwork  	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldProjbud    	nvarchar(20)         
	declare @sOldObject_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)     
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			int	
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)
	declare @sOldRoute			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nOldRouterev		numeric(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.SOB_SHUTDOWN,	i.SOB_OBTYPE,	i.SOB_OBRTYPE,	i.SOB_OBJECT,	i.SOB_DEPEND,
													  	i.SOB_STANDWORK,	i.SOB_PROJBUD,	i.SOB_OBJECT_ORG,	i.SOB_UPDATECOUNT,	i.SOB_SQLIDENTITY
													 ,
													  	d.SOB_SHUTDOWN,	d.SOB_OBTYPE,	d.SOB_OBRTYPE,	d.SOB_OBJECT,	d.SOB_DEPEND,
													  	d.SOB_STANDWORK,	d.SOB_PROJBUD,	d.SOB_OBJECT_ORG,	d.SOB_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	i.SOB_ROUTE,	i.SOB_ROUTEREV,		d.SOB_ROUTE,	d.SOB_ROUTEREV
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.SOB_SQLIDENTITY = d.SOB_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sShutdown,	@sObtype,	@sObrtype,	@sObject,	@sDepend,
										   	@sStandwork,	@sProjbud,	@sObject_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldShutdown,	@sOldObtype,	@sOldObrtype,	@sOldObject,	@sOldDepend,
											@sOldStandwork,	@sOldProjbud,	@sOldObject_org,	@nOldUpdatecount,
											@sRoute,	@nRouterev,		@sOldRoute,		@nOldRouterev
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							IF @sShutdown           <> @sOldShutdown
							OR @sObject             <> @sOldObject
							OR @sObject_org         <> @sOldObject_org
							OR coalesce( @sObtype, N' ' ) <> coalesce( @sOldObtype, N' ' )
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_SOB', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end 

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5SHUTDOWNOBJECTS set	SOB_SHUTDOWN     =  @sShutdown,	SOB_OBTYPE       =  @sObtype,	SOB_OBRTYPE      =  @sObrtype,
						                        	SOB_OBJECT       =  @sObject,	SOB_DEPEND       =  @sDepend,	SOB_STANDWORK    =  @sStandwork,
						                        	SOB_PROJBUD      =  @sProjbud,	SOB_OBJECT_ORG   =  @sObject_org,	SOB_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                        	SOB_LASTSAVED    =  getdate(),	SOB_ROUTE        =  @sRoute,	SOB_ROUTEREV     =  @nRouterev
						                        
						where SOB_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sShutdown,	@sObtype,	@sObrtype,	@sObject,	@sDepend,
												   	@sStandwork,	@sProjbud,	@sObject_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
												   ,
													@sOldShutdown,	@sOldObtype,	@sOldObrtype,	@sOldObject,	@sOldDepend,
													@sOldStandwork,	@sOldProjbud,	@sOldObject_org,	@nOldUpdatecount,
													@sRoute,	@nRouterev,		@sOldRoute,		@nOldRouterev
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT std_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

        END

      DEALLOCATE upd

create trigger PREUPD_STO
on R5STOCK
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCerrsource		nvarchar(32)
	declare @sCerrtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCstoclass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sCstoclassorg 		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dDstodate			datetime
	declare @sCprefstore   		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCprefsup			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCstcode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCstore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sToRepairType		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nStoQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldCstoclass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCstoclassorg 	nvarchar(15)
	declare @dOldDstodate		datetime
	declare @sOldCprefstore   	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCprefsup		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldCstcode		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCstore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldToRepairType	nvarchar(1)
	declare @nOldStoQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldCpart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCpart				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCpartOrg			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldCpartOrg		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sStockOut			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldStockOut		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @sX					nvarchar(4)
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.STO_CLASS,		i.STO_CLASS_ORG,	i.STO_STOCKTAKE,
														i.STO_PREFSTORE,	i.STO_PREFSUP,		i.STO_STORE,
														i.STO_REPAIRTYPE,	i.STO_QTY,			i.STO_PART,
														i.STO_PART_ORG,		i.STO_STOCKOUT,		i.STO_UPDATECOUNT,
														d.STO_CLASS,		d.STO_CLASS_ORG,	d.STO_STOCKTAKE,
														d.STO_PREFSTORE,	d.STO_PREFSUP,		d.STO_STORE,
														d.STO_REPAIRTYPE,	d.STO_QTY,			d.STO_PART,
														d.STO_PART_ORG,		d.STO_STOCKOUT,		d.STO_UPDATECOUNT,
														i.STO_SQLIDENTITY
											from	inserted i, deleted d
											where	i.STO_SQLIDENTITY = d.STO_SQLIDENTITY
 			
		
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sCstoclass,		@sCstoclassorg,		@dDstodate,
													@sCprefstore,		@sCprefsup,			
													@sCstore,			@sToRepairType,		@nStoQty,
													@sCpart,			@sCpartOrg,			@sStockOut,
													@nUpdatecount,
													@sOldCstoclass,		@sOldCstoclassorg,	@dOldDstodate,
													@sOldCprefstore,	@sOldCprefsup,		
													@sOldCstore,		@sOldToRepairType,	@nOldStoQty,
													@sOldCpart,			@sOldCpartOrg,		@sOldStockOut,
													@nOldUpdateCount,	@nSqlIdentity

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
							if @sCstore	<> @sOldCstore
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							if coalesce(@sCstoclass, N'X' ) 	<> N'N' AND  @sCpart <> @sOldCpart
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_STO', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							
							execute @nReturn = O7PRESTO N'UPD', @sCstoclass , @sCstoclassorg ,@dDstodate OUTPUT, @sCprefstore, @sCprefsup, @sCstore	, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull(@nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5STOCK set STO_UPDATED = GetDate(), STO_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where STO_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							if @nStoQty = 0 and @nOldStoQty > 0 AND @sOldStockOut = N'+'
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7POSSTO  @sCstore, @sCpart, @sCpartOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											SET @sCerrsource = N'O7PRESTO'
											SET @sCerrtype   = N'PROC'
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE @sCerrsource, @sCerrtype, @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
								fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sCstoclass,		@sCstoclassorg,		@dDstodate,
																@sCprefstore,		@sCprefsup,			
																@sCstore,			@sToRepairType,		@nStoQty,
																@sCpart,			@sCpartOrg,			@sStockOut,
																@nUpdatecount,
																@sOldCstoclass,		@sOldCstoclassorg,	@dOldDstodate,
																@sOldCprefstore,	@sOldCprefsup,		
																@sOldCstore,		@sOldToRepairType,	@nOldStoQty,
																@sOldCpart,			@sOldCpartOrg,		@sOldStockOut,
																@nOldUpdateCount,	@nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_STR
on R5STORES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sDeforg		nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCode		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldParent		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sLtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sLocation		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sLocationOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount	int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int

   declare @sNotused          nvarchar(1)
   declare @sOldnotused       nvarchar(1)
   declare @dLastStatusUpdate datetime


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.str_code, i.str_org, i.str_desc, i.str_parent, i.str_class, i.str_class_org, i.str_ltype, i.str_location, i.str_location_org, i.str_UPDATECOUNT,
														d.str_code, d.str_org, d.str_parent, d.str_class, d.str_class_org, d.str_UPDATECOUNT, i.STR_SQLIDENTITY, d.str_notused, i.str_notused, i.str_laststatusupdate
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.STR_SQLIDENTITY = d.STR_SQLIDENTITY
			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					deallocate c_ins_del
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sParent, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sLtype,
                    @sLocation, @sLocationOrg, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldParent, @sOldClass,
                    @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @sNotused, @sOldnotused, @dLastStatusUpdate
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sX = NULL

							if ( @sCode <>  @sOldCode OR @sOrg <>  @sOldOrg)
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PRESTR N'UPD', @sCode, @sParent, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sLtype, @sLocation, @sLocationOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PRESTR', N'PROC', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

                     if @sNotused <> @sOldnotused
                        begin
                          set    @dLastStatusUpdate       = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )
                          update r5stores
                          set    str_laststatusupdate = @dLastStatusUpdate
                          where  str_sqlidentity          = @nSqlIdentity
                        end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5STORES set STR_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1,
													STR_UPDATED = GetDate()
										 where STR_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

                            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'STOR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' AND
							 ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR
							   @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'STOR'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode

                            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sParent, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sLtype, @sLocation, @sLocationOrg, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldParent, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @sNotused, @sOldnotused, @dLastStatusUpdate
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_SWD
on R5DISPATCHES
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sEvent      		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nAct        		numeric(8,0)        
	declare @dReported   		datetime            
	declare @dStart      		datetime            
	declare @dEnd        		datetime            
	declare @sOrigin     		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sAssigned   		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sAction     		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sCostcode   		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldEvent      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOldAct        	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @dOldReported   	datetime            
	declare @dOldStart      	datetime            
	declare @dOldEnd        	datetime            
	declare @sOldOrigin     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldAssigned   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldAction     	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldCostcode   	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0) 
	
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @sTypeent			nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE;  /* Type entity                           */
	declare @sStatent			nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_statent%TYPE;  /* Status entity                         */
	declare @nCountit			integer
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE	      

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.SWD_CODE,	i.SWD_DESC,	i.SWD_EVENT,	i.SWD_ACT,	i.SWD_REPORTED,
													  	i.SWD_START,	i.SWD_END,	i.SWD_ORIGIN,	i.SWD_ASSIGNED,	i.SWD_ACTION,
													  	i.SWD_COSTCODE,	i.SWD_CLASS,	i.SWD_ORG,	i.SWD_CLASS_ORG,	i.SWD_UPDATECOUNT,
													 	i.SWD_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.SWD_CODE,	d.SWD_DESC,	d.SWD_EVENT,	d.SWD_ACT,	d.SWD_REPORTED,
													  	d.SWD_START,	d.SWD_END,	d.SWD_ORIGIN,	d.SWD_ASSIGNED,	d.SWD_ACTION,
													  	d.SWD_COSTCODE,	d.SWD_CLASS,	d.SWD_ORG,	d.SWD_CLASS_ORG,	d.SWD_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.SWD_SQLIDENTITY = d.SWD_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dReported,
										   	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sOrigin,	@sAssigned,	@sAction,
										   	@sCostcode,	@sClass,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
										   	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldEvent,	@nOldAct,	@dOldReported,
											@dOldStart,	@dOldEnd,	@sOldOrigin,	@sOldAssigned,	@sOldAction,
											@sOldCostcode,	@sOldClass,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
										
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							
							if @sCode <> @sOldCode
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if @sEvent <> @sOldEvent OR @dReported <> @dOldReported
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if @sClass is NOT NULL AND (@sClass <> coalesce(@sOldClass,N'*')
							OR @sClass_org <> coalesce(@sOldClass_org, @sDeforg)) 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'DISP', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_SWD', N'TRIG', 4
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'OBJ', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypeent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult = N'0'
								set @sX = null
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7CKSTTP', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND  (@sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass,N'*') 
							OR @sClass_org <> coalesce(@sOldClass_org,@sDeforg))
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'DISP'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode

						end
					update R5DISPATCHES set	SWD_CODE         =  @sCode,	SWD_DESC         =  @sDesc,	SWD_EVENT        =  @sEvent,
						                   	SWD_ACT          =  @nAct,	SWD_REPORTED     =  @dReported,	SWD_START        =  @dStart,
						                   	SWD_END          =  @dEnd,	SWD_ORIGIN       =  @sOrigin,	SWD_ASSIGNED     =  @sAssigned,
						                   	SWD_ACTION       =  @sAction,	SWD_COSTCODE     =  @sCostcode,	SWD_CLASS        =  @sClass,
						                   	SWD_ORG          =  @sOrg,	SWD_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	SWD_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                   	SWD_LASTSAVED    = getdate()
						                   
						where SWD_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dReported,
												   	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sOrigin,	@sAssigned,	@sAction,
												   	@sCostcode,	@sClass,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
												   	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldEvent,	@nOldAct,	@dOldReported,
													@dOldStart,	@dOldEnd,	@sOldOrigin,	@sOldAssigned,	@sOldAction,
													@sOldCostcode,	@sOldClass,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
												
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_SYC
on R5SYMPTOMCLASSES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser              nvarchar(38)
    declare @nUpdatecount       int
    declare @nOldUpdateCount    int
    declare @nSqlIdentity       int
    declare @sClass             nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassOrg          nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSymptom           nvarchar(8)  
    declare @sOldClass          nvarchar(8)
    declare @sOldClassOrg       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOldSymptom        nvarchar(8)  


    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select   i.SYC_CLASS, i.SYC_CLASS_ORG, i.SYC_SYMPTOM, i.SYC_UPDATECOUNT, i.SYC_SQLIDENTITY,  
                                                        d.SYC_CLASS, d.SYC_CLASS_ORG, d.SYC_SYMPTOM, d.SYC_UPDATECOUNT 
                                               from inserted i, deleted d
                                              where i.SYC_SQLIDENTITY = d.SYC_SQLIDENTITY
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_ins_del 
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into @sClass,@sClassOrg,@sSymptom, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity,
                                                    @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldSymptom, @nOldUpdateCount
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin

                            /* W41301 - Code and Class not updateable */
                            if @sClass      <> @sOldClass   OR
                               @sClassOrg   <> @sOldClassOrg    OR
                               @sSymptom        <> @sOldSymptom
                                begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end


                            if @nOldUpdateCount is null
                                update R5SYMPTOMCLASSES set SYC_UPDATECOUNT =  1 where SYC_SQLIDENTITY      = @nSqlIdentity
                            else
                                begin

                                    if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
                                        update R5SYMPTOMCLASSES set SYC_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where SYC_SQLIDENTITY      = @nSqlIdentity
                                    else
                                        begin
                                            close c_ins_del
                                            deallocate c_ins_del
                                            execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                                            rollback transaction
                                            return
                                        end

                                    
                                end

                            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sClass,@sClassOrg,@sSymptom, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity,
                                                            @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldSymptom, @nOldUpdateCount
                        end
                    close c_ins_del
                end
            deallocate c_ins_del
        end
