as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.TAX_CODE, i.TAX_ORG, i.TAX_DESC, i.TAX_CLASS, i.TAX_CLASS_ORG , i.TAX_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.TAX_CODE, d.TAX_ORG, d.TAX_DESC, d.TAX_CLASS, d.TAX_CLASS_ORG , d.TAX_UPDATECOUNT, i.TAX_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.TAX_SQLIDENTITY = d.TAX_SQLIDENTITY
			
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							set @sX = NULL
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'TAX', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_TAX', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end


							--PREUPD2_TAX portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5TAXES set TAX_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, TAX_LASTSAVED = getdate() where TAX_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'TAX', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (@sOldClass <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'TAX'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end

		end

													 	i.TKR_UPDATED,	i.TKR_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	d.TKR_TRANS,	d.TKR_PROMPTSEQ,	d.TKR_TARGETPROMPT,	d.TKR_TARGETSQL,	d.TKR_UPDATED,
													  	d.TKR_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.TKR_SQLIDENTITY = d.TKR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sTrans,	@nPromptseq,	@nTargetprompt,	@sTargetsql,	@nSqlidentity,
										   	@dUpdated,	@nUpdatecount,
											@sOldTrans,	@nOldPromptseq,	@nOldTargetprompt,	@sOldTargetsql,	@dOldUpdated,
											@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'

						where TKR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sTrans,	@nPromptseq,	@nTargetprompt,	@sTargetsql,	@nSqlidentity,

													@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_TOO
on R5TOOLS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(12)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nError		int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.TOO_CODE, i.TOO_ORG, i.TOO_DESC, i.TOO_CLASS, i.TOO_CLASS_ORG , i.TOO_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.TOO_CODE, d.TOO_ORG, d.TOO_DESC, d.TOO_CLASS, d.TOO_CLASS_ORG , d.TOO_UPDATECOUNT, i.TOO_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.TOO_SQLIDENTITY = d.TOO_SQLIDENTITY

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							set @sX = NULL
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end


								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = O7PRETOO N'UPD', @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7RAE N'O7PRETOO', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end


							--PREUPD2_TOO portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5TOOLS set TOO_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, TOO_LASTSAVED = getdate() where TOO_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'TOOL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'TOOL'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
    					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
    													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_TOU

NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser				nvarchar(38)

	declare @dDatebooked    		datetime
	declare @dDateused      		datetime
	declare @nHours         		numeric(12,2)
	declare @nTariff        		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost          		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQty           		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sGltransferflag		nvarchar(1)

	declare @nUpdatecount   		numeric(38,0)

	declare @sRouterec      		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nSqlidentity   		integer

	declare @sOldMrc           	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldTool          	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sOldEvent         	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldAct           	numeric(8,0)
	declare @dOldDatebooked    	datetime

	declare @nOldTariff        	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldCost          	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldQty           	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldGltransferflag	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldTranscode     	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nOldTransorgid    	integer
	declare @nOldTransgroup    	integer
	declare @nOldAcd           	bigint
	declare @dOldGltransfer    	datetime
	declare @nOldUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)
	declare @nOldOrighours     	numeric(12,2)
	declare @sOldRouterec      	nvarchar(1)

	declare @nTariffTemp			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCostTemp				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQtyTemp				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sAction				nvarchar(3)
	declare @nObjCount				integer

	declare @nCount					integer
	declare @nReturn				integer
	declare @sChk					nvarchar(4)

	declare @sJecategory		nvarchar(25)
	declare @sJesource			nvarchar(25)
	declare @sOldJecategory		nvarchar(25)
	declare @sOldJesource		nvarchar(25)
	declare @sSplitusage		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldSplitusage		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTempSplitusage	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sMisc				nvarchar(1)

    declare @sInvoice           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sInvoice_org       nvarchar(15)
    declare @nInvoice_revision  numeric(8)
    declare @nInvoiceline       numeric(8)
    declare @sOldInvoice        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sUnmatchedInvoice           nvarchar(45)
	declare @sUnmatchedInvoiceorg        nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUnmatchedInvoiceline       numeric(8)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.TOU_MRC,	i.TOU_TOOL,	i.TOU_EVENT,	i.TOU_ACT,	i.TOU_DATEBOOKED,
													  	i.TOU_DATEUSED,	i.TOU_HOURS,	i.TOU_TARIFF,	i.TOU_COST,	i.TOU_QTY,

													  	i.TOU_JECATEGORY, i.TOU_JESOURCE, i.TOU_SPLITUSAGE, i.TOU_DESC, i.TOU_MISC,
													  	i.TOU_INVOICE, i.TOU_INVOICE_ORG, i.TOU_INVOICE_REVISION, i.TOU_INVOICELINE, i.TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICE,
													  	i.TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICE_ORG, i.TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICELINE,
													  	d.TOU_MRC,	d.TOU_TOOL,	d.TOU_EVENT,	d.TOU_ACT,	d.TOU_DATEBOOKED,
													  	d.TOU_DATEUSED,	d.TOU_HOURS,	d.TOU_TARIFF,	d.TOU_COST,	d.TOU_QTY,
													  	d.TOU_GLTRANSFERFLAG,	d.TOU_TRANSCODE,	d.TOU_TRANSORGID,	d.TOU_TRANSGROUP,	d.TOU_ACD,
													  	d.TOU_GLTRANSFER,	d.TOU_UPDATECOUNT,	d.TOU_ORIGHOURS,	d.TOU_ROUTEREC,
														d.TOU_JECATEGORY, d.TOU_JESOURCE, d.TOU_SPLITUSAGE, d.TOU_INVOICE
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.TOU_SQLIDENTITY = d.TOU_SQLIDENTITY

			create table #tProperties_tou ( event			nvarchar(30),
										act				numeric(8,0),
										mrc				nvarchar(15),
										tool			nvarchar(12),
										dateused		datetime,
										datebooked		datetime,
										orighours		numeric(12,2),
										tariff			numeric(24,6),
										cost			numeric(24,6),
										qty				numeric(24,6),
										actiontable		nvarchar(3),
										objtable		integer,
										splitusage		nvarchar(1)	)

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dDatebooked,
										   	@dDateused,	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@nQty,
										   	@sGltransferflag,	@sTranscode,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@nAcd,

											@nSqlidentity ,@sJecategory, @sJesource,@sSplitusage,@sDesc,@sMisc,
											@sInvoice, @sInvoice_org, @nInvoice_revision, @nInvoiceline, @sUnmatchedInvoice,
											@sUnmatchedInvoiceorg, @nUnmatchedInvoiceline,

											@dOldGltransfer,	@nOldUpdatecount,	@nOldOrighours,	@sOldRouterec,@sOldJecategory, @sOldJesource, @sOldSplitusage, @sOldInvoice
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if @sSplitusage <> N'N' and coalesce( @sInvoice, N'x' ) = coalesce( @sOldInvoice, N'x' )
								begin
									select @nCount = count(*)
									from   r5events
									where  evt_routeparent = @sEvent
									AND    ( @sSplitusage = N'A' OR ( @sSplitusage = N'O' AND evt_rstatus <> N'C' ) ) and
										   EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
												  FROM   r5activities
												  WHERE  act_event = evt_code
												  AND    act_act   = @nAct )


									if coalesce(@nCount,0) > 0
										begin
											if @nHours = 0
												set @nHours = @nOrighours

											set @nOrighours = @nHours
											set @nHours = 0
											set @nCost = 0
											insert into #tProperties_tou values (@sEvent, @nAct, @sMrc, @sTool, @dDateused, @dDatebooked, @nOrighours,@nTariff, @nCost , @nQty, N'UPD', @nCount, @sSplitusage)
										end
								end


								if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
									set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
								else
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
										drop table #tProperties_tou
										rollback transaction
										return
									end
						end
					update R5TOOLUSAGE set	TOU_MRC             =  @sMrc,	TOU_TOOL            =  @sTool,	TOU_EVENT           =  @sEvent,
						                  	TOU_ACT             =  @nAct,	TOU_DATEBOOKED      =  @dDatebooked,	TOU_DATEUSED        =  @dDateused,
						                  	TOU_HOURS           =  @nHours,	TOU_TARIFF          =  @nTariff,	TOU_COST            =  @nCost,
						                  	TOU_QTY             =  @nQty,	TOU_GLTRANSFERFLAG  =  @sGltransferflag,	TOU_TRANSCODE       =  @sTranscode,
						                  	TOU_TRANSORGID      =  @nTransorgid,	TOU_TRANSGROUP      =  @nTransgroup,	TOU_ACD             =  @nAcd,
						                  	TOU_GLTRANSFER      =  @dGltransfer,	TOU_UPDATECOUNT     =  @nUpdatecount,	TOU_ORIGHOURS       =  @nOrighours,
						                  	TOU_ROUTEREC        =  @sRouterec, TOU_JECATEGORY = @sJecategory, TOU_JESOURCE = @sJesource, TOU_SPLITUSAGE = @sSplitusage,
						                  	TOU_INVOICE         =  @sInvoice, TOU_I

ON r5mgprovisioningconfig
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @name NVARCHAR( 64 )
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT tpk_name
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @name
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5mgprovisioningconfig
          SET    tpk_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  tpk_name = @name
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @name
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

create trigger PREUPD_TRD
on R5TRADES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sUser             nvarchar(38)
   declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
   declare @sX                nvarchar(1)
   declare @sCode             nvarchar(30)
   declare @sOldCode          nvarchar(30)
   declare @sOrg              nvarchar(15)
   declare @sDesc             nvarchar(80)
   declare @nUpdatecount      int
   declare @nOldUpdatecount   int
   declare @nSqlIdentity      int
   declare @nReturn           int
   declare @sClass            nvarchar(8)
   declare @sClassOrg         nvarchar(15)
   declare @sOldOrg           nvarchar(15)
   declare @sOldDesc          nvarchar(80)
   declare @sOldClass         nvarchar(8)
   declare @sOldClassOrg      nvarchar(15)
   declare @sDeforg           nvarchar(200)   --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
   declare @nCountit          int
   declare @sChk              nvarchar(4)
   declare @dToday            datetime

   declare @nCount            int
   declare @sFlag             nvarchar(1)
   declare @sTempMsgid        nvarchar(256)
   declare @dLastStatusUpdate datetime
   declare @sNotUsed          nvarchar(1)
   declare @sOldNotUsed       nvarchar(1)
   declare @dCreated          datetime


   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.trd_code, i.trd_org, i.trd_desc, i.trd_class, i.trd_class_org , i.trd_updatecount,
                                         d.trd_code, d.trd_org, d.trd_desc, d.trd_class, d.trd_class_org , d.trd_updatecount, i.trd_sqlidentity,
                                         d.trd_laststatusupdate, i.trd_notused, d.trd_notused, d.trd_created
                                    from inserted i, deleted d
                                   where i.trd_sqlidentity = d.trd_sqlidentity

         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_ins_del
               fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount,
                                       @sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity,
                                       @dLastStatusUpdate, @sNotUsed, @sOldNotUsed, @dCreated
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     --preupd_trd portion

                     set @sX = NULL
                     set @nCountit = 0
                     set @sCheckresult = N'0'

                     /* W26311 - Code not updateable */
                     IF @sCode <> @sOldCode
                        Begin
                           execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
                           close c_ins_del
                           deallocate c_ins_del
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        End

                        /* W26321 : Class must exist ( r5classes, rentity = N'TRAD' ) */
                        execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
                           begin
                              close c_ins_del
                              deallocate c_ins_del
                              rollback transaction
                              return
                           end



                        If @sClass is not null and (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg))
                           begin
                              execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'TRAD', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                 begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                 end

                              if @nCountit = 0
                                 begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_TRD', N'TRIG', 1
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                 end
                           end

                        IF @sNotUsed <> @sOldNotUsed
                           begin
                             set @dLastStatusUpdate = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )
                           end


                        set @dToday = GETDATE()
                        update r5trades
                        set trd_updated = @dToday,
                            trd_laststatusupdate = @dLastStatusUpdate
                        where trd_sqlidentity        = @nSqlIdentity



                     --PREUPD2_TRD portion
                     if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
                        update r5trades set trd_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where trd_sqlidentity = @nSqlIdentity
                     else
                        begin
                           close c_ins_del
                           deallocate c_ins_del
                           execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     --POSUPD_TRD portion

                     /* W2635 - Update descriptions */
                     execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'TRAD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_ins_del
                           deallocate c_ins_del
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end


                     select @nCount = count(*) from  r5install WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCITM'

                     if @nCount > 0
                        select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  r5install WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCITM'
                     else
                        set @sFlag = N'N'

                     if @sFlag = N'T'
                        begin
                           EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT

                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                           begin
                              close c_inserted
                              deallocate c_inserted
                              rollback transaction
                              return
                           end


                           INSERT INTO r5xmltranstatus(
                           xts_trantype,
                           xts_table,
                           xts_keyfld1,
                           xts_keyfld2,
                           xts_keyfld3,
                           xts_orig_messageid,
                           xts_org
                           )
                           VALUES(
                           N'SYNCITEM',
                           N'R5TRADES',
                           @sCode,
                           @sOrg,
                           N'R',
                           @sTempMsgid,
                           @sOrg)
                        end


                     /* W26113 - If class is updated then remove property values of old class */
                     IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND @sOldClass <> Coalesce(@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg, @sDeforg)
                           DELETE

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_TRE
ON r5trackingreports
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT tre_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5trackingreports
          SET    tre_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  tre_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

				begin

create trigger PREUPD_TRS
on R5TEMPRUNSQL
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)

	declare @sUser        		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sFunction    		nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sSql         		nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @nRetry       		integer             
	declare @dCreated_date		datetime            
	declare @dUpdated_date		datetime            
	declare @sErrortext   		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount 		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 		integer             

	declare @nOldCode        	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sOldUser        	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOldFunction    	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sOldSql         	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @nOldRetry       	integer             
	declare @dOldCreated_date	datetime            
	declare @dOldUpdated_date	datetime            
	declare @sOldErrortext   	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nOldUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)      
	
    declare @nReturn			integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin

			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.TRS_CODE,	i.TRS_USER,	i.TRS_FUNCTION,	i.TRS_SQL,	i.TRS_RETRY,
													  	i.TRS_CREATED_DATE,	i.TRS_UPDATED_DATE,	i.TRS_ERRORTEXT,	i.TRS_UPDATECOUNT,	i.TRS_SQLIDENTITY
													 ,
													  	d.TRS_CODE,	d.TRS_USER,	d.TRS_FUNCTION,	d.TRS_SQL,	d.TRS_RETRY,
													  	d.TRS_CREATED_DATE,	d.TRS_UPDATED_DATE,	d.TRS_ERRORTEXT,	d.TRS_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.TRS_SQLIDENTITY = d.TRS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nCode,	@sUser,	@sFunction,	@sSql,	@nRetry,
										   	@dCreated_date,	@dUpdated_date,	@sErrortext,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity

											@dOldCreated_date,	@dOldUpdated_date,	@sOldErrortext,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
                         	EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @dUpdated_date OUTPUT, NULL
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_ins_del
									DEALLOCATE c_ins_del

								END


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )

									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								end

     

						end

						where TRS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

													@dOldCreated_date,	@dOldUpdated_date,	@sOldErrortext,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end

		end

													  d.TSK_CODE, d.TSK_ORG, d.TSK_DESC, d.TSK_CLASS, d.TSK_CLASS_ORG , d.TSK_REVISION, d.TSK_UPDATECOUNT, i.TSK_SQLIDENTITY, d.TSK_WODESC,

create trigger PREUPD_UCO
on R5UCODES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as

	declare @sRcode				nvarchar(8)

	declare @sRentity			nvarchar(4)

		begin

														i.UCO_UPDATECOUNT, d.UCO_UPDATECOUNT, i.UCO_SQLIDENTITY
										from	inserted i, deleted d
									   where	i.UCO_SQLIDENTITY	= d.UCO_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

				begin

								begin
									close c_ins_del

		end

create trigger PREUPD_UGR
on R5GROUPS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(12)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.UGR_CODE, i.UGR_CLASS, i.UGR_CLASS_ORG, i.UGR_DESC,
														d.UGR_CODE, d.UGR_CLASS, d.UGR_CLASS_ORG,
														i.UGR_UPDATECOUNT, d.UGR_UPDATECOUNT, i.UGR_SQLIDENTITY
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.UGR_SQLIDENTITY = d.UGR_SQLIDENTITY
			
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sX = NULL

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									deallocate c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if @sClass is not null and 
							 ( @sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) OR 
							   @sClassOrg <> coalesce( @sOldClassOrg, @sDeforg ) ) 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'GROU', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return 
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_UGR', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							update R5GROUPS set UGR_UPDATED = GetDate() where UGR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--PREUPD2_UGR portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5GROUPS set UGR_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where UGR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'GROU', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return 
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' AND
							 ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR
							   @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'GROU'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

on R5USEGRIDSYSDEFAULT
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as

	declare @nUpdateCount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.USD_UPDATECOUNT, d.USD_UPDATECOUNT, i.USD_SQLIDENTITY
										   from inserted i, deleted d
										  where i.USD_SQLIDENTITY	= d.USD_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

				begin
					open c_ins_del

						begin

								update R5USEGRIDSYSDEFAULT set USD_UPDATECOUNT = 1

											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
										end
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity

ON r5usertabcolumns
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT utc_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5usertabcolumns
          SET    utc_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  utc_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

create trigger PREUPD_WAC
on R5STANDWACTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDuration		numeric(8)	
	declare @sStart			numeric(3)
	declare @sStandwork		nvarchar(20)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sOldStandwork		nvarchar(20)
	declare @nOldAct			numeric(8)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.WAC_STANDWORK, i.WAC_ACT,  i.WAC_DURATION, i.WAC_START, i.WAC_UPDATECOUNT, d.WAC_STANDWORK, d.WAC_ACT, d.WAC_UPDATECOUNT, i.WAC_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.WAC_SQLIDENTITY = d.WAC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sStandwork, @nAct, @sDuration,@sStart, @nUpdatecount, @sOldStandwork, @nOldAct,  @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							/* W192  -  Update of Reading not allowed */
							--preupd_WAC section
							/* W16211 : PPM, Act. No, Trade not updatable  */
							IF @sStandwork   <> @sOldStandwork    OR @nAct   <> @nOldAct 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							/* W16223 : Call to o7prewac procedure  */
							execute @nReturn = O7PREWAC N'UPD', @sStandwork, @sDuration, @sStart, @sCheckresult Output
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREWAC', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update R5STANDWACTS set WAC_UPDATED = GetDate() where WAC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--preupd2_WAC section
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5STANDWACTS set WAC_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where WAC_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sStandwork, @nAct, @sDuration,@sStart, @nUpdatecount, @sOldStandwork, @nOldAct,  @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_WCV
on R5WARCOVERAGES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sWarranty			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObject			nvarchar(30)		
	declare @sObjectOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sUOM				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sObrType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nStartusage		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldWarranty		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldObject			nvarchar(30)		
	declare @sOldObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldUOM			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldObType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldObrType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nOldStartusage		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.WCV_Warranty, i.WCV_Object,  i.WCV_Object_org, i.WCV_UOM, i.WCV_OBTYPE, i.WCV_OBRTYPE, i.WCV_StartUsage, i.WCV_UPDATECOUNT,
													 d.WCV_Warranty, d.WCV_Object,  d.WCV_Object_org, d.WCV_UOM, d.WCV_OBTYPE, d.WCV_OBRTYPE, d.WCV_StartUsage, d.WCV_UPDATECOUNT, i.WCV_SQLIDENTITY 
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.WCV_SQLIDENTITY = d.WCV_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sWarranty, @sObject, @sObjectOrg ,@sUOM,@sObType, @sObrType,@nStartusage, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldWarranty, @sOldObject, @sOldObjectOrg ,@sOldUOM,@sOldObType, @sOldObrType,@nOldStartusage, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--preupd_WCV section
							
							IF @sWarranty   <> @sOldWarranty
							OR @sObject     <> @sOldObject
							OR @sObjectOrg  <> @sOldObjectOrg
							OR @sUOM        <> @sOldUOM
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_WCV', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							IF(( @sObType     <> @sOldObType )  OR(  @sObrType    <> @sOldObrType ) OR(  @nStartusage <> @nOldStartusage ))
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update R5WARCOVERAGES set WCV_UPDATED = GetDate() where WCV_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--preupd2_WCV section
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5WARCOVERAGES set WCV_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where WCV_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction

body:
create trigger PREUPD_WPK
on R5WORKPACKAGES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(24)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sJobClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sJobClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sJobType			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(24)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldJobClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldJobClassOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldJobType		nvarchar(8)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.WPK_CODE, i.WPK_DESC, i.WPK_ORG, i.WPK_CLASS, i.WPK_CLASS_ORG, i.WPK_JOBCLASS, i.WPK_JOBCLASS_ORG, i.WPK_JOBTYPE, i.WPK_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.WPK_CODE, d.WPK_DESC, d.WPK_ORG, d.WPK_CLASS, d.WPK_CLASS_ORG, d.WPK_JOBCLASS, d.WPK_JOBCLASS_ORG, d.WPK_JOBTYPE, d.WPK_UPDATECOUNT, i.WPK_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.WPK_SQLIDENTITY = d.WPK_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sJobClass, @sJobClassOrg, @sJobType,@nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldJobClass, @sOldJobClassOrg, @sOldJobType, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode OR @sOrg <> @sOldOrg
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'WKPK', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_WPK', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

								If @sJobClass is not null 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'EVNT', @sJobClass, @sJobClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_WPK', N'TRIG', 2
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

								If @sJobType is not null 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'JBTP', @sJobType, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_WPK', N'TRIG', 3
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5WORKPACKAGES set WPK_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, WPK_LASTSAVED = getdate() where WPK_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'WKPK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (@sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'WKPK'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sJobClass, @sJobClassOrg, @sJobType,@nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldJobClass, @sOldJobClassOrg, @sOldJobType, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_ZPL
ON r5dwpolinesdailysnap
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @datekey      NUMERIC( 18 )
  DECLARE @orgkey       NUMERIC( 18 )

create trigger PRE_AJO
on R5ARRJOBS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sARRANGEMENT		nvarchar (12)
	declare @sMRC				nvarchar (15)
	declare @sJOBTYPE			nvarchar (8) 
	declare @sOBJCLASS			nvarchar (8) 
	declare @sOBJCLASS_ORG		nvarchar (15)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int

	--moved the update section of this code to the preupd2_ajo trigger.

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select AJO_ARRANGEMENT, AJO_MRC, AJO_JOBTYPE, AJO_OBJCLASS, AJO_OBJCLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sX = NULL
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sARRANGEMENT, @sMRC, @sJOBTYPE, @sOBJCLASS, @sOBJCLASS_ORG
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7PREAJO N'INS',@sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sARRANGEMENT, @sJOBTYPE, @sMRC, @sOBJCLASS , @sOBJCLASS_ORG
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sARRANGEMENT, @sMRC, @sJOBTYPE, @sOBJCLASS, @sOBJCLASS_ORG
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PRE_CEL
on R5CALCEVTLINES
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nIncrement  	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nLine       	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sRtype      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sSubevent   	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nSubact     	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @nCost       	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCalc       	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCorr       	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nPrice      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sTrade      	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOctype     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nHours      	numeric(12,2)       
	declare @sPart       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nQty        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sTool       	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sPart_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             

	declare @nReturn	integer          

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	CEL_EVENT,	CEL_INCREMENT,	CEL_LINE,	CEL_RTYPE,	CEL_SUBEVENT,
													  	CEL_SUBACT,	CEL_COST,	CEL_CALC,	CEL_CORR,	CEL_PRICE,
													  	CEL_TRADE,	CEL_OCTYPE,	CEL_HOURS,	CEL_PART,	CEL_QTY,
													  	CEL_TOOL,	CEL_PART_ORG,	CEL_UPDATECOUNT,	CEL_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEvent,	@nIncrement,	@nLine,	@sRtype,	@sSubevent,
												@nSubact,	@nCost,	@nCalc,	@nCorr,	@nPrice,
												@sTrade,	@sOctype,	@nHours,	@sPart,	@nQty,
												@sTool,	@sPart_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							execute @nReturn = o7precel N'INS', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,
								NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,
								NULL,NULL, @nCalc,@nCorr,@nCost,@nPrice OUTPUT,@sEvent,@nIncrement OUTPUT,
								@nHours,@nLine,@sOctype,@sPart,@sPart_org,@nQty,@sRtype OUTPUT,@nSubact,@sSubevent,@sTrade
												
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					insert into R5CALCEVTLINES(	CEL_EVENT,	CEL_INCREMENT,	CEL_LINE,	CEL_RTYPE,	CEL_SUBEVENT,
								               	CEL_SUBACT,	CEL_COST,	CEL_CALC,	CEL_CORR,	CEL_PRICE,
								               	CEL_TRADE,	CEL_OCTYPE,	CEL_HOURS,	CEL_PART,	CEL_QTY,
								               	CEL_TOOL,	CEL_PART_ORG,	CEL_UPDATECOUNT)
								values (	@sEvent,	@nIncrement,	@nLine,	@sRtype,	@sSubevent,
											@nSubact,	@nCost,	@nCalc,	@nCorr,	@nPrice,
											@sTrade,	@sOctype,	@nHours,	@sPart,	@nQty,
									    	@sTool,	@sPart_org,	@nUpdatecount
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEvent,	@nIncrement,	@nLine,	@sRtype,	@sSubevent,
														@nSubact,	@nCost,	@nCalc,	@nCorr,	@nPrice,
														@sTrade,	@sOctype,	@nHours,	@sPart,	@nQty,
														@sTool,	@sPart_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger
        print @sPostInsertTrigger
        EXEC (@sPostInsertTrigger)
        
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = 'CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_U5' +  @sTableName + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + 'ON  U5' +  @sTableName + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + 'FOR UPDATE  ' + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + 'AS  ' + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + ' DECLARE @sUser            nvarchar(255) ' + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + ' DECLARE @sDescription     nvarchar(80) ' + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + ' DECLARE @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4) ' + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + ' DECLARE @KeyFieldValues   nvarchar(100) ' + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + ' DECLARE @sX               nvarchar(4) ' + CHAR(13)
        SET @sPostUpdateTrigger = @sPostUpdateTrigger + ' DECLARE @nReturn          int ' + CHAR(13)

create procedure P_CLEANOUT_ID_TABLES
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sSQL       nvarchar(500)
    declare @sTablename nvarchar(128)
    declare @sOwnername nvarchar(128)

    declare c_tables cursor local for select cast(o.name as nvarchar(128)), cast(u.name as nvarchar(128))
                                        from sysobjects o, sysusers u
                                        where o.xtype = 'U' 
                                          and o.name like N'SEQ_%'
                                          and o.uid = u.uid
    open c_tables
    fetch next from c_tables into @sTablename, @sOwnername
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            begin transaction
            set @sSQL = N'begin SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON delete from ' + @sOwnername + N'."' + @sTablename + N'" end'
            EXEC( @sSQL )
            commit
        
            fetch next from c_tables into @sTablename, @sOwnername
        end
    close c_tables
    deallocate c_tables

create procedure P_DATE_FIRSTDAY @dReturnDate    datetime OUTPUT,
                            @dDate		datetime
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dReturn		datetime
	declare @nSavedatefirst	integer

	SET @nSavedatefirst = @@DATEFIRST
	
	SET DATEFIRST 7  --default this to Sunday.
	set @dReturn = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dateadd(dy, -1*(datepart(dw, @dDate) - 1), @dDate), N'DD')
	SET DATEFIRST @nSavedatefirst --return the Datefirst value to the server default.

	set @dReturnDate = @dReturn

CREATE PROCEDURE P_GETNEXTID @szMoniker nvarchar(64), @nID bigint OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL       nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sTablename nvarchar(128)
    declare @sOwner     nvarchar(128)

    set @sTablename = N'"SEQ_' + @szMoniker + N'"'

    --get owner name of sequence table
    select @sOwner = cast( u.name as nvarchar(128) )
      from sysobjects o, sysusers u
      where o.xtype = 'U'
        and o.name  = N'SEQ_' + @szMoniker
        and o.uid = u.uid

    --check to make that the sequence table exists
    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
           set @sSQL = N'begin set QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON insert into "' + @sOwner + N'".' + @sTablename + N' values (0) end'
           execute (@sSQL)
	        set @nID = @@IDENTITY
        end
    else
		set @nID = -1

    return

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nError     int

    set @sSQL = N'select @nReturn = sum(' + @sColumn + N') ' + 
                N'  from r5vfleetbilllines ' +

create function R5BUDGET_GET_LOC_HIERARCHY_1 (@sCode nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table( loc_code nvarchar(30)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                  loc_org     nvarchar(15)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
   DECLARE @nLevel         int
   DECLARE @sCurrentCode   nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @sCurrentOrg nvarchar(15)
      
   declare @tStack table ( loc_code nvarchar(30), loc_org nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
   
   INSERT INTO @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, 1
                     from r5locations
                         where loc_code = @sCode
                          and  loc_org  = @sOrg
   SET @nLevel = 1

   WHILE @nLevel > 0
      BEGIN
         IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
            BEGIN
               select   @sCurrentCode  = loc_code,
                     @sCurrentOrg   = loc_org
                 from   @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
               insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @sCurrentOrg )
               delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND loc_code = @sCurrentCode and loc_org = @sCurrentOrg
               insert into @tStack  select   loc_code, loc_org, @nLevel + 1
                                from   r5locations
                               where   loc_parent     = @sCurrentCode   and 
                                    loc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg
               IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
            END
         ELSE
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      END
   return
end

name: R5BVDWCUBEMROINVBYSTORE
body:
CREATE VIEW R5BVDWCUBEMROINVBYSTORE AS
SELECT 
	c.mro_datekey MRO_DATEKEY, 
	d.zdt_date ZDT_DATE,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),d.zdt_date,101) ZDT_DATEFMT,
	c.mro_orgkey MRO_ORGKEY, 
	o.zor_code ZOR_CODE, 
	c.mro_storekey MRO_STOREKEY, 
	s.zso_code ZSO_CODE, 
	c.mro_orderedmatlcostdefcur MRO_ORDEREDMATLCOSTDEFCUR, 
	c.mro_valueonhanddefcur MRO_VALUEONHANDDEFCUR
FROM 
(SELECT
  COALESCE(p.zps_dateapprovedkey,sd.zss_datekey) mro_datekey,
  COALESCE(p.zps_orgkey, sd.zss_orgkey) mro_orgkey,
  COALESCE(p.zps_storekey, sd.zss_storekey) mro_storekey,
  COALESCE(p.zps_orderedmatlcostdefcur,0) mro_orderedmatlcostdefcur,
  COALESCE(sd.zss_valueonhanddefcur,0) mro_valueonhanddefcur
FROM
  (SELECT zps_dateapprovedkey, zps_orgkey, zps_storekey, SUM(zps_orderedmatlcostdefcur) zps_orderedmatlcostdefcur FROM r5dwpoaccumsnap 

GROUP BY zps_dateapprovedkey, zps_orgkey, zps_storekey) p FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT zss_datekey,zss_orgkey, zss_storekey, SUM

(zss_valueonhanddefcur) zss_valueonhanddefcur FROM r5dwstoresdailysnap GROUP BY zss_datekey,zss_orgkey, zss_storekey) sd
  ON sd.zss_datekey = p.zps_dateapprovedkey
  AND sd.zss_storekey = p.zps_storekey
  AND sd.zss_orgkey = p.zps_orgkey) c, r5dwstores s, r5dworganizations o, r5dwdates d
WHERE
    c.mro_datekey != -1
    AND c.mro_orgkey = o.zor_key
    AND c.mro_storekey = s.zso_key
    AND c.mro_datekey = d.zdt_key
    AND DATEPART(yy, d.zdt_date) BETWEEN DATEPART(yy, GETDATE())-8 AND DATEPART(yy, GETDATE())
0

name: R5BVDWCUBEMROPARTSTOBYSTORE

CREATE VIEW R5BVDWCUBEMROPARTSTOBYSTORE AS
SELECT
	c.mro_datekey MRO_DATEKEY,
	d.zdt_date ZDT_DATE,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),d.zdt_date,101) ZDT_DATEFMT,
	c.mro_orgkey MRO_ORGKEY,
	o.zor_code ZOR_CODE,
	c.mro_storekey MRO_STOREKEY,
	s.zso_code ZSO_CODE,
	c.mro_materialcostdefcur MRO_MATERIALCOSTDEFCUR,
    c.mro_valueonhanddefcur MRO_VALUEONHANDDEFCUR
FROM 
(SELECT
  COALESCE(md.zms_datekey,sd.zss_datekey) mro_datekey,
  COALESCE(md.zms_orgkey, sd.zss_orgkey) mro_orgkey,
  COALESCE(md.zms_fromstorekey, sd.zss_storekey) mro_storekey,
  COALESCE(md.zms_materialcostdefcur,0) mro_materialcostdefcur,
  COALESCE(sd.zss_valueonhanddefcur,0) mro_valueonhanddefcur
FROM
  (SELECT zms_datekey, zms_orgkey, zms_fromstorekey, SUM(zms_materialcostdefcur) zms_materialcostdefcur FROM r5dwmatltransdailysnap INNER 

JOIN r5dwmatltranstypes ON zms_matltranstypekey = zmt_key WHERE zmt_code = 'I' GROUP BY zms_datekey, zms_orgkey, zms_fromstorekey) md 
  FULL OUTER JOIN 
  (SELECT zss_datekey,zss_orgkey, zss_storekey, SUM(zss_valueonhanddefcur) zss_valueonhanddefcur FROM r5dwstoresdailysnap GROUP BY 

zss_datekey,zss_orgkey, zss_storekey) sd
  ON sd.zss_datekey = md.zms_datekey
  AND sd.zss_storekey = md.zms_fromstorekey
  AND sd.zss_orgkey = md.zms_orgkey) c, 
  r5dwstores s, 
  r5dworganizations o, 
  r5dwdates d
WHERE
  c.mro_datekey != -1
  AND c.mro_orgkey = o.zor_key
  AND c.mro_storekey = s.zso_key
  AND c.mro_datekey = d.zdt_key
  AND DATEPART(yy, d.zdt_date) BETWEEN DATEPART(yy, GETDATE())-8 AND DATEPART(yy, GETDATE())
0

SELECT

  COALESCE(dp.zmr_code,'_NULL_') DW_DEPT,

  COALESCE(ts.zst_code,'') + '_' + COALESCE(ts.zst_rcode,'') + '_' + COALESCE(ts.zst_statusentity,'') DW_TOSTATUSKEY,

  SUM(COALESCE(m.zsc_cumulativetime,0)) DW_CUMMTIME

  r5dwstatusdailysnap m, r5dwdates d, r5dworganizations o, r5dwmrcs dp, r5dwentities e, r5dwstatuses fs, r5dwstatuses ts
WHERE
  m.zsc_datekey = d.zdt_key
  AND m.zsc_orgkey = o.zor_key
  AND m.zsc_mrckey = dp.zmr_key
  AND m.zsc_entitykey = e.zen_key
  AND m.zsc_fromstatuskey = fs.zst_key
  AND m.zsc_tostatuskey = ts.zst_key
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM r5bvdwdimstatus WHERE "ZST_UNIQUEID" = COALESCE(ts.zst_code,'') + '_' + COALESCE(ts.zst_rcode,'') + '_' + COALESCE(ts.zst_statusentity,'') )
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM r5bvdwdimstatus WHERE "ZST_UNIQUEID" = COALESCE(fs.zst_code,'') + '_' + COALESCE(fs.zst_rcode,'') + '_' + COALESCE(fs.zst_statusentity,'') )
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 'X' FROM r5bvdwdimentity WHERE "ZEN_UNIQUEID" = COALESCE(e.zen_code,'') + '_' + COALESCE(e.zen_secondary,'') )

  d.zdt_date,  o.zor_code,  dp.zmr_code,

CREATE VIEW R5BVDWCUBEUSERORGACCESS AS
SELECT  
	u.uog_user UOG_USER,
	u.uog_org ORGANIZATION,
	COALESCE(u.uog_org,'') + '_' + COALESCE(c.mrc_code,'') DEPARTMENT,
	1 UOG_VALUE
FROM
	r5userorganization u
	INNER JOIN 
		(SELECT uog_user, uog_org,uog_common, mrc_code FROM r5userorganization , r5mrcs WHERE mrc_org = uog_org) c
		ON (u.uog_user = c.uog_user and  (c.uog_common = '+' OR c.uog_org = u.uog_org))
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	'_NO_USER',
	'_' ORGANIZATION,
	'_DEPT' DEPARTMENT,
	1 UOG_VALUE
FROM DUAL

CREATE VIEW R5BVDWDIMDATE AS
SELECT '1901' ZDT_YEAR,'Quarter 1 1901' ZDT_QUARTER,'January 1901' ZDT_MONTH, '01/01/1901' ZDT_DATE, '1901-01' ZDT_YEARMONTH,'1901-1' ZDT_YEARQUARTER FROM DUAL
UNION
SELECT
  CAST(zdt_year AS NVARCHAR(4)) ZDT_YEAR,
  'Quarter ' + CAST(zdt_quarter AS NVARCHAR(1)) + ' ' + CAST(zdt_year AS NVARCHAR(4)) ZDT_QUARTER, 
  CASE zdt_monthnuminyear 
    WHEN 1 THEN 'January' 
    WHEN 2 THEN 'February' 
    WHEN 3 THEN 'March'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'July'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'October'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'November'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'December' END + ' ' + CAST(zdt_year AS NVARCHAR(4)) ZDT_MONTH, 
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),zdt_date,101) ZDT_DATE,
  zdt_yearmonth ZDT_YEARMONTH,
  zdt_yearquarter ZDT_YEARQUARTER
FROM r5dwdates 
WHERE zdt_key > 0

name: R5BVDWDIMPERIOD

CREATE VIEW R5BVDWDIMPERIOD AS
SELECT
  CAST(zdt_year AS NVARCHAR(4)) ZDT_YEAR,
  'Quarter ' + CAST(zdt_quarter AS NVARCHAR(1)) + ' ' + CAST(zdt_year AS NVARCHAR(4)) ZDT_QUARTER, 
  CASE zdt_monthnuminyear 
    WHEN 1 THEN 'January' 
    WHEN 2 THEN 'February' 
    WHEN 3 THEN 'March'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'July'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'October'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'November'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'December' END + ' ' + CAST(zdt_year AS NVARCHAR(4)) ZDT_MONTH, 
  dbo.f_date_to_char(zdt_date,'MM/DD/YYYY') ZDT_DATE,
  ZDT_YEARMONTH,
  ZDT_YEARQUARTER
FROM r5dwdates 
WHERE zdt_key > 0 AND zdt_year <= DATEPART(yy, GETDATE())

name: R5BVDWMROINVPARTSTOBYSTORE
body:
CREATE VIEW R5BVDWMROINVPARTSTOBYSTORE AS    
SELECT 
    d.mro_datekey ZDT_KEY,
    d.mro_orgkey ZOR_KEY, 
    d.mro_storekey ZSO_KEY, 
    d.mro_lastsaved MRO_LASTSAVED,
    d.mro_orderedmatlcostdefcur MRO_ORDEREDMATLCOSTDEFCUR, 
    d.mro_valueonhanddefcur MRO_VALUEONHANDDEFCUR,
    d.mro_materialcostdefcur MRO_MATERIALCOSTDEFCUR
FROM 
    (SELECT
      COALESCE( c.mro_lastsaved, md.zms_lastsaved ) mro_lastsaved, 
      COALESCE(c.mro_datekey,md.zms_datekey) mro_datekey,
      COALESCE(c.mro_orgkey,md.zms_orgkey) mro_orgkey,
      COALESCE(c.mro_storekey,md.zms_fromstorekey) mro_storekey,
      COALESCE(c.mro_orderedmatlcostdefcur,0) mro_orderedmatlcostdefcur,
      COALESCE(c.mro_valueonhanddefcur,0) mro_valueonhanddefcur,
      COALESCE(md.zms_materialcostdefcur,0) mro_materialcostdefcur
    FROM
        (SELECT
          COALESCE( p.zps_lastsaved, sd.zss_lastsaved ) mro_lastsaved, 
          COALESCE(p.zps_dateapprovedkey,sd.zss_datekey) mro_datekey,
          COALESCE(p.zps_orgkey, sd.zss_orgkey) mro_orgkey,
          COALESCE(p.zps_storekey, sd.zss_storekey) mro_storekey,
          COALESCE(p.zps_orderedmatlcostdefcur,0) mro_orderedmatlcostdefcur,
          COALESCE(sd.zss_valueonhanddefcur,0) mro_valueonhanddefcur
        FROM
          (SELECT 
            zps_dateapprovedkey, 
            zps_orgkey, 
            zps_storekey, 
            zps_lastsaved,
            SUM(zps_orderedmatlcostdefcur) zps_orderedmatlcostdefcur
           FROM r5dwpoaccumsnap 
           GROUP BY zps_dateapprovedkey, zps_orgkey, zps_storekey, zps_lastsaved ) p 
          FULL OUTER JOIN 
          (SELECT 
            zss_datekey,
            zss_orgkey,
            zss_storekey,
            zss_lastsaved,
            SUM(zss_valueonhanddefcur) zss_valueonhanddefcur
          FROM r5dwstoresdailysnap
          GROUP BY zss_datekey,zss_orgkey, zss_storekey, zss_lastsaved ) sd
          ON sd.zss_datekey = p.zps_dateapprovedkey
             AND sd.zss_storekey = p.zps_storekey
             AND sd.zss_orgkey = p.zps_orgkey) c
        FULL OUTER JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            zms_datekey, 
            zms_orgkey, 
            zms_fromstorekey, 
            zms_lastsaved,
            SUM(zms_materialcostdefcur) zms_materialcostdefcur 
           FROM r5dwmatltransdailysnap 
                INNER JOIN r5dwmatltranstypes ON zms_matltranstypekey = zmt_key 
           WHERE zmt_rcode = 'I' 
           GROUP BY zms_datekey, zms_orgkey, zms_fromstorekey, zms_lastsaved ) md
        ON md.zms_datekey = c.mro_datekey
             AND md.zms_orgkey = c.mro_orgkey
             AND md.zms_fromstorekey = c.mro_storekey) d, 
    r5dwstores s, 
    r5dworganizations o, 
    r5dwdates dd
WHERE
    d.mro_datekey != -1
    AND d.mro_orgkey = o.zor_key
    AND d.mro_storekey = s.zso_key
    AND d.mro_datekey = dd.zdt_key

CREATE VIEW R5BVDWSPAREPARTSCOUNT AS
SELECT
  uog_user usr_code,
  uog_org org_code, 
  MAX( sto_lastsaved ) sto_lastsaved,
  COUNT( DISTINCT sto_part + '_' + sto_part_org ) spc_count
FROM
    r5userorganization r
    LEFT JOIN r5stock 
    ON COALESCE( sto_class, ' ') <> 'N'
      AND sto_part_org = r.uog_org 
          OR ( '-' = ( SELECT uog_common FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = r.uog_user and uog_org = r.uog_org )
             AND sto_part_org IN ( SELECT uog_org FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = r.uog_user and uog_common = '+' ) )
GROUP BY uog_user, uog_org

CREATE VIEW r5chargedefsequences AS
SELECT cds_category, cds_subcategory, cds_level, cds_sequence, cds_actualsubcat, NULL cds_rcode
FROM   r5chargedefsequence
WHERE  cds_category <> N'WOCH' 
UNION
SELECT cds_category, uco_code, cds_level, cds_sequence, cds_actualsubcat, ISNULL( cds_actualsubcat, uco_rcode ) cds_rcode
FROM   r5ucodes, r5chargedefsequence
WHERE  cds_category = N'WOCH'
AND    uco_rentity  = N'CSTP'
AND    uco_rcode    = cds_subcategory
UNION
SELECT N'FUEL', fue_code, N'TR', 25, NULL, NULL
FROM   r5fuels
WHERE  fue_code <> N'FC00'
UNION
SELECT N'FUEL', fue_code, N'SC', 26, NULL, NULL
FROM   r5fuels
WHERE  fue_code <> N'FC00'
UNION
SELECT N'FUEL', N'FC00', N'TR', 25, fue_code, NULL
FROM   r5fuels
WHERE  fue_code <> N'FC00'
UNION
SELECT N'FUEL', N'FC00', N'SC', 26, fue_code, NULL
FROM   r5fuels
WHERE  fue_code <> N'FC00'
UNION
SELECT N'ENER', cmd_code, N'TR', 28, NULL, NULL
FROM   r5commodities 
WHERE  cmd_code <> N'EC00'
UNION
SELECT N'ENER', cmd_code, N'SC', 29, NULL, NULL
FROM   r5commodities 
WHERE  cmd_code <> N'EC00'

name: R5DEFPARTSUMMARYVW
body:
CREATE VIEW R5DEFPARTSUMMARYVW
(   DPS_DEFCODE,DPS_DEFORIGINALWO,DPS_DEFORIGINALACT,DPS_PARTCODE, DPS_PARTORG, DPS_PARTUOM, DPS_PARTSTORE, DPS_PARTSOURCE,
    DPS_PLANNEDSRC, DPS_PLANNEDQUANTITY, DPS_RESQTY, DPS_AVAILABLE, DPS_MATERIALLIST,DPS_MATLREVISION,
    DPS_REQUISITION, DPS_REQORG, DPS_REQSTATUS, DPS_REQLINE, DPS_REQLINESTATUS, DPS_PURCHASEORDER,
    DPS_POORG, DPS_POSTATUS, DPS_POLINE, DPS_POLINESTATUS, DPS_REQPOWORKORDER,DPS_REQPOACT, DPS_EQUIPMENT,
    DPS_EQUIPMENTORG, DPS_RELATEDWO, DPS_REQUESTEDQTY, DPS_OUTSTANDING, DPS_DELDUEDATE,
    DPS_ORIGINATOR, DPS_BUYER, DPS_SUPPLIER, DPS_SUPPLIERORG, DPS_MLPLINE, DPS_JOINEQUIPMENT
)
AS 
SELECT  dfa_code,dfa_origwo,dfa_origact,orl_part partcode, orl_part_org , orl_puruom ,
                    ord_store ,
                    CASE WHEN orl_req IS NULL THEN 'POONLY'
                        ELSE 'REQPO'
                    END,
                    NULL, NULL,
                    NULL , NULL , NULL ,NULL, req_code ,REQ_ORG ,
                    req_status , rql_reqline , rql_status ,
                    ord_code , ord_org , ord_status ,
                    orl_ordline , orl_status , orl_event , orl_act,
		    CASE
		       WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '-'
			  THEN p.evt_object
			   WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND orl_relatedwo IS NULL 
			  THEN 'ALLEQUIPMENT' 
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND orl_relatedwo = orl_event 
			  THEN 'WOHEADEREQUIPMENT'
			  WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND orl_relatedwo != orl_event 
			    THEN dfa_object
		    END ,
		    CASE
			   WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '-'
			  THEN p.evt_object_org
			   WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND ( orl_relatedwo IS NULL or orl_relatedwo = orl_event )
			  THEN null
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND orl_relatedwo != orl_event 
			  THEN dfa_object_org
		    END ,
		    CASE
			   WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '-'
			  THEN null
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND orl_relatedwo IS NULL 
			  THEN null
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND orl_relatedwo = orl_event 
			  THEN orl_relatedwo
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND orl_relatedwo != orl_event 
			  THEN dfa_relatedwo
		    END ,
                    CASE
                        WHEN orl_rtype='PD'
                    THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN
                            p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND (orl_relatedwo = dfa_relatedwo OR orl_relatedwo = orl_event)
                        THEN
                                ORL_ORDQTY
                        WHEN
                            p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND  (select count(*) from r5events  where EVT_ROUTEPARENT =dfa_previouswo)>0 and orl_relatedwo is null
                        THEN
                              ROUND(ORL_ORDQTY/(select count(*) from r5events  where EVT_ROUTEPARENT = dfa_previouswo),2)
                        WHEN
                            (p.evt_multiequip = '-' OR   ORL_RELATEDWO = ORL_EVENT )
                        THEN
                             ORL_ORDQTY
                        END
                ELSE
                      null
                END,
            CASE
                WHEN
                    p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND (orl_relatedwo = dfa_relatedwo OR orl_relatedwo = orl_event)
                THEN
                    dbo.o7outstqty(ORL_ORDER,ORL_ORDER_ORG,ORL_ORDLINE)
                WHEN
                    p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND  (select count(*) from r5events  where EVT_ROUTEPARENT =dfa_previouswo) > 0 and orl_relatedwo is null
                THEN
                    ROUND(dbo.o7outstqty(ORL_ORDER,ORL_ORDER_ORG,ORL_ORDLINE)/(select count(*) from r5events  where EVT_ROUTEPARENT = dfa_previouswo),2)
                WHEN
                    p.evt_multiequip = '-'
                THEN
                    dbo.o7outstqty(ORL_ORDER,ORL_ORDER_ORG,ORL_ORDLINE)
            END,
                    orl_due, ord_origin, ord_buyer,
                    ord_supplier, ord_supplier_org, null, dfa_object + '#' + dfa_object_org
           FROM r5parts, r5orders, r5deferredact,
               r5orderlines
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5requislines  ON ( orl_req = rql_req AND orl_reqline = rql_reqline)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5requisitions  ON (orl_req = req_code)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events p  ON (orl_event = p.evt_code)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events c  ON (orl_relatedwo = c.evt_code)
          WHERE par_code = orl_part
            AND par_org = orl_part_org
            AND orl_order = ord_code
            AND orl_order_org = ord_org
            AND orl_event = dfa_previouswo
            AND orl_act = dfa_previousact
            AND dfa_object = COALESCE( c.evt_object, dfa_object )
            AND dfa_object_org = COALESCE( c.evt_object_org, dfa_object_org )
            AND (   orl_relatedwo IS NULL AND  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5events
                             WHERE evt_routeparent = dfa_previouswo AND DFA_OBJECT = EVT_OBJECT 
							 	   AND DFA_OBJECT_ORG =EVT_OBJECT_ORG)
                 OR COALESCE (dfa_relatedwo, '!@#$') = COALESCE (orl_relatedwo, '!@#$') or orl_relatedwo = orl_event
                )
            AND not ((orl_rstatus = 'J') OR ( orl_rstatus = 'C' AND COALESCE(orl_recvqty, 0) =0) )
            AND (ORL_RELATEDWO = dfa_relatedwo or ORL_RELATEDWO is null or dfa_relatedwo is null or orl_relatedwo = orl_event )
            AND dfa_rstatus <>'C'
	    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM R5EVENTS WHERE EVT_OBJECT=dfa_object AND EVT_OBJECT_ORG=DFA_OBJECT_ORG AND (EVT_CODE=dfa_previouswo or EVT_CODE=dfa_relatedwo))
UNION ALL
        SELECT dfa_code,dfa_origwo,dfa_origact,par_code , rql_part_org , rql_uom ,
                req_tocode, 'REQONLY', NULL, NULL,
                NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL, req_code ,REQ_ORG ,
                req_status , rql_reqline , rql_status ,
                NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL ,
                NULL , rql_event ,rql_act,
                CASE
		   WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '-'
			  THEN p.evt_object
		       WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND rql_relatedwo IS NULL 
			  THEN 'ALLEQUIPMENT'
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND rql_relatedwo = rql_event 
			  THEN 'WOHEADEREQUIPMENT'
			  WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND rql_relatedwo != rql_event 
			    THEN dfa_object
		END ,
		CASE
		       WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '-'
			  THEN p.evt_object_org
		       WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND ( rql_relatedwo IS NULL or rql_relatedwo = rql_event )
			  THEN null
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND rql_relatedwo != rql_event 
			  THEN dfa_object_org
		END ,
		CASE
		       WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '-'
			  THEN null
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND rql_relatedwo IS NULL 
			  THEN null
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND rql_relatedwo = rql_event 
			  THEN rql_relatedwo
			WHEN p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND rql_relatedwo != rql_event 
			  THEN dfa_relatedwo
		END ,
                CASE
                    WHEN rql_rtype='PD'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN
                            p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND (rql_relatedwo = dfa_relatedwo OR rql_relatedwo = rql_event)
                        THEN
                                rql_qty
                        WHEN
                            p.evt_multiequip = '+' AND  (select count(*) from r5events  where EVT_ROUTEPARENT =dfa_previouswo)>0 and rql_relatedwo is null
                        THEN
                              ROUND(RQL_QTY/(select count(*) from r5events  where EVT_ROUTEPARENT = dfa_previouswo),2)
                        WHEN
                            (p.evt_multiequip = '-' OR   RQL_RELATEDWO = RQL_EVENT ) 
                        THEN
                             RQL_QTY
                        END
                ELSE
                      null
                END,
            null,
                rql_due ,req_origin , rql_buyer , rql_supplier ,
                rql_supplier_org, null,

name: r5duepercentage
body:
CREATE VIEW r5duepercentage
AS
select eob_object, eob_object_org, 
MAX( RIGHT( REPLICATE('0',3)+
     CAST (CAST(dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER(ROUND(dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(0, dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(COALESCE(100 -
                                                 (datediff( d, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), 'DD' ), evt_due ) /
                                                 dbo.O7GTFREQ(evt_freq,
                                                           evt_perioduom,
                                                           evt_due) * 100),
                                                 0),
                                             COALESCE(100 -
                                                 ((evt_meterdue -
                                                 ou1.oud_totalusage) /
                                                 evt_meterinterval * 100),
                                                 0)),
                                                 COALESCE(100 -
                                                 ((evt_meterdue2 -
                                                 ou2.oud_totalusage) /
                                                 evt_meterinterval2 * 100),
                                                 0))),0),999) AS INT)AS nvarchar ), 3)  + '#' + evt_code ) code
         FROM   r5objects, r5eventobjects, r5events
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs ou1 
                             ON ( ou1.oud_object = evt_object AND ou1.oud_object_org = evt_object_org AND ou1.oud_uom = evt_metuom )
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs ou2 
                             ON ( ou2.oud_object = evt_object AND ou2.oud_object_org = evt_object_org AND ou2.oud_uom = evt_metuom2 )
         WHERE  evt_code = eob_event
         AND    obj_code    = eob_object
         AND    obj_org     = eob_object_org
         AND    evt_rtype   = 'PPM'
         AND    evt_rstatus    = 'R'
         AND    obj_obrtype IN ( 'A', 'P', 'S' )
         AND    obj_operationalrstatus IN ( 'O', 'NO' )
         GROUP BY eob_object, eob_object_org

ALTER TABLE R5EVENTS DISABLE TRIGGER PREDEL_EVT' )
                declare c_cv_events cursor local for select evt_code from #tCVEvents
                open c_cv_events
                fetch next from c_cv_events into @sCode
                while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                    begin
                        UPDATE r5events
                           SET evt_rstatus = N'A'
                         WHERE evt_code = @sCode

                        DELETE FROM r5customerrequesthistory 
                        WHERE crh_event = @sCode

                        DELETE FROM r5events WHERE evt_code = @sCode
        
                        fetch next from c_cv_events into @sCode
                    end
                close c_cv_events
                deallocate c_cv_events

                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5EVENTS ENABLE TRIGGER PREDEL_EVT' )
            end try 
            begin catch
                declare @sErrorMessage  nvarchar(4000)
                declare @nErrorSeverity int
                declare @nErrorState    int

                select @sErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                       @nErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
                       @nErrorState = ERROR_STATE()

                close c_cv_events
                deallocate c_cv_events
                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5EVENTS ENABLE TRIGGER PREDEL_EVT' )

                RAISERROR(@sErrorMessage, @nErrorSeverity, @nErrorState)
            end catch
        end

CREATE VIEW R5IESMENUSEARCH
    (IMS_USERFUNCTION, IMS_SYSTEMFUNCTION, IMS_DESC, IMS_CLASS, IMS_GROUP, IMS_LANG)
AS
SELECT e1.emn_function,
       CASE
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'REP' OR f.fun_class = 'WEBR' THEN 'EWSREP'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'WEB' THEN 'EWSWEB'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'REPA' THEN 'COGWEB'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'REPB' THEN 'COGREP'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'REPC' AND f.fun_subtype = 'R' THEN 'COGREPC'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'REPC' AND f.fun_subtype = 'Q' THEN 'COGQREPC'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'WSP' THEN 'BSWSPE'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'WEBD' AND f.fun_application = 'BSUGRD' THEN 'EWSUSR'
            WHEN f.fun_class = 'WEBD' THEN 'BSUDSC'
       ELSE
            COALESCE(f.fun_application, f.fun_code)
       END,
       d.des_text,
       f.fun_class,
       e1.emn_group,
       d.des_lang
FROM r5extmenus e1,
     r5functions f,
     r5permissions p,
     r5descriptions d
WHERE d.des_rentity = 'FUNC'
AND p.prm_select = '?'
AND e1.emn_group = p.prm_group
AND e1.emn_function = p.prm_function
AND e1.emn_function = f.fun_code
AND e1.emn_function = d.des_code
AND e1.emn_type NOT IN ('F', 'M')
AND COALESCE(e1.emn_hide, '-') = '-'
AND COALESCE(e1.emn_mobile, '-') = '-'
AND COALESCE(e1.emn_meflag, 'E') <> 'B'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.F_MENU_HIDDEN_HIERARCHY(e1.emn_code) e2)
