CAST(IMP_RECEIVED AS NUMERIC(24,6)) IMP_RECEIVED,
IMP_INVOICED,
ORL_TAX,
ORL_TAX2,
ORL_SUPPLIER,
ORL_SUPPLIER_ORG,
IVL_INVOICE,
IVL_INVOICE_ORG,
ORL_RTYPE,
ORL_PART_ORG,
ORL_ORDER_ORG,
ORL_TYPE
from
(
select
	orl_order,
	orl_ordline,
	orl_ref,
	ivl_invqty IMP_ORDINVQTY,
	case when orl_rtype = 'SF' then
		(dbo.f_greatest_number( dbo.f_greatest_number( orl_price, ISNULL( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) ) -
			ISNULL( (SELECT SUM( ivl_invvalue * (CASE WHEN  inv_rtype = 'I' THEN 1 ELSE  -1 END) )
			FROM  r5invoices,  r5invoicelines
			WHERE  inv_code = ivl_invoice AND inv_org = ivl_invoice_org AND inv_rstatus <> 'C' AND
			ivl_order = orl_order  AND ISNULL( ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-' AND
			ivl_order_org = orl_order_org  AND ivl_ordline = orl_ordline ), 0 ), 0 )) else
		case when exists(select 1 from r5install where ins_code='INVECINC' and ins_desc in ('NO', 'COPY')) then
			orl_price else
			orl_price * ( 1 - ISNULL( orl_discperc, 0 ) / 100 ) + ( ISNULL( orl_totextra, 0 ) / (orl_ordqty / ISNULL( orl_multiply, 1 )) )
		end
	end IMP_PRICE,
	orl_part,
	orl_costcode,
	orl_event,
	orl_act,
	orl_trade,
	orl_task,
	orl_taskrev,
	orl_curr,
	orl_exch,
	case orl_rtype when N'SF' then orl_price else (orl_ordqty / coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 )) end IMP_ORDERED,
	case orl_rtype when N'SF' then coalesce( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) else (coalesce(orl_recvqty, 0) / coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 )) end IMP_RECEIVED,
	(SELECT coalesce( SUM(value),0) from (select case inv_rtype when 'C' then case inv_return when  N'+' then
												  case orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else -ivl_returnqty end else
												  case orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else ivl_returnqty end end
				 	  		  			 when 'D' then case inv_return when  N'+' then
										 	  	  case orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else -ivl_returnqty end else
										 	  	  case orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else ivl_returnqty end end
										 else case orl_rtype when N'SF' then ivl_invvalue else ivl_invqty end end as value
	FROM   r5invoices v, r5invoicelines ivl
	WHERE  v.inv_code = ivl.ivl_invoice
	AND    v.inv_org = ivl.ivl_invoice_org
	AND    v.inv_rstatus = 'A'
    AND    ISNULL( ivl.ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-' 
	AND    ivl.ivl_order = l.ORL_ORDER
	AND    ivl.ivl_ordline = l.ORL_ORDLINE
	AND    ivl.ivl_order_org = l.ORL_ORDER_ORG) inner1) IMP_INVOICED,
	orl_tax,
	orl_tax2,
	null ORL_SUPPLIER,
	null ORL_SUPPLIER_ORG,
	ivl_invoice,
	ivl_invoice_org,
	orl_rtype,
	orl_part_org,
	orl_order_org,
	orl_type
from r5invoicelines i, r5orderlines l
where
i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
and i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
and i.ivl_ordline = l.orl_ordline
AND ISNULL( i.ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-' 
UNION ALL
select
	orl_order,
	orl_ordline,
	orl_ref,
	round(coalesce(orl_ordqty,0)/coalesce(orl_multiply,1), 6) IMP_ORDINVQTY,
	case when orl_rtype = 'SF' then
		(dbo.f_greatest_number( dbo.f_greatest_number( orl_price, ISNULL( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) ) -
			ISNULL( (SELECT SUM( ivl_invvalue * (CASE WHEN  inv_rtype = 'I' THEN 1 ELSE  -1 END) )
			FROM  r5invoices,  r5invoicelines
			WHERE  inv_code = ivl_invoice AND inv_org = ivl_invoice_org AND inv_rstatus <> 'C' AND
			ivl_order = orl_order AND ISNULL( ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-'  AND
			ivl_order_org = orl_order_org  AND ivl_ordline = orl_ordline ), 0 ), 0 )) else
		case when exists(select 1 from r5install where ins_code='INVECINC' and ins_desc in ('NO', 'COPY')) then
			orl_price else
			orl_price * ( 1 - ISNULL( orl_discperc, 0 ) / 100 ) + ( ISNULL( orl_totextra, 0 ) / (orl_ordqty / ISNULL( orl_multiply, 1 )) )
		end
	end IMP_PRICE,
	orl_part,
	orl_costcode,
	orl_event,
	orl_act,
	orl_trade,
	orl_task,
	orl_taskrev,
	orl_curr,
	orl_exch,
	case orl_rtype when N'SF' then orl_price else (orl_ordqty / coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 )) end IMP_ORDERED,
	case orl_rtype when N'SF' then coalesce( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) else (coalesce(orl_recvqty, 0) / coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 )) end IMP_RECEIVED,
	(SELECT coalesce( SUM(value),0 ) from (select  case inv_rtype when 'C' then  case inv_return when '+' then case orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else -ivl_returnqty end else case orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else ivl_returnqty end end
				 	  		  			      when 'D' then case inv_return when '+' then case orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else -ivl_returnqty end else case  orl_rtype when N'SF' then -ivl_invvalue else ivl_returnqty  end  end
										 else case orl_rtype when N'SF' then ivl_invvalue else ivl_invqty end end as value
	FROM   r5invoices v, r5invoicelines i
	WHERE  v.inv_code = i.ivl_invoice
	AND    v.inv_org = i.ivl_invoice_org
	AND    v.inv_rstatus <> 'C'
    AND    ISNULL( i.ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-' 
	AND    i.ivl_order = l.ORL_ORDER
	AND    i.ivl_ordline = l.ORL_ORDLINE
	AND    i.ivl_order_org = l.ORL_ORDER_ORG) inner2) IMP_INVOICED,
	orl_tax,
	orl_tax2,
	orl_supplier,
	orl_supplier_org,
	null ivl_invoice,
	null ivl_invoice_org,
	orl_rtype,
	orl_part_org,
	orl_order_org,
	orl_type
from  r5orderlines l, r5orders o
where
orl_order = ord_code
and ORD_ORG     = ORL_ORDER_ORG
and ORD_RSTATUS = 'A'
AND ORL_RSTATUS in ('A', 'C', 'J')
AND
	(( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( CASE ORL_RSTATUS WHEN N'C' THEN 0 ELSE ORL_ORDQTY END, coalesce( ORL_RECVQTY, 0 ) - coalesce( orl_scrapqty, 0 ) ) / coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) >
		( SELECT coalesce( SUM( case inv_rtype
                                    when 'C' then case inv_return when N'+' then -ivl_returnqty else 0 end
									when 'D' then case inv_return when  N'+' then -ivl_returnqty else 0 end
									else ivl_invqty end ), 0 )
		FROM   r5invoicelines i, r5invoices v
		WHERE  v.inv_code = i.ivl_invoice
		AND v.inv_org = i.ivl_invoice_org
		AND v.inv_rstatus  <> 'C'
        AND ISNULL( i.ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-' 
 		AND i.ivl_order = orl_order
		AND i.ivl_ordline = orl_ordline
		AND i.ivl_order_org = orl_order_org )
	AND ORL_RTYPE <> 'SF' )
	OR
	( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( CASE ORL_RSTATUS WHEN N'C' THEN 0 ELSE ORL_PRICE END, coalesce( ORL_RECVVALUE, 0 ) ) >
	( SELECT coalesce( SUM( case inv_rtype when 'C' then -ivl_invvalue when 'D' then -ivl_invvalue else ivl_invvalue end), 0 )
	FROM  r5invoicelines i,r5invoices v
	WHERE v.inv_code = i.ivl_invoice
	AND v.inv_org = i.ivl_invoice_org
	AND v.inv_rstatus <> 'C'
    AND ISNULL( i.ivl_prepayment, N'-' ) = N'-' 
	AND i.ivl_order = orl_order
	AND i.ivl_ordline = orl_ordline
	AND i.ivl_order_org = orl_order_org )
	AND ORL_RTYPE = 'SF' ))
) Outer1

ORL_ROWID, FROM_LOCATIONID, CUSTOMERNUM, PONUM,

ITEMNUM, DESCRIPTION, QUANTITYCANCELED, REASON, 
QUANTITYORDERED, ORDORG, VENDORORG, ITEMORG, 
ORDERDATE )
AS 
SELECT ord.ord_sqlidentity ord_rowid,
         orl.orl_sqlidentity orl_rowid,
         mp5i.des_text FROM_LOCATIONID,
         mp5i.des_text CUSTOMERNUM,
         ord.ord_code PONUM,
         ord.ord_supplier VENDORID,
         otr.otr_controlnum POCONFIRMATIONNUM,
         ipv.ipv_desc TO_LOCATIONID,
         orl.orl_ordline ITEMID,
         orl.orl_part ITEMNUM,
         des.des_text DESCRIPTION,
         (orl.orl_ordqty - coalesce(orl.orl_recvqty,0) ) QUANTITYCANCELED,
         dbo.o7ipgtxt(N'PORLC', orl.orl_order, orl.orl_order_org, orl.orl_ordline) REASON,
         orl.orl_ordqty QUANTITYORDERED,

body:
CREATE VIEW R5IPORDERLINEAVAIL AS
SELECT orl.orl_sqlidentity orl_rowid,
       site.des_text SITENAME,
       mp5i.des_text COMPANYNAME,
       mp5i.des_text FROM_LOCATIONID,
       ipv.ipv_desc  TO_LOCATIONID,
       isnull(pord.adr_address1, isnull(poed.adr_address1, isnull(strd.adr_address1, deli.adr_address1 ))) SHIPTO_ADDRESS1,

       CASE WHEN pord.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN poed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_address2 
					 ELSE strd.adr_address2 END
				 ELSE poed.adr_address2 END
			ELSE pord.adr_address2  END SHIPTO_ADDRESS2,

	   CASE WHEN pord.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN poed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_address3
					  ELSE strd.adr_address3 END
				 ELSE poed.adr_address3 END
			ELSE pord.adr_address3  END SHIPTO_ADDRESS3,

	   CASE WHEN pord.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN poed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_city
					 ELSE strd.adr_city END
				 ELSE poed.adr_city END
			ELSE pord.adr_city  END SHIPTO_CITY,

		CASE WHEN pord.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN poed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_state
					 ELSE strd.adr_state END
				 ELSE poed.adr_state END
			ELSE pord.adr_state  END SHIPTO_STATE,

		CASE WHEN pord.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN poed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_zip
					 ELSE strd.adr_zip END
				 ELSE poed.adr_zip END
			ELSE pord.adr_zip  END SHIPTO_ZIP
  FROM  r5orderlines orl,
        r5descriptions mp5i,
        r5descriptions site,
        r5ipvendors ipv,
		r5companies com LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address deli ON
	        			deli.adr_code = N'*#' + com.com_org
   						AND deli.adr_rentity = N'COMP'
   						AND deli.adr_rtype = N'D',
	    r5orders ord   LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address strd ON
						strd.adr_code  = ord.ord_store
					    AND strd.adr_rentity  = N'STOR'
					    AND strd.adr_rtype  = N'D'	
							LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address pord ON
						pord.adr_code = ord.ord_code + N'#' + ord.ord_org
					    AND pord.adr_rentity = N'PORD'
					    AND pord.adr_rtype = N'D',
		r5entities ent LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address poed ON
						poed.adr_code = ent.ent_rentity
					    AND poed.adr_rentity = N'ENT'
					    AND poed.adr_rtype = N'D'
WHERE  ord.ord_code = orl.orl_order
   AND ord.ord_org = orl.orl_order_org
   AND ord.ord_supplier = com.com_code 
   AND ord.ord_supplier_org = com.com_org  
   AND com.com_ipvendor = ipv.ipv_code 
   AND ent.ent_table = N'R5ORDERS'
   AND mp5i.des_rentity = N'COMP'                          
   AND mp5i.des_code = N'*'
   AND mp5i.des_org = com.com_org
   AND mp5i.des_rtype = N'*'
   AND mp5i.des_lang = N'EN'
   AND site.des_rentity = N'ORG'  
   AND site.des_code = ord.ord_org
   AND site.des_org = N'*'
   AND site.des_lang = N'EN'
   AND site.des_rtype = N'*'
   AND NOT (deli.adr_code IS NULL AND poed.adr_code IS NULL AND strd.adr_code IS NULL AND pord.adr_code IS NULL)
   AND orl_rstatus = N'U'
   AND orl_rtype IN (N'PD', N'PS')

CREATE VIEW R5IPORDERLINES ( ORD_SQLIDENTITY, 
MP2ITEMID, USERITEMNUM, DESCRIPTION, ITEMCOMMENTS, 
QUANTITYREQUESTED, DUEDATE, UOP, UNITCOST, 
TOTAL,  VENDORITEMNUM, COSTCENTER ) AS 
  SELECT ord.ord_sqlidentity ord_rowid,
         orl.orl_ordline MP2ITEMID,
         orl.orl_part USERITEMNUM,
		 substring( par_desc, 1, CASE charindex( par_desc, N'::SupplierSessionID' )
								WHEN N'0' THEN  256
                 				ELSE charindex( par_desc, N'::SupplierSessionID' )  - 1 END ) +
         substring( cat_desc, CASE charindex( cat_desc, N'::SupplierSessionID' )
							   WHEN  0 THEN 2001
                 				ELSE charindex( cat_desc, N'::SupplierSessionID' ) END, 2000 ) DESCRIPTION,
         dbo.O7IPGTXT(N'PORL',orl.orl_order, orl.orl_order_org, orl_ordline) ITEMCOMMENTS,
         orl.orl_ordqty / isnull ( orl.orl_multiply, 1 ) QUANTITYREQUESTED,
		 convert(nvarchar(50), orl.orl_due, 101) DUEDATE,
         isnull ( orl.orl_puruom, N'EA' ) UOP,
         orl.orl_price UNITCOST,
         isnull ( orl.orl_ordqty / isnull ( orl.orl_multiply, 1 ) * orl.orl_price, 0 ) TOTAL,
         isnull(orl.orl_ref, isnull ( case orl.orl_rtype when N'RE' then cat.cat_repref else cat.cat_ref end, '' )) VENDORITEMNUM,
	     orl_costcode COSTCENTER
  FROM   r5orders ord, r5orderlines orl, r5parts par, r5catalogue cat
  WHERE  orl.orl_order = ord.ord_code
  AND    orl.orl_order_org = ord.ord_org
  AND    orl.orl_part = par.par_code
  AND    orl.orl_part_org = par.par_org
  AND    orl.orl_part = cat.cat_part
  AND    orl.orl_part_org = cat.cat_part_org
  AND    orl.orl_supplier = cat.cat_supplier
  AND    orl.orl_supplier_org = cat.cat_supplier_org
  AND    orl.orl_rtype IN (N'PD', N'PS', N'RE')
  AND    orl.orl_rstatus = N'A'
  AND   (orl.orl_ref IS NOT NULL OR case orl.orl_rtype when N'RE' then cat.cat_repref else cat.cat_ref end IS NOT NULL)

CREATE VIEW R5IPREQLINEAVAIL AS
SELECT rql.rql_sqlidentity rql_rowid,
       site.des_text SITENAME,
       mp5i.des_text COMPANYNAME,
       mp5i.des_text FROM_LOCATIONID,
       ipv.ipv_desc  TO_LOCATIONID,
       isnull(reqd.adr_address1, isnull(rqed.adr_address1, isnull(strd.adr_address1, deli.adr_address1 ))) SHIPTO_ADDRESS1,

	   CASE WHEN reqd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN rqed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_address2
					 ELSE strd.adr_address2 END
				 ELSE rqed.adr_address2 END
			ELSE reqd.adr_address2  END SHIPTO_ADDRESS2,

	   CASE WHEN reqd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN rqed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_address3
					 ELSE strd.adr_address3 END
				 ELSE rqed.adr_address3 END
			ELSE reqd.adr_address3  END SHIPTO_ADDRESS3,

       CASE WHEN reqd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN rqed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_city
					 ELSE strd.adr_city END
				 ELSE rqed.adr_city END
			ELSE reqd.adr_city  END SHIPTO_CITY,

      CASE WHEN reqd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN rqed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_state
					 ELSE strd.adr_state END
				 ELSE rqed.adr_state END
			ELSE reqd.adr_state  END SHIPTO_STATE,

	   CASE WHEN reqd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN
			CASE WHEN rqed.adr_address1 is NULL THEN 
				CASE WHEN strd.adr_address1 is NULL THEN deli.adr_zip
					 ELSE strd.adr_zip END
				 ELSE rqed.adr_zip END
			ELSE reqd.adr_zip  END SHIPTO_ZIP
  FROM  r5requislines rql,
        r5descriptions mp5i,
        r5descriptions site,
        r5ipvendors ipv,       
	    r5companies com LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address deli ON
	        			deli.adr_code = N'*#' + com.com_org
   						AND deli.adr_rentity = N'COMP'
   						AND deli.adr_rtype = N'D',
	    r5requisitions req LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address strd ON
						strd.adr_code  = req.req_tocode
					    AND strd.adr_rentity  = N'STOR'
					    AND strd.adr_rtype  = N'D'	
							LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address reqd ON
						reqd.adr_code = req.req_code
					    AND reqd.adr_rentity = N'REQ'
					    AND reqd.adr_rtype = N'D',
		r5entities ent LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address rqed ON
						rqed.adr_code = ent.ent_rentity
					    AND rqed.adr_rentity = N'ENT'
					    AND rqed.adr_rtype = N'D'
												
WHERE  req.req_code = rql.rql_req
   AND rql.rql_supplier = com.com_code 
   AND rql.rql_supplier_org = com.com_org  
   AND com.com_ipvendor = ipv.ipv_code 
   AND ent.ent_table = N'R5REQUISITIONS'
   AND mp5i.des_rentity = N'COMP'                          
   AND mp5i.des_code = N'*'
   AND mp5i.des_org = com.com_org
   AND mp5i.des_rtype = N'*'
   AND mp5i.des_lang = N'EN'
   AND site.des_rentity = N'ORG'

CREATE VIEW R5IPRETURNITEMS
(TRA_ROWID, FROM_LOCATIONID, CUSTOMERNUM, PONUM, VENDORID, 
 POCONFIRMATIONNUM, TO_LOCATIONID, ITEMID, ITEMNUM, DESCRIPTION, 
 QUANTITYRETURNED, ORDORG, VENDORORG, ITEMORG, REASON, 
 ORDERDATE)
AS 
SELECT tra.tra_sqlidentity tra_rowid,
         mp5i.des_text FROM_LOCATIONID,
         mp5i.des_text CUSTOMERNUM,
         tra.tra_order PONUM,
         ord.ord_supplier VENDORID,
         otr.otr_controlnum POCONFIRMATIONNUM,
         ipv.ipv_desc TO_LOCATIONID,
         trl.trl_ordline ITEMID,
         trl.trl_part ITEMNUM,
         des.des_text DESCRIPTION,
         trl.trl_qty QUANTITYRETURNED,
         ord.ord_org ORDORG,
         ord.ord_supplier_org VENDORORG,
         trl.trl_part_org ITEMORG,
         trl.trl_rejectreason REASON,
         ord.ord_date ORDERDATE
    FROM r5transactions tra,
         r5translines trl,
         r5orders ord,
         r5descriptions mp5i,
         r5descriptions des,
         r5companies com,
         r5ipvendors ipv,
         r5ordertracking otr
   WHERE tra.tra_code =trl.trl_trans
     AND tra_rstatus = N'A'
     AND tra_rtype = N'RETN'
     AND tra.tra_order = ord.ord_code
     AND tra.tra_order_org = ord.ord_org
     AND ord.ord_supplier = com.com_code                     -- join to MP5i supplier record
     AND ord.ord_supplier_org = com.com_org                  -- join to MP5i supplier record
     AND com.com_ipvendor = ipv.ipv_code
     AND mp5i.des_rentity = N'COMP' -- join to descriptions to retrieve customer name (from org)
     AND mp5i.des_code = N'*'
     AND mp5i.des_org = com.com_org
     AND mp5i.des_lang = N'EN'
     AND mp5i.des_rtype = N'*'
     AND ord.ord_code = otr.otr_order
     AND ord.ord_org  = otr.otr_order_org
     AND otr.otr_tracktype = N'POTR'
     AND des.des_rentity = N'PART'
     AND des.des_code = trl.trl_part
     AND des.des_org = trl.trl_part_org
     AND des.des_lang = N'EN'
     AND des.des_rtype = N'*'
     AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                     FROM   r5ordertracking otr2
                     WHERE  ord.ord_code = otr2.otr_order
                     AND    ord.ord_org  = otr2.otr_order_org
                     AND    otr2.otr_tracktype = N'POTR'
                     AND    otr2.otr_gendate > otr.otr_gendate )

name: R5MSPI_O7CREMPLOYEESCHEDULE
body:
create procedure R5MSPI_O7CREMPLOYEESCHEDULE(@sProject nvarchar(20),
										     @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
										     @nAct     numeric(8),
										     @sTrade   nvarchar(15))


as
        DECLARE @sDeparment nvarchar(15)
        DECLARE @sScheduleDate  datetime
        DECLARE @sScheduleValue numeric(24,6)
        DECLARE @sResource      nvarchar(30)
        DECLARE @sShift         nvarchar(4)
        DECLARE @sScheduler     nvarchar(255)
        DECLARE @sComment       nvarchar(60)
        DECLARE cur_employee CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR
		SELECT  r.mrs_sched,
		        r.mrs_schedvalue,
		        r.mrs_resource,
		        r.mrs_shift,
		        r.mrs_scheduler,
		        r.mrs_comment
		FROM    r5mpresourceschedule r
		WHERE   r.mrs_mpproj = @sProject
		AND     r.mrs_event  = @sEvent
		AND     r.mrs_act    = @nAct
		AND     r.mrs_resource_type = N'PERS'
		AND     EXISTS (SELECT 1
		                FROM   r5personnel p
		                WHERE  p.per_code = r.mrs_resource)


       OPEN cur_employee
       FETCH NEXT FROM cur_employee
       INTO  @sScheduleDate,@sScheduleValue,@sResource,@sShift,@sScheduler,@sComment
       WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
       BEGIN
         set @sDeparment = dbo.R5MSPI_O7GETEMPLOYEEDEPT(@sResource)
         set @sScheduleDate = dbo.f_trunc_date(@sScheduleDate,'DD')
         INSERT INTO r5actschedules (acs_mpproj,
	                                 acs_event,
	                                 acs_activity,
	                                 acs_trade,
	                                 acs_mrc,
	                                 acs_sched,
	                                 acs_hours,
	                                 acs_responsible,
	                                 acs_shift,
	                                 acs_scheduler,
	                                 acs_comment)
	    VALUES (@sProject,
	            @sEvent,
	            @nAct,
	            @sTrade,
	            @sDeparment,
	            @sScheduleDate,
	            @sScheduleValue,
	            @sResource,
	            @sShift,
	            @sScheduler,
	            @sComment)
          FETCH NEXT FROM cur_employee
          INTO  @sScheduleDate,@sScheduleValue,@sResource,@sShift,@sScheduler,@sComment
        END
        CLOSE cur_employee
        DEALLOCATE cur_employee


-- ========================================

		AND     EXISTS (SELECT 1
		                FROM   r5objects o
		                WHERE  o.obj_code = r.mrs_resource
		                AND    o.obj_org  = r.mrs_resource_org)


       OPEN cur_equipment

         INSERT INTO r5actschedules (acs_mpproj,

	                                 acs_hours,
	                                 acs_object,
	                                 acs_object_org,
	                                 acs_shift,

	                                 acs_comment)
	    VALUES (@sProject,

	            @nAct,
	            @sTrade,
	            @sDeparment,
	            @sScheduleDate,
	            @sScheduleValue,
	            @sResource,
	            @sResourceorg,
	            @sShift,

          FETCH NEXT FROM cur_equipment

name: R5MSPI_O7CRPRED
body:
create procedure R5MSPI_O7CRPRED		@sPreds		nvarchar(500),
										@sEvent		nvarchar(30),
										@sAct		nvarchar(8),
										@sProject	nvarchar(30)

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @sVEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sVAct				numeric(8)
	declare @nPrednum			integer
	declare @sVPreds			nvarchar(500)
	declare @sVPred				nvarchar(50)
	declare @nVCommapos			integer
	declare @nVPoundpos			integer
	declare @nPnum				integer
	declare @nTempPred			integer
	declare @sTempEvtCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nTempAct			numeric(8)



begin

	set @sVPreds	= @sPreds
	set @sVPred		= null
	set @nPnum		= 1
	set @nVCommapos = 1

	declare @tPredtable table (	 Prednum integer, EventCode nvarchar(30), Act numeric(8) )

	if @sVPreds is null
		return

	WHILE @nVCommapos > 0
		BEGIN
			set @nVCommapos = charindex(N',', @sVPreds)
			IF @nVCommapos > 0
				begin
					set @sVPred = SUBSTRING(@sVPreds, 1, @nVCommapos - 1)
					set @sVPreds = SUBSTRING(@sVPreds, @nVCommapos + 1, len(@sVPreds) - (@nVCommapos ) )
				end
			ELSE
				set @sVPred = @sVPreds

			set @nVPoundpos = charindex(N'#', @sVPred)
			IF @nVPoundpos > 0
				begin
					set @nPrednum     = SUBSTRING(@sVPred,    1, @nVPoundpos -1 )
					set @sVEvent       = SUBSTRING(@sVPred,    @nVPoundpos +1 , len(@sVPred) - @nVPoundpos)
					set @sVAct         = SUBSTRING(@sVEvent,   charindex(N'#', @sVEvent)+1, len(@sVEvent) - charindex(N'#', @sVEvent))
					set @sVEvent       = SUBSTRING(@sVEvent,   1, charindex(N'#', @sVEvent)-1)

					insert into @tPredtable values ( @nPrednum, @sVEvent, @sVAct )
					set @nPnum = @nPnum +1
				end

			IF @nVCommapos = 0
				BREAK
		END

	DELETE FROM r5mppredecessors
	WHERE  mpd_event     = @sEvent
	AND    mpd_act       = convert(numeric(8),@sAct)
	AND    mpd_mpproj    = @sProject

	DELETE FROM r5predecessors
	WHERE  pds_event = @sEvent
	AND    pds_act   = convert(numeric(8),@sAct)


	declare c_temptable cursor local for select	Prednum, EventCode, Act
									FROM @tPredtable
	open c_temptable
	fetch next from c_temptable into @nTempPred, @sTempEvtCode, @nTempAct
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
		
			-- To avoid creating circular predecessors
			DELETE FROM r5mppredecessors
			WHERE  mpd_event     = @sTempEvtCode
			AND    mpd_act       = @nTempAct
			AND    mpd_predevent = @sEvent
			AND    mpd_predact   = convert(numeric(8),@sAct)
			AND    mpd_mpproj    = @sProject

			DELETE FROM r5predecessors
			WHERE  pds_event = @sTempEvtCode
			AND    pds_act   = @nTempAct
			AND    pds_predevent = @sEvent
			AND    pds_predact   = convert(numeric(8),@sAct)
		
			INSERT INTO r5mppredecessors(mpd_mpproj,
				mpd_event,
				mpd_act,
				mpd_pred,
				mpd_predevent,
				mpd_predact)
			VALUES (                     @sProject,
				@sEvent,
				convert(numeric(8),@sAct),
				@nTempPred,
				@sTempEvtCode,
				@nTempAct)

			INSERT INTO r5predecessors(pds_event,
				pds_act,
				pds_pred,
				pds_predevent,
				pds_predact)
			VALUES (                   @sEvent,
				convert(numeric(8),@sAct),
				@nTempPred,
				@sTempEvtCode,
				@nTempAct)

			fetch next from c_temptable into @nTempPred, @sTempEvtCode, @nTempAct
  		end
	close c_temptable
	deallocate c_temptable

END

create procedure R5MSPI_O7CRSCH		@sResources  nvarchar(2000),

    SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @dTodate				datetime
	declare @nVcommapos				integer
	declare @nVpoundpos				integer
	declare @nPnum					integer
	declare @nTnum					integer
	declare @nCnum					integer
	declare @nDnum					integer
	declare @nDnum1					integer
	declare @nDnum2					integer
	declare @nOnum					integer
	declare @nVtotalunits			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVpershours			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVdayhours				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVschhours				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVmaxhours				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVhoursperemp			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVtotalhours			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVavghours				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVhrremaining			numeric(24,6)

	declare @bMatchdate				integer
	declare @bUseavghours			integer

	declare @dTempDate	datetime

	declare @nPerIndex				integer
	declare @sPerInitial			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sPerOrg				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nPerUnits				numeric(7,2)

	declare @nToolIndex				integer
	declare @sToolInitial			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sToolOrg				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nToolUnits				numeric(7,2)

	declare @nObjIndex				integer
	declare @sObjInitial			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sObjOrg				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nObjUnits				numeric(7,2)

	declare @nCompIndex				integer

	declare @sCompOrg				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nCompUnits				numeric(7,2)
	declare @nShifthours			numeric(24,6)

	declare @nMaxSchIndex			integer
	declare @nMaxSchNumber			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sDepartment			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sShift					nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn				integer

	set @sVresources	= @sResources



	if @sVresources IS NULL
		RETURN

	set @dCdate	= @dStart
	set @dTdate	= @dStart
	set @dOdate	= @dStart
	set @nVcommapos = 1

	set @sVresource	= NULL
	set @sVtype		= NULL
	set @sVresname	= NULL
	set @sVresorg	= NULL
	set @sVresunits	= NULL
	set @sVeqpunits	= NULL
	set @sVexit		= N'NO'
	set @nPnum	= 1
	set @nTnum	= 1
	set @nCnum	= 1
	set @nDnum	= 1
	set @nDnum1	= 1
	set @nDnum2	= 1
	set @nOnum	= 1
	set @nVtotalunits = 0
	set @nVmaxhours = 0

	DELETE FROM r5actschedules
	WHERE  acs_event     = @sEvent
	AND    acs_activity  = @nAct
	AND    acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL
	AND    acs_mpproj  IS NOT NULL

	DELETE FROM r5mpactschedules
	WHERE  msa_event     = @sEvent
	AND    msa_act       = @nAct
	AND    msa_mpproj = @sProject

	DELETE FROM r5toolreq
	WHERE  tor_event   = @sEvent
	AND    tor_act     = @nAct
	AND    tor_mpproj IS NOT NULL


	DELETE FROM r5mpactresassignment
	WHERE  maa_event = @sEvent
	AND    maa_act   = @nAct

	CREATE TABLE #tPers (nIndex integer, Initial nvarchar(30), Org nvarchar(15), Units numeric(7,2))
	CREATE TABLE #tTool (nIndex integer,Initial nvarchar(30), Org nvarchar(15), Units numeric(7,2))
	CREATE TABLE #tObj (nIndex integer,Initial nvarchar(30), Org nvarchar(15), Units numeric(7,2))
	CREATE TABLE #tComp (nIndex integer,Initial nvarchar(30), Org nvarchar(15), Units numeric(7,2))
	CREATE TABLE #tDates (Dates datetime)
	CREATE TABLE #tMaxSchhrs (nIndex integer, Numbers numeric(24,6))

  	while @nVcommapos <> 0
		begin
			set @nVcommapos = charindex(',' , @sVresources)
			if @nVcommapos > 0
				begin
					set @sVresource = SUBSTRING(@sVresources, 1, @nVcommapos-1)
					set @sVresources  = SUBSTRING(@sVresources, @nVcommapos+1, len(@sVresources) - @nVcommapos )
				end
			else
				set @sVresource = @sVresources

		    set @nVpoundpos = charindex(N'#', @sVresource)

			if @nVpoundpos > 0
				begin
					set @sVtype     = SUBSTRING(@sVresource, 1, @nVpoundpos-1)
					set @sVresname  = SUBSTRING(@sVresource, @nVpoundpos+1, len(@sVresource) - @nVpoundpos)
					set @sVresorg   = SUBSTRING(@sVresname,  charindex(N'#', @sVresname )+1, len(@sVresname) - charindex(N'#', @sVresname))
					set @sVresunits = SUBSTRING(@sVresorg,   charindex(N'#', @sVresorg)+1, len(@sVresorg) - charindex(N'#', @sVresorg))
					set @sVresunits = ROUND(@sVresunits, 2)

					set @sVresname  = SUBSTRING(@sVresname, 1, charindex(N'#', @sVresname)-1)
					set @sVresorg   = SUBSTRING(@sVresorg,  1, charindex(N'#', @sVresorg)-1)

					if @sVtype = N'PERS'
						begin
							INSERT INTO #tPers Select @nPnum, @sVresname, @sVresorg, @sVresunits
							set @nVtotalunits = @nVtotalunits + convert(numeric(24,6),coalesce(@sVresunits, N'0'))
							set @nPnum = @nPnum +1
						end
					if @sVtype ='TOOL'
						begin
							INSERT INTO #tTool Select @nTnum, @sVresname, @sVresorg, @sVresunits
							set @nTnum = @nTnum +1
						end
					if @sVtype ='COMP'
						begin
							INSERT INTO #tComp  Select @nCnum, @sVresname, @sVresorg, @sVresunits
							set @nCnum = @nCnum +1
						end
					if @sVtype ='OBJ'
						begin
							INSERT INTO #tObj  Select @nOnum, @sVresname, @sVresorg, @sVresunits
							set @nOnum = @nOnum +1
						end
				end
		end


	-- Create schedules and personnel resource record
	if @nVtotalunits > 0
		begin
		    set @nVhoursperemp = ROUND(@nHours/(@nPnum - 1),2)

			declare cPers cursor local for select nIndex, Initial, Org, Units FROM #tPers order by nIndex
			open cPers

					set @dCdate      = @dStart
					set @nVtotalhours = 0
					set @nVavghours = 0
					set @nDnum1 = 1
					set @bUseavghours = 0

					-- 06/29/04 SRH - This code is following the Oracle code verbatum. The Oracle code does
					-- not reset the temporary table before adding new values.  I could not tell if this was intended or a bug in Oracle.
					-- If this changes in Oracle make sure to reset the temporary table.

					-- loop through each day to see if assigned personnel can handle the task
					while @dCdate BETWEEN @dStart AND (DATEADD(dd, @nDuration -1, @dStart  ) )

							set @nVpershours = ROUND(@nShifthours*@nPerUnits/100, 2)

							--	Since they do not reset the temporary table in Oracle. We need to
							--	clear the temporary table of nIndex you are about to insert.
							DELETE FROM #tMaxSchhrs where  nIndex = @nDnum1
							INSERT INTO #tMaxSchhrs  Select @nDnum1, @nVpershours

					IF @nVtotalhours < @nVhoursperemp -- divide work evenly into each day
						begin

							set @bUseavghours = 1
						end

					set @dCdate			= @dStart
					set @nVdayhours		= 0

create procedure R5MSPI_O7CRSCHEWS(@sEvent       nvarchar(30),
                                   @nAct         numeric(8),
                                   @sProject     nvarchar(20),
                                   @sTrade       nvarchar(20),
                                   @sMrc         nvarchar(20),
                                   @nHours       numeric(24,6))


as
  declare @nReturn			integer
  -- clean up schedule tables
  DELETE FROM r5actschedules
  WHERE  acs_event     = @sEvent
  AND    acs_activity  = @nAct
  AND    acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL
  AND    (acs_responsible IS NOT NULL OR acs_object IS NOT NULL);

  DELETE FROM r5toolreq
  WHERE  tor_event   = @sEvent
  AND    tor_act     = @nAct;

  DELETE FROM r5mpassignedsuppliers
  WHERE  mas_event = @sEvent
  AND    mas_act   = @nAct;



  -- create employee records

  execute @nReturn = R5MSPI_O7CREMPLOYEESCHEDULE @sProject,@sEvent,@nAct, @sTrade
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
     return -1
  -- create maintenance equipment schedule

  execute @nReturn = R5MSPI_O7CREQUIPMENTSCHEDULE @sProject,@sEvent,@nAct, @sTrade
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
     return -1

  -- Create tool request and tool resource record

  execute @nReturn = R5MSPI_O7CRTOOLREQUEST @sProject,@sEvent,@nAct,@nHours,@sMrc
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
     return -1

  -- Create supplier resource record

  execute @nReturn = R5MSPI_O7CRSUPPLIERSCHEDULE @sProject,@sEvent,@nAct
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
     return -1

  -- clean tempory schedule table

  DELETE FROM r5mpresourceschedule
  WHERE mrs_mpproj = @sProject
  AND   mrs_event  = @sEvent
  AND   mrs_act    = @nAct;

create procedure R5MSPI_O7CRSUPPLIERSCHEDULE(@sProject nvarchar(20),

										     @nAct     numeric(8))


as
        DECLARE @sScheduleDate  datetime
        DECLARE @sScheduleValue numeric(24,6)
        DECLARE @sResource      nvarchar(30)
        DECLARE @sResourceorg   nvarchar(15)
        DECLARE cur_supplier CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR
		SELECT  r.mrs_sched,
		        r.mrs_schedvalue,
		        r.mrs_resource,

		WHERE   r.mrs_mpproj = @sProject
		AND     r.mrs_event  = @sEvent
		AND     r.mrs_act    = @nAct
		AND     r.mrs_resource_type = N'COMP'
		AND     EXISTS (SELECT 1
		                FROM   r5companies c
		                WHERE  c.com_code = r.mrs_resource
		                AND    c.com_org  = r.mrs_resource_org)


       OPEN cur_supplier

       WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
       BEGIN
         set @sScheduleDate = dbo.f_trunc_date(@sScheduleDate,'DD')

	     VALUES (@sProject,
	             @sEvent,
	             @nAct,
	             @sScheduleDate,
	             @sScheduleValue,
	             @sResource,
	             @sResourceorg)
          FETCH NEXT FROM cur_supplier
          INTO  @sScheduleDate,@sScheduleValue,@sResource,@sResourceorg
        END
        CLOSE cur_supplier
        DEALLOCATE cur_supplier

create procedure R5MSPI_O7EQUIPMENT		@sProject	nvarchar(20),
										@sOrg	nvarchar(15)

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrg2				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassorg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(255)
begin

	SELECT  @sUser = mpj_user
	FROM    r5mpprojects
	WHERE   mpj_code = @sProject

	declare cObject cursor local for SELECT obj_code,
											obj_desc,
											obj_org,
											obj_class,
											obj_class_org,
											obj_obtype

											FROM  r5objects
											WHERE obj_production = N'-'
											AND   obj_rstatus <> N'D'
											AND   obj_notused = N'-'
											AND   obj_code <> N'*'
											AND   EXISTS ( SELECT  NULL
												 FROM    r5userorganization
												 WHERE   uog_org  = obj_org
												 AND     uog_user = @sUser
												 AND     (uog_org = @sOrg
												 OR      uog_common= N'+'))


	OPEN cObject
	FETCH NEXT FROM cObject INTO @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg2, @sClass, @sClassorg, @sObtype
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO r5mpequipment( meq_mpproj,
					 meq_code,
					 meq_org,
					 meq_desc,
					 meq_class,
					 meq_class_org,
					 meq_objtype,
					 meq_resourcetype,
					 meq_msresourcetype)
				VALUES (                   @sProject,
					 @sCode,
					 @sOrg2,
					 @sDesc,
					 @sClass,
					 @sClassorg,
					 @sObtype,
					 N'OBJ',
					 N'MATERIAL')

				FETCH NEXT FROM cObject INTO @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg2, @sClass, @sClassorg, @sObtype

create function R5MSPI_O7GETCOMMENT (@sEventAct nvarchar(100), @sLang nvarchar(2))
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
	declare @sReturn nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sText nvarchar(4000)

	/*Note add_text is a long in the database - yet the Oracle version selects it into
	a varchar2(8000).  This procedure is following the same logic as the Oracle.
	This could change.  Due the restrictions of nvarchar the local variable is only
	nvarchar(4000)
	*/

	declare cComment cursor local for SELECT add_text
												FROM   r5addetails
												WHERE  add_rentity = N'EVNT'
												AND    add_rtype   = N'*'
												AND    add_lang    = @sLang
												AND    add_code    = @sEventAct

	set @sReturn = null

	OPEN cComment
	FETCH NEXT FROM cComment INTO @sText
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				set @sReturn = coalesce(@sReturn,'') + @sText
				FETCH NEXT FROM cComment INTO @sText
			END
	CLOSE cComment
	DEALLOCATE cComment

	return(@sReturn)
end

create function R5MSPI_O7GETRESOURCE (@sEvent nvarchar(100), @nAct numeric(8), @sLang nvarchar(2))
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
	declare @sResource		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sComma			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sResinitial	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sResunits		nvarchar(10)
	declare @sRestype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sResorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(50)

	set @sResource		= NULL
	set @sComma			= N''


	declare cResource cursor local for SELECT coalesce(maa_resinitial, N''),
										coalesce(maa_resunits, N''),
										coalesce(maa_restype, N''),
										coalesce(maa_resorg, N'')
										FROM   r5mpactresassignment
										WHERE  maa_event = @sEvent
										AND    maa_act   = @nAct

	OPEN cResource
	FETCH NEXT FROM cResource INTO @sResinitial, @sResunits, @sRestype, @sResorg
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				set @sDesc = N''
				IF @sResource IS NOT NULL
					set @sComma = N','

				IF @sRestype = N'PERS'
					begin
						set @sResource = coalesce(@sResource, N'') + @sComma + @sResinitial +  N'[' + @sResunits + N']' + N'%'
					end

				IF @sRestype = N'TOOL'
					begin
						set @sDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'TOOL' , @sResinitial  , NULL , NULL )
						set @sResource = coalesce(@sResource, N'') + @sComma + @sDesc +  N'[' + @sResunits + N']'
					end
				IF @sRestype = N'COMP'
					begin
						set @sDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'COMP' , @sResinitial  , NULL , NULL )
						set @sResource = coalesce(@sResource, N'') + @sComma + @sDesc +  N'[' + @sResunits + N']' + N'%'
					end
				IF @sRestype = N'OBJ'
					begin
						set @sTemp = @sResinitial + N'#' + @sResorg
						set @sDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'COMP' , @sResinitial  , NULL , NULL )
						set @sResource = coalesce(@sResource, N'') + @sComma + @sDesc +  N'[' + @sResunits + N']'
					end

				FETCH NEXT FROM cResource INTO @sResinitial, @sResunits, @sRestype, @sResorg
			END
	CLOSE cResource
	DEALLOCATE cResource

	return(@sResource)

end

create procedure R5MSPI_O7MPACTS

   @dDatefrom       DATETIME,
   @dDateto         DATETIME,
   @sEvttype        nvarchar(4),
   @sEvtstatus      nvarchar(4),

   @sChild_obj       nvarchar(30),

   @sProject        nvarchar(20),
   @sPriority       nvarchar(8),

AS

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sSel_Clause_evt		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sSel_Clause_act		nvarchar(4000)

	declare @sExtra_act				nvarchar(4000)

	declare @sIns_Clause_act		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nCursor_in_evt			INTEGER
	declare @nCount_proj			INTEGER
	declare @nCount_obj				INTEGER
	declare @nCount_mrc				INTEGER
	declare @sEvent					nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtdesc				nvarchar(80)

	declare @nDuration				numeric(18, 0)
	declare @dTarget				datetime
	declare @nAct					numeric(8)
	declare @sActcompl				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nPersons				numeric(8)
	declare @dActstart				datetime
	declare @nBooked				numeric(18,0)
	declare @sActdesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @dMatrdate				datetime
	declare @nPerccompleted			numeric(3)
	declare @sPrjorg				nvarchar(15) --r5mpprojects.mpj_org%TYPE
	declare @sCharfrom				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sCharto				nvarchar(8)

	declare @sEvtcode 				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtmrc				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvtjobtype			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sEvtpriority			nvarchar(8)
	declare @dEvttarget				datetime
	declare @dEvtstart				datetime
	declare @nEvtduration			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvtobject				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtobject_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvtproject			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sEvtrstatus			nvarchar(4)

	declare @nActact				numeric(8)
	declare @nActrem				numeric(18, 0)
	declare @nActduration			numeric(8)
	declare @nActest				numeric(18, 0)
	declare @sActtrade				nvarchar(15)
	declare @nActpersons			numeric(8)
	declare @sActcompleted			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nActpercomplete		numeric(3)

	declare @sOutput				nvarchar(6)
	declare @sActresources			nvarchar(1000)
	declare @nReturn				integer
	declare @sEvtComment			nvarchar(4000)

	declare @dActTarget				datetime
	declare	@sActtradedesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sActcomment			nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sActNote   			nvarchar(256)


	set @sExtra = N''
	set @sExtra_act = N''


	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01011900'),
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01012100' )


	set @sChk = N'0'
	if @sMrc IS NULL AND @sObject IS NULL AND @sProject IS NULL
		begin
			SELECT 1
			FROM r5mpschedgroups
			WHERE mpg_rentity = N'OBJ'
			AND   mpg_mpproj  = @sMpproject
			set @nCount_obj = @@ROWCOUNT


			SELECT 1
			FROM r5mpschedgroups
			WHERE mpg_rentity = N'PROJ'
			AND   mpg_mpproj  = @sMpproject
			set @nCount_proj = @@ROWCOUNT


			SELECT 1
			FROM r5mpschedgroups
			WHERE mpg_rentity = N'MRC'
			AND   mpg_mpproj  = @sMpproject
			set @nCount_mrc = @@ROWCOUNT


			if (@nCount_obj + @nCount_proj + @nCount_mrc = 0 )
				begin
				  set @sChk= N'1'
				  RETURN
				end
		end

	set @sSel_Clause_evt =
	'declare cEvt cursor local for SELECT evt_code, evt_desc, evt_mrc, evt_jobtype, evt_priority, evt_target,  evt_start,
		 evt_duration, evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_project, evt_status, evt_rstatus
	FROM r5events
	WHERE evt_target IS NOT NULL
	AND   evt_target >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
	AND   evt_target <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) '

	SELECT @sPrjorg = mpj_org
	FROM   r5mpprojects
	WHERE  mpj_code = @sMpproject

	if @sSesstype = N'A'
		begin

			else
			set @sExtra = @sExtra + N'AND evt_status  = N''' + @sEvtstatus +
					 N''' AND evt_rstatus = N''R'' '
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sEvtstatus IS NULL
				set @sExtra = @sExtra + N'AND evt_rstatus IN ( N''C'',N''R'') '
			else
				set @sExtra = @sExtra + N'AND evt_status  = N''' + @sEvtstatus +
					 N''' AND evt_rstatus IN ( N''C'',N''R'') '
		end


	if @sEvttype IS NOT NULL
		set @sExtra = @sExtra + N'AND evt_jobtype = N'''+ @sEvttype + N''' '

	if @sPriority IS NOT NULL
		set @sExtra = @sExtra + N'AND evt_priority = N'''+ @sPriority + N''' '

	if @sObject IS NOT NULL
		begin
			if coalesce(@sChild_obj, N'-') = N'+'
				set @sExtra = @sExtra +  N' AND ( evt_object + N''#'' + evt_object_org ) IN
				( ( SELECT  stc_child N''#'' stc_child_org
						FROM dbo.R5MSPI_O7MPACTS_GET_HIERARCHY1( ''' + @sObject + N''',''' +  @sObjectorg + N''')
					UNION
					SELECT N''' + @sObject + N'#' + @sObjectorg + N''')'
			else
				set @sExtra = @sExtra + N'AND evt_object     = ''' + @sObject + N''' AND evt_object_org = ''' + @sObjectorg + N''' '
		end

	if @sProject IS NOT NULL
		set @sExtra = @sExtra + N'AND evt_project IN
		( ( SELECT  prj_code
				FROM dbo.R5MSPI_O7MPACTS_GET_HIERARCHY2( ''' + @sProject + N''')
			UNION
			SELECT N''' + @sProject + N''' ) '


	if  @sGroup = N'+'
		begin

		   AND   mpg_mpproj  = @sMpproject


			if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
				begin
					if coalesce(@sChild_obj, N'-') = N'+'
						set @sExtra = @sExtra +  N' AND evt_object + N''#'' + evt_object_org IN
						( SELECT  stc_child + N''#'' + stc_child_org
							FROM dbo.R5MSPI_O7MPACTS_GET_HIERARCHY3( ''' + @sMpproject + N''')
							UNION
							SELECT mpg_code + N''#'' + mpg_code_org
							FROM   r5mpschedgroups
							WHERE  mpg_mpproj = N'''+ @sMpproject + N'''
							AND    mpg_rentity = N''OBJ'' ) '
					else
						set @sExtra = @sExtra + N' AND (evt_object + N''#'' + evt_object_org) IN
						( SELECT mpg_code + N''#'' + mpg_code_org
						FROM   r5mpschedgroups
						WHERE  mpg_mpproj = N''' + @sMpproject + N'''
						AND    mpg_rentity = N''OBJ'') '
				end

			SELECT 1
			FROM r5mpschedgroups
			WHERE mpg_rentity = N'PROJ'
			AND   mpg_mpproj  = @sMpproject

			if @@ROWCOUNT > 0

				( SELECT  prj_code
					FROM dbo.R5MSPI_O7MPACTS_GET_HIERARCHY4( ''' + @sMpproject + N''')
				UNION
				( SELECT mpg_code
				FROM r5mpschedgroups
				WHERE  mpg_mpproj = N'''+ @sMpproject + N'''
				AND    mpg_rentity = N''PROJ'' ) ) '

			SELECT 1

			if @@ROWCOUNT > 0

create function R5MSPI_O7MPACTS_GET_HIERARCHY1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)

	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30),
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_childrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		select	stc_child,
				stc_child_org,
				stc_childtype,
				stc_childrtype,
				1
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org,
							@sCurrentType	= stc_childtype,
							@sCurrentRtype	= stc_childrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg  and stc_childrtype = @sCurrentRtype
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child,
												stc_child_org,
												stc_childtype,
												stc_childrtype,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and
												stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	 and
												stc_parentrtype = @sCurrentRtype
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0

						stc_child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin

	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)

	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30),
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_childrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		select	stc_child,
				stc_child_org,
				stc_childtype,
				stc_childrtype,
				1
		  from	r5structures
		 where	( stc_parent + N'#' + stc_parent_org ) IN
					( SELECT mpg_code + N'#' +  mpg_code_org
					FROM   r5mpschedgroups
					WHERE  mpg_mpproj = @sCode

	SET @nLevel = 1

							@sCurrentRtype	= stc_childrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg  and stc_childrtype = @sCurrentRtype
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child,
												stc_child_org,

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0

				END

				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create procedure R5MSPI_O7MPEQUIPMENTS
   @sMpsession      nvarchar(20),
   @sEquipment            nvarchar(3000)
AS

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nToken_position            integer
    declare @sTempEquipments            nvarchar(3000)
    declare @sEquipNameandorg           nvarchar(60)
    declare @sEquipName                 nvarchar(40)
    declare @sEquipOrg                  nvarchar(15)

    declare @sCode                      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrg                       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc                      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sClass                     nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassorg                  nvarchar(15)
    declare @sObtype                    nvarchar(4)
	declare @nTempTokenPosition			integer

   /* @sEquipment string example: EQUIP1%ORG1#EQUIP2%ORG1#EQUIP3%ORG2 */
   /* # and % are special characters and not allowed to input in front-end */

    set @nToken_position = 1
    set @sTempEquipments = @sEquipment
    set @sTempEquipments = @sTempEquipments + N'#^'

	WHILE @nToken_position > 0
	    BEGIN
            set @nToken_position    = charindex(N'#', @sTempEquipments)
            set @sEquipNameandorg   = SUBSTRING(@sTempEquipments, 1, @nToken_position-1)
            set @sTempEquipments    = SUBSTRING(@sTempEquipments, @nToken_position+1, len(@sTempEquipments) - @nToken_position)

            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'%', @sEquipNameandorg)
			if @nToken_position < 1
				begin
					set @nToken_position = 1
					set @nTempTokenPosition = 0
				end
			else
				set @nTempTokenPosition = @nToken_position

            set @sEquipName = SUBSTRING(@sEquipNameandorg, 1, @nToken_position-1)
            set @sEquipOrg = SUBSTRING(@sEquipNameandorg, @nTempTokenPosition+1, len(@sEquipNameandorg) - @nTempTokenPosition)

            if exists (select 1 FROM   r5objects
                                WHERE  obj_code = @sEquipName
                                AND    obj_org = @sEquipOrg )
                begin
                    SELECT  @sCode = obj_code,
                            @sDesc = obj_desc,
                            @sOrg = obj_org,
                            @sClass = obj_class,
                            @sClassorg = obj_class_org,
                            @sObtype = obj_obtype
                    FROM    r5objects
                    WHERE   obj_code = @sEquipName   AND
                            obj_org = @sEquipOrg


                    INSERT INTO r5mpequipment( meq_mpproj,
                                                meq_code,
                                                meq_org,
                                                meq_desc,
                                                meq_class,
                                                meq_class_org,
                                                meq_objtype,
                                                meq_resourcetype,
                                                meq_msresourcetype)
                    VALUES(  @sMpsession,
                                @sCode,
                                @sOrg,
                                @sDesc,
                                @sClass,
                                @sClassorg,
                                @sObtype,
                                N'OBJ',
                                N'WORK')
                end
            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'#', @sTempEquipments)
        END
        -- add required equipment
        DECLARE cur_requiredobj CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR
		SELECT o.obj_code,
		       o.obj_desc,
		       o.obj_org,
		       o.obj_class,
		       o.obj_class_org
		FROM   r5objects o
		WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT NULL
		               FROM   r5mpactivities a, r5actschedules s
		               WHERE  a.mpa_event        = s.acs_event
		               AND    a.mpa_act          = s.acs_activity
		               AND    s.acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL
		               AND    a.mpa_mpproj       = @sMpsession
		               AND    s.acs_object       = o.obj_code
		               AND    s.acs_object_org   = o.obj_org)
		               AND   NOT EXISTS (SELECT NULL
		                                 FROM   r5mpequipment e2
		                                 WHERE  e2.meq_mpproj =  @sMpsession
		                                 AND    e2.meq_code   = o.obj_code
                                         AND    e2.meq_org    = o.obj_org)

       OPEN cur_requiredobj
       FETCH NEXT FROM cur_requiredobj
       INTO  @sCode,@sDesc,@sOrg,@sClass,@sClassorg
       WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
       BEGIN
         INSERT INTO r5mpequipment( meq_mpproj,
                                    meq_code,
                                    meq_org,
                                    meq_desc,
                                    meq_class,
                                    meq_class_org,
                                    meq_objtype,
                                    meq_resourcetype,
                                    meq_msresourcetype)
         VALUES(  @sMpsession,
                  @sCode,
                  @sOrg,
                  @sDesc,
                  @sClass,
                  @sClassorg,
                  @sObtype,
                  N'OBJ',
                  N'WORK')
          FETCH NEXT FROM cur_requiredobj
          INTO  @sCode,@sDesc,@sOrg,@sClass,@sClassorg
        END
        CLOSE cur_requiredobj
        DEALLOCATE cur_requiredobj


-- ========================================

create procedure R5MSPI_O7MPPERS
   @sMpsession      nvarchar(20),
   @sEmployees      nvarchar(3000)
AS
   /* employees string example: employname1#employname2#employname3 */

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nToken_position         integer
    declare @sTempEmployees          nvarchar(3000)
    declare @sEmployeeName           nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCode                   nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOrg                    nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc                   nvarchar(80)
    declare @sClass                  nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassorg               nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTrade                  nvarchar(15)
    declare @sMrc                    nvarchar(15)

    set @sTempEmployees = @sEmployees
    set @sTempEmployees = @sTempEmployees  + N'#^'
    set @nToken_position = 1


	WHILE @nToken_position > 0
	    BEGIN
            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'#', @sTempEmployees)
            set @sEmployeeName = SUBSTRING(@sTempEmployees, 1, @nToken_position-1)
            set @sTempEmployees = SUBSTRING(@sTempEmployees, @nToken_position+1, len(@sTempEmployees) )

            if exists (select 1 from r5personnel WHERE per_code = @sEmployeeName AND per_schedulingsessionid IS NULL )
                begin

                    SELECT  @sCode = per_code,
                            @sDesc = per_desc,
                            @sOrg = per_org,
                            @sClass = per_class,
                            @sClassorg = per_class_org,
                            @sTrade = per_trade,
                            @sMrc = per_mrc
                    FROM   r5personnel
                    WHERE  per_code = @sEmployeeName

                    INSERT INTO r5mppersonnel(mpp_mpproj,
                                                mpp_code,
                                                mpp_org,
                                                mpp_desc,
                                                mpp_class,
                                                mpp_class_org,
                                                mpp_trade,
                                                mpp_mrc,
                                                mpp_resourcetype,
                                                mpp_msresourcetype)
                    VALUES(  @sMpsession,
                            @sCode,
                            @sOrg,
                            @sDesc,
                            @sClass,
                            @sClassorg,
                            @sTrade,
                            @sMrc,
                            N'PERS',
                            N'WORK')

                    UPDATE r5personnel
                    SET per_schedulingsessionid = @sMpsession,
                        per_schedulingtype = 'MSPR'
                    WHERE per_code = @sCode;
                end
            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'#', @sTempEmployees)
        END

        -- add required employees
        DECLARE cur_requiredpers CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR
		SELECT p.per_code,
		       p.per_desc,
		       p.per_org,
		       p.per_class,
		       p.per_class_org
		FROM   r5personnel p
		WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT NULL
		               FROM   r5mpactivities a, r5actschedules s
		               WHERE  a.mpa_event        = s.acs_event
		               AND    a.mpa_act          = s.acs_activity
		               AND    s.acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL
		               AND    a.mpa_mpproj       = @sMpsession
		               AND    s.acs_responsible  = p.per_code)
		               AND   NOT EXISTS (SELECT NULL
		                                 FROM   r5mppersonnel p2
		                                 WHERE  p2.mpp_mpproj =  @sMpsession
		                                 AND    p2.mpp_code   = p.per_code)

       OPEN cur_requiredpers
       FETCH NEXT FROM cur_requiredpers
       INTO  @sCode,@sDesc,@sOrg,@sClass,@sClassorg
       WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
       BEGIN
          INSERT INTO r5mppersonnel(mpp_mpproj,
                                    mpp_code,
                                    mpp_org,
                                    mpp_desc,
                                    mpp_class,
                                    mpp_class_org,
                                    mpp_trade,
                                    mpp_mrc,
                                    mpp_resourcetype,
                                    mpp_msresourcetype)
          VALUES(  @sMpsession,
                   @sCode,
                   @sOrg,
                   @sDesc,
                   @sClass,
                   @sClassorg,
                   @sTrade,
                   @sMrc,
                   N'PERS',
                   N'WORK')

          UPDATE r5personnel
          SET per_schedulingsessionid = @sMpsession,
              per_schedulingtype = 'MSPR'
          WHERE per_code = @sCode;

          FETCH NEXT FROM cur_requiredpers
          INTO  @sCode,@sDesc,@sOrg,@sClass,@sClassorg
       END
        CLOSE cur_requiredpers
        DEALLOCATE cur_requiredpers

create function R5MSPI_O7MPPRIO (@sPriority nvarchar(30), @sMapflag nvarchar(15))
returns nvarchar(8)
as
begin
	declare @sReturn nvarchar(8)
	declare @Localrowcount integer

	IF @sMapflag = N'TO'
		begin
			SELECT @sReturn = mpr_rprior
			FROM   r5mppriorities
			WHERE  mpr_uprior = @sPriority
			AND    mpr_system = N'+'
			set @Localrowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sMapflag = N'FROM'
				IF @sPriority IS NOT NULL
					begin
						SELECT @sReturn = mpr_uprior
						FROM   r5mppriorities
						WHERE  mpr_rprior = @sPriority
						AND    mpr_system = N'+'
						set @Localrowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
					end
				ELSE
					set @sReturn =  null
			ELSE
				set @sReturn =  N'F'
		end

	if @Localrowcount  <> 1
		begin
			if @Localrowcount  = 0
				begin
					if  @sMapflag = N'TO'
						set @sReturn = N'500'
					else
						set @sReturn = null
				end
			else
			   set @sReturn = N'F'
		end

	return(@sReturn)
end

create procedure R5MSPI_O7MPTOOLS
   @sMpsession      nvarchar(20),
   @sTools            nvarchar(3000)
AS
   /* @sTools string example: tool1#tool2#tool3 */

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nToken_position		integer
    declare @sTempTools				nvarchar(3000)
    declare @sToolname				nvarchar(12)
    declare @sCode					nvarchar(12)
    declare @sOrg					nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc					nvarchar(80)
    declare @sClass					nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassorg				nvarchar(15)

    set @sTempTools = @sTools
    set @sTempTools = @sTempTools  + N'#^'
    set @nToken_position = 1

	WHILE @nToken_position > 0
	    BEGIN
            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'#', @sTempTools)
            set @sToolname = SUBSTRING(@sTempTools, 1, @nToken_position-1)
            set @sTempTools = SUBSTRING(@sTempTools, @nToken_position+1, len(@sTempTools) - @nToken_position)

            if exists (select 1 from r5tools WHERE  too_code = @sToolname )
                begin
                    SELECT @sCode = too_code,
                        @sDesc = too_desc,
                        @sOrg = too_org,
                        @sClass = too_class,
                        @sClassorg = too_class_org
                    FROM   r5tools
                    WHERE  too_code = @sToolname

                    INSERT INTO r5mptool( mto_mpproj,
                                            mto_code,
                                            mto_org,
                                            mto_desc,
                                            mto_class,
                                            mto_class_org,
                                            mto_resourcetype,
                                            mto_msresourcetype)
                    VALUES(  @sMpsession,
                                @sCode,
                                @sOrg,
                                @sDesc,
                                @sClass,
                                @sClassorg,
                                N'TOOL',
                                N'MATERIAL')
                end
            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'#', @sTempTools)
        END
        -- add required tool
        DECLARE cur_requiredtool CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR
		SELECT t.too_code,
		       t.too_desc,
		       t.too_org,
		       t.too_class,
		       t.too_class_org
		FROM   r5tools t
		WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT NULL
		               FROM   r5mpactivities a, r5toolreq t1
		               WHERE  a.mpa_event        = t1.tor_event
		               AND    a.mpa_act          = t1.tor_act
		               AND    a.mpa_mpproj       = @sMpsession
		               AND    t1.tor_tool        = t.too_code)
		               AND   NOT EXISTS (SELECT NULL
		                                 FROM   r5mptool t2
		                                 WHERE  t2.mto_mpproj =  @sMpsession
		                                 AND    t2.mto_code   =  t.too_code)

       OPEN cur_requiredtool

create procedure R5MSPI_O7MPWOACTS
   @sMPschdsession 	        nvarchar(20),
   @sWOActs 	    	    nvarchar(max),
   @sSesstype       	    nvarchar (4),
   @sLang 			        nvarchar(8)
AS
 /* @sWOActs string example: eventcode1%act1#eventcode2%act2#eventcode3%act3 */
 /* # and % are special characters and not allowed to be included in code name */

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nToken_position  			integer
    declare @sTempWOActs 		    	nvarchar(max)
    declare @sEventcode 				nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEventandact 				nvarchar(35)
    declare @sEvtcomment				nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nActivitynum            	numeric(8)
    declare @nPerccompleted             numeric(24,6)
    declare @nBookedhours               numeric(24,6)
    declare @dBookeddate                datetime
    declare @sActdesc				    nvarchar(80)
    declare @dMatrdate					datetime
    declare @sActresource				nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sActcomment				nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nPriority					numeric(8)
    declare @sTemp 				        nvarchar(max)
    declare @sTemp1 				    nvarchar(40)
    declare @nNumberofwo 				numeric(4)
    declare @nEvtfound                  numeric(3)
    declare @nWorepeatlocation 		    numeric(8)

    declare @sEvtCode                   nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvtDesc                   nvarchar(80)
    declare @sEvtMrc                    nvarchar(15)
    declare @sEvtJobtype                nvarchar(8)
    declare @sEvtPriority               nvarchar(8)
    declare @dEvtTarget                 datetime
    declare @dEvtStart                  datetime
    declare @nEvtDuration               numeric(8,0)
    declare @sEvtObject                 nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvtObjectorg              nvarchar(15)
    declare @sEvtProject                nvarchar(20)
    declare @sEvtStatus                 nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEvtRstatus                nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEvtMpproj                 nvarchar(20)
    declare @nActact					numeric(8)
    declare @nActrem					numeric(24,6)
    declare @nActDuration				numeric(8)
    declare @dActStart					datetime
    declare @nActEst					numeric(24,6)
    declare @nActTrade					nvarchar(15)
    declare @nActPersons				numeric(8)
    declare @sActCompleted				nvarchar(1)
    declare @nActpercomplete 			numeric(3)
    declare @sTemp2						nvarchar(100)
	declare @nTempTokenPosition			integer
	declare @sActNote   				nvarchar(80)


    set @sTempWOActs = @sWOActs
    set @sTempWOActs = @sTempWOActs  + N'#^'
    set @nToken_position    = 1
    set @nNumberofwo        = 0

    /*initializing variables for first pass when cursor has not been fetched...*/
    set @sEvtPriority = null
    set @nActrem = null
    set @nActpercomplete = null
    set @sEvtCode = null

    --keep @sTemp from always being null
    set @sTemp = N''

	WHILE @nToken_position > 0
	    BEGIN
            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'#', @sTempWOActs)
            set @sEventandact = SUBSTRING(@sTempWOActs, 1, @nToken_position-1)
            set @sTempWOActs = SUBSTRING(@sTempWOActs, @nToken_position+1 , len(@sTempWOActs))

            set @nToken_position = charindex(N'%', @sEventandact )
			if @nToken_position < 1
				begin
					set @nToken_position = 1
					set @nTempTokenPosition = 0
				end
			else
				set @nTempTokenPosition = @nToken_position

            set @sEventcode = SUBSTRING(@sEventandact, 1, @nToken_position-1)
            set @nActivitynum = SUBSTRING(@sEventandact, @nTempTokenPosition+1 , len(@sEventandact) )

            set @nNumberofwo = @nNumberofwo + 1
            set @sTemp1 = @sEventcode

            /* to find out the wo is aleady insert before */
            IF(@nNumberofwo = 1)
                set @nWorepeatlocation =0
            ELSE
                set @nWorepeatlocation = isnull( charindex(@sEventcode, @sTemp ), 0 )

            set @sTemp = @sTemp + N'#' + @sTemp1


            set @sEvtcomment = dbo.R5MSPI_O7GETCOMMENT(@sEventcode,@sLang)


            IF NOT (@nWorepeatlocation > 0)
                begin
                    set @nEvtfound = 0

                    If exists (SELECT 1 FROM r5events
                               WHERE  evt_code = @sEventcode)
                        set @nEvtfound = 1

                    if @nEvtfound = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from r5mpevents
                                where mpe_mpproj = @sMPschdsession
                                  and mpe_event = @sEventcode )
                        begin

                            SELECT @sEvtCode = evt_code,
                            @sEvtDesc = evt_desc,
                            @sEvtMrc = evt_mrc,
                            @sEvtJobtype = evt_jobtype,
                            @sEvtPriority = evt_priority,
                            @dEvtTarget = evt_target,
                            @dEvtStart = evt_start,
                            @nEvtDuration = evt_duration,
                            @sEvtObject = evt_object,
                            @sEvtObjectorg = evt_object_org,
                            @sEvtProject = evt_project,
                            @sEvtStatus = evt_status,
                            @sEvtRstatus = evt_rstatus,
                            @sEvtMpproj = evt_mpproj
                            FROM   r5events
                            WHERE  evt_code = @sEventcode

                            /*30352 - Line moved here since sEvtPriority is not fetched until now and nPriority is only used in this IF block*/
                            set @nPriority = cast(dbo.R5MSPI_O7MPPRIO( @sEvtPriority , N'TO' ) as numeric(8,0))


                            /* Check mandatory parameters for r5mpevents */
                            IF @dEvtTarget IS NOT NULL AND @sEvtJobtype IS NOT NULL
                                begin
                                    /* Check other conditions */
                                    IF @sSesstype = N'A' AND COALESCE(@sEvtMpproj,N'-') = N'-'
                                        begin

                                            set @nEvtfound = 1
                                            /* insert data into r5mpevents */
                                            INSERT INTO r5mpevents(mpe_mpproj,
                                            mpe_event,
                                            mpe_evtdesc,
                                            mpe_mrc,
                                            mpe_jobtype,
                                            mpe_priority,
                                            mpe_target,
                                            mpe_evtstart,
                                            mpe_duration,
                                            mpe_object,
                                            mpe_object_org,
                                            mpe_project,
                                            mpe_evtstatus,
                                            mpe_evtrstatus,
                                            mpe_comment)
                                            VALUES(@sMPschdsession,
                                            @sEvtCode,
                                            @sEvtDesc,
                                            @sEvtMrc,
                                            @sEvtJobtype,
                                            @nPriority,
                                            @dEvtTarget,
                                            @dEvtStart,
                                            @nEvtDuration,
                                            @sEvtObject,
                                            @sEvtObjectorg,
                                            @sEvtProject,
                                            @sEvtStatus,
                                            @sEvtRstatus,

create procedure R5MSPI_O7OBINST		@sOutput nvarchar(6) OUTPUT,
										@sObject       nvarchar(30),
										@sObjectorg    nvarchar(15),
										@sChkobj      nvarchar(4)


as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sChild		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sChildOrg		nvarchar(15)


	IF @sObject = N'%'
		begin
			set @sOutput = N'%'
			return
		end

	IF @sChkobj = N'-'
		begin
			set @sOutput = N'FALSE'
			return
		end

	/*NOTE:  The Oracle code was written in such a way that if either @sObject or @sObjectorg will always
		be equal unless the values are null.  This is due to the union clause of the cursor.  Since this is the case,
		it is better to just check for null on these two variables instead of cursoring through recordsets.
	*/

	if @sObject = null or @sObjectorg = null
		set @sOutput = N'FALSE'
	else
		set @sOutput = N'TRUE'

	return

create procedure R5MSPI_O7OBJECTINCLASS			@sOutput nvarchar(6) OUTPUT,
										@sObject       nvarchar(30),
										@sObjectorg    nvarchar(15),
										@sObjectclass  nvarchar(8),
										@sObjectclsorg nvarchar(15),
										@sChkobj      nvarchar(4)


as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sParentOrg		nvarchar(15)
	if @sObjectclass IS NULL
		begin
			set @sOutput = N'TRUE'
			return
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			if @sObjectclass  = dbo.R5MSPI_O7OBJECTCLASS( @sObject, @sObjectorg ) AND @sObjectclsorg = dbo.R5MSPI_O7OBJECTCLSORG( @sObject, @sObjectorg )
				begin
					set @sOutput = N'TRUE'
					return
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					if @sChkobj = N'+'
						begin
							declare c_objects cursor local for select	stc_parent,	stc_parent_org
																		FROM   dbo.r5mspi_o7objectinclass_get_hierarchy1 (@sObject, @sObjectorg)
							open c_objects
							fetch next from c_objects into 	@sParent, @sParentOrg
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									if @sObjectclass  = dbo.R5MSPI_O7OBJECTCLASS( @sParent,@sParentOrg ) AND @sObjectclsorg =  dbo.R5MSPI_O7OBJECTCLSORG( @sParent, @sParentOrg )
										begin
											set @sOutput = N'TRUE'
											close c_objects
											deallocate c_objects
											return
										end
									fetch next from c_objects into 	@sParent, @sParentOrg
								end
							close c_objects
							deallocate c_objects

						end
				end
		end

	set @sOutput = N'FALSE'
	return

create function R5MSPI_O7OBJECTINCLASS_GET_HIERARCHY1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_parent		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)

	declare @tStack table ( stc_parent		nvarchar(30),
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_parentrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		select	stc_parent,
				stc_parent_org,
				stc_parentrtype,
				1
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_child		= @sCode	and
				stc_child	= @sOrg

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_parent,
							@sOrg	= stc_parent_org,
							@sCurrentRtype	= stc_parentrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCode and stc_parent_org = @sOrg  and stc_parentrtype = @sCurrentRtype
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_parent,
												stc_parent_org,
												stc_parentrtype,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_child		= @sCode	and
												stc_child_org	= @sOrg	 and
												stc_childrtype = @sCurrentRtype
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

		begin

		return -1

	UPDATE r5mpprojects
	SET    mpj_rstatus = @sVStatus,
		   mpj_status  = @sCStatus
	WHERE  mpj_code    = @sProject
end

CREATE VIEW R5MULTIORGPARTLIST ( PAR_CODE, 
PAR_ORG, PAR_DESC, PAR_CLASS, PAR_CATEGORY, 
PAR_TOOL, PAR_UOM, PAR_BUYER, PAR_PREFSUP, 
PAR_TRACKTYPE, PAR_WARDAYS, PAR_COMMODITY, PAR_SUBCOMMODITY, 
PAR_TAX, PAR_CODESTRUCTURE, PAR_INSMETHOD, PAR_PREFSUPPRICE, 
PAR_PREFUOM, PAR_BYASSET, PAR_BYLOT, PAR_NOTUSED, 
PAR_INSPECT, OBJ_CODE, OBJ_MRC, OBJ_CLASS, 
OBJ_MANUFACT, OBJ_MANUFACTMODEL, OBJ_MANUFACTREVNUM, OBJ_VARIABLE1, 
OBJ_VARIABLE2, OBJ_VARIABLE3, OBJ_VARIABLE4, OBJ_VARIABLE5, 
OBJ_VARIABLE6, UOG_USER, PPR_BASEPRICE, PPR_AVGPRICE, 
PPR_LASTPRICE, PPR_STDPRICE, PPR_PRICETYPE, PPR_CREDIT, 
PPR_COREVALUE )
AS 
SELECT par_code, par_org, par_desc, par_class, par_category, par_tool, par_uom, par_buyer, par_prefsup,
	   par_tracktype, par_wardays, par_commodity, par_subcommodity, par_tax, par_codestructure, par_insmethod,
	   par_prefsupprice, par_prefuom, par_byasset, par_bylot, par_notused, par_inspect, obj_code, obj_mrc,
	   obj_class, obj_manufact, obj_manufactmodel, obj_manufactrevnum, obj_variable1, obj_variable2,
	   obj_variable3, obj_variable4, obj_variable5, obj_variable6, uog_user, ppr_baseprice, ppr_avgprice,
	   ppr_lastprice, ppr_stdprice, ppr_pricetype, ppr_credit, ppr_corevalue
FROM   r5partprices,
       r5organization,
       r5userorganization u1,
       r5install,
       r5objects RIGHT OUTER JOIN 
       r5parts ON  par_code = obj_part 
			AND    par_org  = obj_part_org 
			AND    obj_obrtype = N'I'
WHERE  par_code <> N'*'
AND    par_code = ppr_part
AND    par_org  = ppr_part_org
AND    par_org  = org_code
AND    ins_code = N'DEFORG'
AND    ( u1.uog_default = N'+' OR ( u1.uog_org = ins_desc AND NOT EXISTS
       ( SELECT N'x'
         FROM   r5userorganization u2
         WHERE  u2.uog_user = u1.uog_user
         AND    u2.uog_default = N'+' ) ) )
AND    CASE org_common WHEN N'-' THEN par_org ELSE
		CASE u1.uog_common WHEN N'-' THEN u1.uog_org ELSE N'x' END END = ppr_org
AND    par_org in ( SELECT u2.uog_org FROM r5permissions, r5userorganization u2
                      WHERE  u2.uog_user  = u1.uog_user
                      AND    u2.uog_group = prm_group
            AND    prm_select   = N'?'
            AND    prm_function = N'SSPART' )
UNION
SELECT par_code, par_org, par_desc, par_class, par_category, par_tool, par_uom, par_buyer, par_prefsup,
       par_tracktype, par_wardays, par_commodity, par_subcommodity, par_tax, par_codestructure, par_insmethod,
       par_prefsupprice, par_prefuom, par_byasset, par_bylot, par_notused, par_inspect, obj_code, obj_mrc,
       obj_class, obj_manufact, obj_manufactmodel, obj_manufactrevnum, obj_variable1, obj_variable2,
       obj_variable3, obj_variable4, obj_variable5, obj_variable6, uog_user, cast(null as numeric),
       cast(null as numeric), cast(null as numeric), cast(null as numeric), NULL, cast(null as numeric), cast(null as numeric)
FROM   r5organization,
       r5userorganization u1,
       r5install,
       r5objects RIGHT OUTER JOIN 
       r5parts ON  par_code = obj_part 
			AND    par_org  = obj_part_org 
			AND    obj_obrtype = N'I'
WHERE  par_code <> N'*'
AND    par_org  = org_code
AND    ins_code = N'DEFORG'
AND    ( u1.uog_default = N'+' OR ( u1.uog_org = ins_desc AND NOT EXISTS
       ( SELECT N'x'
         FROM   r5userorganization u2
         WHERE  u2.uog_user = u1.uog_user
         AND    u2.uog_default = N'+' ) ) )
AND    ((CASE org_common WHEN N'-' THEN '-' ELSE
          CASE u1.uog_common WHEN N'-' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END END = N'+')

           AND    ppr_org = CASE org_common WHEN N'-' THEN par_org ELSE

name: R5O7CONS_VALUE_OF
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE R5O7CONS_VALUE_OF (	@sReturn		nvarchar(8) OUTPUT,
										@sConst_Type	NVARCHAR(8), 
										@sConst_Name	NVARCHAR(9))

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @sCode			NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @sDefault		NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @sCheckresult	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @nReturn		INT
	DECLARE @sResult		NVARCHAR(3)

	SET @sCheckresult = N'0'

	SELECT @sCode =
			CASE UPPER(@sConst_Type)
				WHEN N'MODULE' THEN
						CASE UPPER(@sConst_Name)
							WHEN N'B' THEN N'MODULE_B'
							WHEN N'C' THEN N'MODULE_C'
							WHEN N'G' THEN N'MODULE_G'
							WHEN N'I' THEN N'MODULE_I'
							WHEN N'J' THEN N'MODULE_J'
							WHEN N'O' THEN N'MODULE_O'
							WHEN N'P' THEN N'MODULE_P'
							WHEN N'Q' THEN N'MODULE_Q'
							WHEN N'R' THEN N'MODULE_R'
							WHEN N'S' THEN N'MODULE_S'
							WHEN N'T' THEN N'MODULE_T'
							WHEN N'U' THEN N'MODULE_U'
							WHEN N'Y' THEN N'MODULE_Y'
							WHEN N'W' THEN N'MODULE_W'
							ELSE N'+'
						END
				WHEN N'OPTION' THEN
						CASE UPPER(@sConst_Name)
							WHEN N'CLOSING'	THEN N'OPT_CLOS'
							WHEN N'DOCS'	THEN N'OPT_DOCS'
							WHEN N'SYSTEM'	THEN N'OPT_SYS'
							WHEN N'FUNCPOS'	THEN N'OPT_FUNP'
							WHEN N'TAGS'	THEN N'OPT_TAGS'
							WHEN N'MSPROJS'	THEN N'OPT_MSPR'
							WHEN N'STWO'	THEN N'OPT_STWO'
							WHEN N'PERMITS'	THEN N'OPT_PERM'
							WHEN N'ROOT'	THEN N'OPT_ROOT'
							WHEN N'DIAG'	THEN N'OPT_DIAG'
							WHEN N'BARCODE'	THEN N'OPT_BARC'
							WHEN N'MCSARCH'	THEN N'OPT_MCSA'
							ELSE N'+'
						END
				WHEN N'CONSTANT' THEN
						CASE UPPER (@sConst_Name)
							WHEN N'PRICELEV' THEN N'PRICELEV'
							ELSE N'+'
						END
				ELSE N'+'
			END

			IF @sCode = N'+'
				SET @sReturn = '+'
			ELSE
				EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sReturn OUTPUT, @sCode, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

name: R5O7_O7CKCODE

create procedure R5O7_O7CKCODE	@sRcode		nvarchar(4)	output,
								@sUcode		nvarchar(8)	output,
								@sRentity	nvarchar(4),
								@sChk		nvarchar(4)	output
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sResult		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @nReturn		int

	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @sResult = null
	set @nCountit = 0

	if (@sRcode is null and @sUcode is null) or @sRentity is null
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	if not exists( select 1 FROM  r5entities WHERE ent_rentity = @sRentity )
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	if @sUcode is not null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sResult OUTPUT, @sUcode, @sRentity, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult = N'0'
				set @sRcode = @sResult
			else
				set @sChk = @sCheckresult
			return
		end

	if @sRcode is null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sResult OUTPUT, @sUcode, @sRentity, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult = N'0'
				set @sRcode = @sResult
			else
				set @sChk = @sCheckresult

			return
		end

	if @sUcode is null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sResult OUTPUT, @sRcode, @sRentity, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult = N'0'
				set @sUcode = @sResult
			else
				set @sChk = @sCheckresult

			return
		end
