create procedure R5O7_O7EXIST	@sRentity	nvarchar(10),
								@sEnttype	nvarchar(4),
								@sEntcode	nvarchar(100),
								@sOrgcode	nvarchar(15),
								@sPar1		nvarchar(8),
								@sPar2		nvarchar(4),
								@sPar3		nvarchar(4),
								@sPar4		nvarchar(4),
								@sPar5		nvarchar(4),
								@nCountit	int				OUTPUT,
								@sChk		nvarchar(10)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SET @sChk = N'0'
	SET @nCountit = -1

	if @sRentity is null or @sEnttype is null or @sEntcode is null
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	if @sRentity <> N'R5CLAS'
		begin
			select @nCountit = count(*) from r5entities where ent_rentity = @sRentity
			if @nCountit < 1
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', 2
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sPar1 is null and @sPar2 is null and @sPar3 is null and @sPar4 is null and @sPar5 is null
		begin
			select	@nCountit = count(*)
			  FROM	r5descriptions  d
			 WHERE  d.des_code      = @sEntcode
			 AND    d.des_org       = coalesce(@sOrgcode,d.des_org)
			 AND    d.des_rentity   = @sRentity

			if @nCountit > 0
				SET @nCountit = 1
			return
		end

	SET @nCountit = -1

	if @sRentity = N'OBJ'
		begin
			if @sPar1 = N'CLAS'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM	r5objects o
					 WHERE	o.obj_class     = @sEntcode
					 AND    o.obj_class_org = @sOrgcode

					if @nCountit > 0
						SET @nCountit = 1
					return
				end
			if @sPar1 = N'CAT'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM	r5objects o
			         WHERE  o.obj_category = @sEntcode

					if @nCountit > 0
						SET @nCountit = 1
					return
				end
			if @sPar1 = N'MRC'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM	r5objects o
			         WHERE  o.obj_mrc  = @sEntcode

					if @nCountit > 0
						SET @nCountit = 1
					return
				end
			if @sPar1 = N'STAT'
				begin
					if @sPar2 = N'>='
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM	r5objects     o
							 WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sEntcode
							 AND    o.obj_obtype  = @sEnttype
							 AND    o.obj_status  >= @sPar3
							return
						end

					if @sPar2 = N'<='
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM	r5objects     o
							 WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sEntcode
							 AND    o.obj_obtype  = @sEnttype
							 AND    o.obj_status  <= @sPar3
							return
						end

					-- if we get here then do the following
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM	r5objects     o
					 WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sEntcode
					 AND    o.obj_obtype  = @sEnttype
					 AND    o.obj_status  = @sPar3

					return
				end

			--if we get here then there is an error
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', 2
			return -1
		end

	if @sRentity in ( N'EVNT', N'ENT', N'RECO', N'ACCO', N'CAUS', N'FAIL', N'CLAS', N'IND', N'PROM', N'R5CLAS' )
		begin
			if @sRentity = N'EVNT'
				begin
					if @sPar1 = N'ACTV'
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM	r5activities a
							 WHERE  a.act_event  = @sEntcode

							if @nCountit > 0
								SET @nCountit = 1
							return
						end

					if @sPar1 = N'PROJ'
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM	r5events e
							 WHERE  e.evt_project = @sEntcode

							if @nCountit > 0
								SET @nCountit = 1
							return
						end

					if @sPar1 = N'PROJ?'
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM	r5events e
							 WHERE  e.evt_code    = @sEntcode
							 AND    e.evt_project = @sPar2
							return
						end

					if @sPar1 = N'CHILD'
						begin
							if @sPar2 = N'DEPEND'
								begin
									select	@nCountit = count(*)
									  FROM	r5events e
									 WHERE  e.evt_parent  = @sEntcode
									 AND    e.evt_depend IS NOT NULL
									 AND    e.evt_rstatus <> N'C'

									if @nCountit > 0
										SET @nCountit = 1
									return
								end
						end

					if @sPar1 = N'OPENFP'
						return
				end

			if @sRentity = N'ENT'
				begin
					if @sPar1 = N'RCOD'
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM  r5rcodes r
							 WHERE  r.rco_rentity = @sEnttype
							 AND    r.rco_rcode   = @sEntcode

							if @nCountit > 0
								SET @nCountit = 1
							return
						end

					if @sPar1 = N'UCOD'
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM  r5ucodes      u
							 WHERE  u.uco_rentity = @sEnttype
							 AND    u.uco_code    = @sEntcode

							if @nCountit > 0
								SET @nCountit = 1
							return
						end
				end

			if @sRentity = N'RECO'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM  r5requircodes r
					 WHERE  r.rqm_code = @sEntcode
					 AND  ( r.rqm_gen  = N'+'
							OR EXISTS (
							   SELECT NULL
							   FROM   r5reqclasses r
							   WHERE  r.rcl_reqm      = @sEntcode
							   AND    r.rcl_class     = @sPar1
					 AND    r.rcl_class_org = @sOrgcode ) )
					return
   				end

			if @sRentity = N'ACCO'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM  r5actioncodes a
					 WHERE  a.acc_code = @sEntcode
					 AND  ( a.acc_gen  = N'+'
							OR EXISTS (
							   SELECT NULL
							   FROM   r5actclasses l
							   WHERE  l.acl_action = @sEntcode
							   AND    l.acl_class  = @sPar1
					   AND    l.acl_class_org = @sOrgcode) )
					return
   				end

			if @sRentity = N'CAUS'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM  r5causes c
					 WHERE  c.cau_code = @sEntcode
					 AND  ( c.cau_gen  = N'+'
							OR EXISTS (
							   SELECT NULL
							   FROM   r5causeclasses l
							   WHERE  l.cac_cause = @sEntcode
							   AND    l.cac_class  = @sPar1
					   AND    l.cac_class_org = @sOrgcode ) )
					return
   				end

			if @sRentity = N'FAIL'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM  r5failures f
					 WHERE  f.fal_code = @sEntcode
					 AND  ( f.fal_gen  = N'+'
							OR EXISTS (
							   SELECT NULL
							   FROM   r5failureclasses l
							   WHERE  l.fca_failure = @sEntcode
							   AND    l.fca_class   = @sPar1
					   AND    l.fca_class_org = @sOrgcode) )
  					return
   				end

			if @sRentity = N'CLAS' OR @sRentity = N'IND'
				begin
					select	@nCountit = count(*)
					  FROM  r5classes      c
					 WHERE  c.cls_rentity = @sEnttype
					 AND    c.cls_code    = @sEntcode
					 AND    c.cls_org     = @sOrgcode
					 AND    coalesce(c.cls_notused, N'-') = N'-'

  					return
   				end

			if @sRentity = N'PROM'
				begin
					if @sPar1 = N'DET'
						begin
							select	@nCountit = count(*)
							  FROM  r5propertyvalues p
							 WHERE  p.prv_rentity = @sEnttype
							 AND    p.prv_code    = @sEntcode

							if @nCountit > 0
								SET @nCountit = 1
							return
						end
   				end

			if @sRentity = N'R5CLAS'
				begin
					if @sPar1 IN ( N'OBJ', N'COMP', N'CONT', N'PART', N'PERS', N'ACCO', N'CAL', N'CLAU',

create function R5O7_O7GET_DESC (	@sLang		nvarchar(2),
									@sRentity	nvarchar(4),
									@sEntcode	nvarchar(100),
									@sRtype		nvarchar(4),
									@sUtype		nvarchar(4) )
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin
	declare @sDesctext	nvarchar(255)	-- r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(100)	-- r5descriptions.des_code%TYPE
	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15)	-- r5descriptions.des_org%TYPE
	declare @nPos		int
	declare @nOrgPos	int
	declare @nCount		int

	if coalesce( NULLIF( @sEntcode, '' ), N'#' ) = N'#' OR @sEntcode = N'##' OR @sRentity is null
		return( null )

	if charindex( N'%', @sEntcode ) <> 0
		return( @sEntcode )

	/* 	Get the description text, preferably in the user's language.
		However, if the description is available in only one language
		then that one will be returned. */

	SET @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sEntcode )
	if @nPos > 0 and @sRentity NOT IN ( N'HOME', N'TANK', N'PUMP', N'PROM', N'RMXC', N'CFGL' )
		begin
			SET @nOrgPos = len(@sEntcode) - charindex( N'#', Reverse(@sEntcode )) + 1
			SET @sCode = substring( @sEntcode, 1, @nOrgPos - 1 )
			SET @sOrg = substring( @sEntcode, @nOrgPos + 1, 40 )

			/* Query to find descriptions for codes with an org. */
			SELECT @sDesctext = d.des_text
			FROM   r5descriptions d
			WHERE  d.des_rentity = @sRentity
			AND    d.des_code    = @sCode
			AND    d.des_org     = @sOrg
			AND    d.des_lang    = @sLang
		end
	else
		begin
			SET @sCode = @sEntcode
			SET @sOrg = N'%'
			if @sRentity NOT IN ( N'RCOD', N'UCOD' )
				SELECT @sDesctext = d.des_text
				FROM   r5descriptions d
				WHERE  d.des_rentity = @sRentity
				AND    d.des_code    = @sCode
				AND    d.des_lang    = @sLang
			else
				SELECT @sDesctext = d.des_text
				FROM   r5descriptions d
				WHERE  d.des_rentity = @sRentity
				AND    d.des_code    = @sCode
				AND    d.des_org     = '*'
				AND    d.des_lang    = @sLang
				AND    d.des_rtype   = @sRtype;
		end
	if @sDesctext is not null AND @sRentity != 'CLAS'
		return( @sDesctext )

	SET @sDesctext = N'?'

    SELECT @sDesctext = d.des_text
    FROM   r5descriptions d
    WHERE  d.des_rtype   = COALESCE( case @sRtype when '' then null else @sRtype end, d.des_rtype )
    AND    d.des_type    = COALESCE( case @sUtype when '' then null else @sUtype end, d.des_type )
    AND    d.des_rentity = @sRentity
    AND    d.des_code    = @sCode
    AND    d.des_org  LIKE @sOrg
    AND    d.des_lang    = @sLang

    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        SELECT @sDesctext = d.des_text
        FROM   r5descriptions d
        WHERE  d.des_rtype   = COALESCE( case @sRtype when '' then null else @sRtype end, d.des_rtype )
        AND    d.des_type    = COALESCE( case @sUtype when '' then null else @sUtype end, d.des_type )
        AND    d.des_rentity = @sRentity
        AND    d.des_code    = @sCode
        AND    d.des_org  LIKE @sOrg

	if @sDesctext is null and @sRentity = N'EVNT'
		select @sDesctext = evt_desc from r5events where evt_code = @sCode

	return( @sDesctext )
end

create function [dbo].[R5O7_O7GET_ICON] (	@sRentity	nvarchar(4),
									@sUcode	nvarchar(100))
returns nvarchar(1000)
as
begin
	declare @sIconPath	nvarchar(1000)	-- r5ucodes.uco_iconpath%TYPE

    SELECT @sIconPath = CASE WHEN COALESCE( u.uco_iconpath, u.uco_icon ) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '@' END + COALESCE( u.uco_iconpath, u.uco_icon )
    FROM   r5ucodes u
    WHERE  u.uco_rentity   = @sRentity
    AND    u.uco_code    = @sUcode

	return( @sIconPath )
end

create procedure R5O7_O7RCODE 	@sRetcode	nvarchar(8)	OUTPUT,
								@sUcode		nvarchar(8),

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount		int

	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sRetcode = N'*'

	if @sUcode is null or @sRentity is null
		set @sChk = N'1'

	if @sRentity = N'ENT'
		begin
			select	@sRetcode = e.ent_rentity
			  FROM  r5entities   e
			 WHERE  e.ent_entity = @sUcode

            set @nCount = @@ROWCOUNT

			if @nCount <> 1
				begin
					if @nCount = 0
						set @sChk = N'2'
					else
        				set @sChk = N'999'
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			select	@sRetcode = s.uco_rcode
			  FROM  r5ucodes      s
			 WHERE  s.uco_code    = @sUcode
			 AND    s.uco_rentity = @sRentity

            set @nCount = @@ROWCOUNT

			if @nCount <> 1
				begin
					if @nCount = 0
						set @sChk = N'3'
					else
        				set @sChk = N'999'
				end
		end

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @sReturn NVARCHAR(8)
SET @sReturn = N'*'

IF @sRCode IS NULL OR @sREntity IS NULL
   RETURN @sReturn

IF @sREntity = N'ENT'
    BEGIN
	   SELECT @sReturn = ent_entity
		 FROM r5entities
		WHERE ent_rentity = @sRCode
	   IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
		 SET @sReturn = N'*'

     AND uco_system = N'+'
RETURN @sReturn
END

CREATE VIEW R5ONORDER2
(ONO_PART,ONO_PART_ORG,ONO_STORE,ONO_QTY)
AS 

SELECT
    x.orl_part,
   x.orl_part_org,
   x.orl_store,
   SUM( CASE x.orl_rtype WHEN N'PS' THEN x.orl_ordqty - coalesce( x.orl_recvqty, 0 ) - coalesce( x.orl_scrapqty, 0 ) ELSE coalesce(x.value, 0) END )
FROM 
    (SELECT
       orl_part,
       orl_part_org,
       orl_store,
       orl_rtype,
       orl_ordqty,
       orl_recvqty,
       orl_scrapqty,
       ( SELECT SUM(rpb_qty) FROM r5repairbins WHERE rpb_part = orl_part AND rpb_part_org = orl_part_org AND rpb_req = orl_req AND rpb_reqline = orl_reqline ) as value
    FROM     r5orderlines
    WHERE    orl_rtype  IN ( N'PS', N'RE' )
    AND      orl_active = N'+'
    ) x
GROUP BY x.orl_store,
         x.orl_part,
         x.orl_part_org

CREATE VIEW R5ONORDER_DETAILS
(ONOD_REQ, ONOD_REQLINE, ONOD_ORDER, ONOD_ORDER_ORG, ONOD_ORDLINE, 
 ONOD_TYPE, ONOD_STORE, ONOD_PART, ONOD_PART_ORG, ONOD_QTY, 
 ONOD_DUE, ONOD_QUOTFLAG, ONOD_RENTITY, ONOD_PURUOM, ONOD_BUYER)
AS 
SELECT
   o.orl_req,
   o.orl_reqline,
   o.orl_order,
   o.orl_order_org,
   o.orl_ordline,
   o.orl_type,
   o.orl_store,
   o.orl_part,
   o.orl_part_org,
   coalesce( o.orl_ordqty, 0 ) - coalesce( o.orl_recvqty, 0 ) - coalesce( o.orl_scrapqty, 0 ),
   o.orl_due,
   r.rql_quotflag,
   N'COMP',
   o.orl_puruom,
   d.ord_buyer
FROM   r5orders d,
       r5orderlines o left outer join r5requislines r on r.rql_req = o.orl_req AND r.rql_reqline = o.orl_reqline 
WHERE  d.ord_code = o.orl_order
AND    d.ord_org  = o.orl_order_org
AND    o.orl_active = N'+'
AND    coalesce( o.orl_ordqty, 0 ) - coalesce( o.orl_recvqty, 0 ) - coalesce( o.orl_scrapqty, 0 ) > 0
UNION
SELECT
   r.rql_req,
   r.rql_reqline,
   NULL,
   NULL,
   NULL,
   r.rql_type,
   e.req_tocode,
   r.rql_part,
   r.rql_part_org,
   coalesce( r.rql_qty, 0 ) - coalesce( r.rql_recvqty, 0 ) - coalesce( r.rql_scrapqty, 0 ),
   r.rql_due,
   r.rql_quotflag,
   e.req_fromrentity,
   NULL,
   r.rql_buyer
FROM   r5requislines  r,
       r5requisitions e
WHERE  e.req_code     = r.rql_req
AND    r.rql_rstatus  IN (N'A', N'U')
AND    coalesce( r.rql_qty, 0 ) - coalesce( r.rql_recvqty , 0 ) - coalesce( r.rql_scrapqty, 0 ) > 0
AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT N'x'
		   FROM   r5orderlines d
		   WHERE  d.orl_req     = r.rql_req
		   AND    d.orl_reqline = r.rql_reqline )

0

name: R5ONREPREQ

CREATE VIEW R5ONREPREQ
(RPR_PART, RPR_PART_ORG, RPR_STORE, RPR_QTY)
AS 
SELECT l.rql_part,
       l.rql_part_org,
       r.req_tocode,
       coalesce( SUM( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( l.rql_qty - coalesce( l.rql_recvqty, 0 ) - coalesce( l.rql_scrapqty, 0 ), 0 ) ), 0 )
FROM   r5requisitions r,
       r5parts p,
       r5requislines l
WHERE  r.req_code       = l.rql_req
AND    l.rql_part       = p.par_code
AND    l.rql_part_org   = p.par_org
AND    l.rql_rtype       IN ( N'RI', N'RE' )
AND    l.rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' )
AND    p.par_repairable = N'+'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                 FROM   r5joblines j
                 WHERE  j.jbl_req     = l.rql_req
                 AND    j.jbl_reqline = l.rql_reqline
                 AND    j.jbl_active  = N'+' )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                 FROM   r5orders o,
                        r5orderlines s
                 WHERE  s.orl_order     = o.ord_code
                 AND    s.orl_order_org = o.ord_org
                 AND    s.orl_req       = l.rql_req
                 AND    s.orl_reqline   = l.rql_reqline
                 AND    o.ord_rstatus IN ( N'A' ) )
GROUP BY l.rql_part,
         l.rql_part_org,
         r.req_tocode

CREATE VIEW R5ONREQUI2
(ORE_PART,ORE_PART_ORG,ORE_STORE,ORE_QTY)
AS 


SELECT 
   x.rql_part,
   x.rql_part_org,
   x.req_tocode,
	SUM( CASE x.rql_rtype WHEN N'PS' THEN x.rql_qty - coalesce( x.rql_recvqty, 0 ) - coalesce( x.rql_scrapqty, 0 ) ELSE coalesce(x.value, 0)  END )
FROM 
	(SELECT
	   r.rql_part,
	   r.rql_part_org,
	   q.req_tocode,
		r.rql_rtype,
		r.rql_qty, 
		r.rql_recvqty,
		r.rql_scrapqty,
		(SELECT SUM(rpb_qty) FROM r5repairbins WHERE rpb_part = r.rql_part AND rpb_part_org = r.rql_part_org AND rpb_req = r.rql_req AND rpb_reqline = r.rql_reqline) as value
	FROM     r5requislines  r,

	WHERE    q.req_code = r.rql_req
	AND      r.rql_rstatus IN ( N'U', N'R', N'A' )
	AND      r.rql_rtype IN ( N'PS', N'RE' )
	AND      r.rql_active = N'+'
	AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
	                 FROM   r5orderlines o
	                 WHERE  o.orl_req     = r.rql_req
